  1 | You are an AI assistant specialized in creating podcast transcripts.
  2 | Your task is to generate a transcript for a specific segment of a podcast episode based on a provided briefing and outline.
  3 | The transcript will be used to generate podcast audio. Follow these instructions carefully:
  4 | 
  5 | First, review the briefing for the podcast episode:
  6 | <briefing>
  7 | {{ briefing }}
  8 | </briefing>
  9 | 
 10 | The user has provided content to be used as the context for this podcast episode:
 11 | <context>
 12 | {% if context is string %}
 13 | {{ context }}
 14 | {% else %}
 15 | {% for item in context %}
 16 | <content_piece>
 17 | {{ item }}
 18 | </content_piece>
 19 | {% endfor %}
 20 | {% endif %}
 21 | </context>
 22 | 
 23 | The podcast features the following speakers:
 24 | <speakers>
 25 | {% for speaker in speakers %}
 26 | - **{{ speaker.name }}**: {{ speaker.backstory }}
 27 |   Personality: {{ speaker.personality }}
 28 | {% endfor %}
 29 | </speakers>
 30 | 
 31 | Next, examine the outline produced by our director:
 32 | <outline>
 33 | {{ outline }}
 34 | </outline>
 35 | 
 36 | {% if transcript %}
 37 | Here is the current transcript so far:
 38 | <transcript>
 39 | {{ transcript }}
 40 | </transcript>
 41 | {% endif %}
 42 | 
 43 | {% if is_final %}
 44 | This is the final segment of the podcast. Make sure to wrap up the conversation and provide a conclusion.
 45 | {% endif %}
 46 | 
 47 | 
 48 | You will focus on creating the dialogue for the following segment ONLY:
 49 | <segment>
 50 | {{ segment }}
 51 | </segment>
 52 | 
 53 | Follow these format requirements strictly:
 54 |    - Use the actual speaker names ({{ speaker_names|join(', ') }}) to denote speakers.
 55 |    - Choose which speaker should speak based on their personality, backstory, and the content being discussed.
 56 |    - Stick to the segment, do not go further than what's requested. Other agents will do the rest of the podcast.
 57 |    - The transcript must have at least {{ turns }} turns of messages between the speakers.
 58 |    - Each speaker should contribute meaningfully based on their expertise and personality.
 59 | 
 60 | 
 61 | ```json
 62 | {
 63 |     "transcript": [
 64 |         {
 65 |             "speaker": "[Actual Speaker Name]",
 66 |             "dialogue": "[Speaker's dialogue based on their personality and expertise]"
 67 |         },
 68 |     ...
 69 |     ]
 70 | }
 71 | ```
 72 | 
 73 | Formatting instructions:
 74 | {{ format_instructions}}
 75 | 
 76 | 
 77 | Guidelines for creating the transcript:
 78 |    - Ensure the conversation flows naturally and covers all points in the outline.
 79 |    - Ensure you return the root "transcript" key in your response.
 80 |    - Make the dialogue sound conversational and engaging.
 81 |    - Include relevant details from the briefing.
 82 |    - Avoid long monologues; keep exchanges between speakers balanced.
 83 |    - Use appropriate transitions between topics.
 84 |    - Match each speaker's dialogue to their personality and expertise.
 85 |    - Choose speakers strategically based on who would naturally contribute to each topic.
 86 |    - This is a whole podcast so no need to reintroduce speakers or topics on each segment. Segments are just markers for us to know to change the topics, nothing else.
 87 |    - IMPORTANT: Only use the provided speaker names: {{ speaker_names|join(', ') }}
 88 | 
 89 | IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT:
 90 | - If you use extended thinking with <think> tags, put ALL your reasoning inside <think></think> tags
 91 | - Put the final JSON output OUTSIDE and AFTER any <think> tags
 92 | - Do NOT wrap the JSON in ```json code blocks - return the raw JSON object only
 93 | - Example correct format:
 94 |   <think>Let me plan the dialogue...</think>
 95 |   {"transcript": [...]}
 96 | 
 97 | When you're ready, provide the transcript.
 98 | Remember, you are creating a realistic podcast conversation based on the given information.
 99 | Make it informative, engaging, and natural-sounding while adhering to the format requirements.
100 |

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import React from 'react'
  4 | import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
  5 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
  6 | import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'
  7 | import { enUS } from '@/lib/locales/en-US'
  8 | 
  9 | // Use English as fallback for ErrorBoundary (class component cannot use hooks)
 10 | const t = enUS
 11 | 
 12 | interface ErrorBoundaryState {
 13 |   hasError: boolean
 14 |   error?: Error
 15 |   errorInfo?: React.ErrorInfo
 16 | }
 17 | 
 18 | interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
 19 |   children: React.ReactNode
 20 |   fallback?: React.ComponentType<{error?: Error; resetError: () => void}>
 21 | }
 22 | 
 23 | export class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
 24 |   constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
 25 |     super(props)
 26 |     this.state = { hasError: false }
 27 |   }
 28 | 
 29 |   static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
 30 |     return {
 31 |       hasError: true,
 32 |       error
 33 |     }
 34 |   }
 35 | 
 36 |   componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
 37 |     console.error('Error caught by boundary:', error, errorInfo)
 38 |     this.setState({
 39 |       error,
 40 |       errorInfo
 41 |     })
 42 |   }
 43 | 
 44 |   resetError = () => {
 45 |     this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined, errorInfo: undefined })
 46 |   }
 47 | 
 48 |   render() {
 49 |     if (this.state.hasError) {
 50 |       if (this.props.fallback) {
 51 |         const FallbackComponent = this.props.fallback
 52 |         return <FallbackComponent error={this.state.error} resetError={this.resetError} />
 53 |       }
 54 | 
 55 |       return (
 56 |         <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background p-4">
 57 |           <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
 58 |             <CardHeader className="text-center">
 59 |               <div className="mx-auto w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/20 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
 60 |                 <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
 61 |               </div>
 62 |               <CardTitle className="text-red-900 dark:text-red-100">{t?.common?.error || 'Something went wrong'}</CardTitle>
 63 |               <CardDescription>
 64 |                 {t?.common?.refreshPage || 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try refreshing the page.'}
 65 |               </CardDescription>
 66 |             </CardHeader>
 67 |             <CardContent className="space-y-4">
 68 |               {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && this.state.error && (
 69 |                 <details className="text-xs bg-muted p-3 rounded border">
 70 |                   <summary className="cursor-pointer font-medium">{t?.common?.errorDetails || 'Error Details'}</summary>
 71 |                   <pre className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
 72 |                     {this.state.error.toString()}
 73 |                   </pre>
 74 |                 </details>
 75 |               )}
 76 |               <Button 
 77 |                 onClick={this.resetError} 
 78 |                 className="w-full"
 79 |                 variant="outline"
 80 |               >
 81 |                 <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
 82 |                 {t?.common?.retry || 'Try Again'}
 83 |               </Button>
 84 |               <Button 
 85 |                 onClick={() => window.location.reload()} 
 86 |                 className="w-full"
 87 |               >
 88 |                 {t?.common?.refresh || 'Refresh Page'}
 89 |               </Button>
 90 |             </CardContent>
 91 |           </Card>
 92 |         </div>
 93 |       )
 94 |     }
 95 | 
 96 |     return this.props.children
 97 |   }
 98 | }
 99 | 
100 | // Hook version for functional components
101 | export function useErrorBoundary() {
102 |   return (error: Error) => {
103 |     throw error
104 |   }
105 | }

 1 | from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
 2 | 
 3 | from loguru import logger
 4 | from surreal_commands import get_command_status, submit_command
 5 | 
 6 | 
 7 | class CommandService:
 8 |     """Generic service layer for command operations"""
 9 | 
10 |     @staticmethod
11 |     async def submit_command_job(
12 |         module_name: str,  # Actually app_name for surreal-commands
13 |         command_name: str,
14 |         command_args: Dict[str, Any],
15 |         context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
16 |     ) -> str:
17 |         """Submit a generic command job for background processing"""
18 |         try:
19 |             # Ensure command modules are imported before submitting
20 |             # This is needed because submit_command validates against local registry
21 |             try:
22 |                 import commands.podcast_commands  # noqa: F401
23 |             except ImportError as import_err:
24 |                 logger.error(f"Failed to import command modules: {import_err}")
25 |                 raise ValueError("Command modules not available")
26 | 
27 |             # surreal-commands expects: submit_command(app_name, command_name, args)
28 |             cmd_id = submit_command(
29 |                 module_name,  # This is actually the app name (e.g., "open_notebook")
30 |                 command_name,  # Command name (e.g., "process_text")
31 |                 command_args,  # Input data
32 |             )
33 |             # Convert RecordID to string if needed
34 |             if not cmd_id:
35 |                 raise ValueError("Failed to get cmd_id from submit_command")
36 |             cmd_id_str = str(cmd_id)
37 |             logger.info(
38 |                 f"Submitted command job: {cmd_id_str} for {module_name}.{command_name}"
39 |             )
40 |             return cmd_id_str
41 | 
42 |         except Exception as e:
43 |             logger.error(f"Failed to submit command job: {e}")
44 |             raise
45 | 
46 |     @staticmethod
47 |     async def get_command_status(job_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
48 |         """Get status of any command job"""
49 |         try:
50 |             status = await get_command_status(job_id)
51 |             return {
52 |                 "job_id": job_id,
53 |                 "status": status.status if status else "unknown",
54 |                 "result": status.result if status else None,
55 |                 "error_message": getattr(status, "error_message", None)
56 |                 if status
57 |                 else None,
58 |                 "created": str(status.created)
59 |                 if status and hasattr(status, "created") and status.created
60 |                 else None,
61 |                 "updated": str(status.updated)
62 |                 if status and hasattr(status, "updated") and status.updated
63 |                 else None,
64 |                 "progress": getattr(status, "progress", None) if status else None,
65 |             }
66 |         except Exception as e:
67 |             logger.error(f"Failed to get command status: {e}")
68 |             raise
69 | 
70 |     @staticmethod
71 |     async def list_command_jobs(
72 |         module_filter: Optional[str] = None,
73 |         command_filter: Optional[str] = None,
74 |         status_filter: Optional[str] = None,
75 |         limit: int = 50,
76 |     ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
77 |         """List command jobs with optional filtering"""
78 |         # This will be implemented with proper SurrealDB queries
79 |         # For now, return empty list as this is foundation phase
80 |         return []
81 | 
82 |     @staticmethod
83 |     async def cancel_command_job(job_id: str) -> bool:
84 |         """Cancel a running command job"""
85 |         try:
86 |             # Implementation depends on surreal-commands cancellation support
87 |             # For now, just log the attempt
88 |             logger.info(f"Attempting to cancel job: {job_id}")
89 |             return True
90 |         except Exception as e:
91 |             logger.error(f"Failed to cancel command job: {e}")
92 |             raise

  1 | """
  2 | Insights service layer using API.
  3 | """
  4 | 
  5 | from typing import List, Optional
  6 | 
  7 | from loguru import logger
  8 | 
  9 | from api.client import api_client
 10 | from open_notebook.domain.notebook import Note, SourceInsight
 11 | 
 12 | 
 13 | class InsightsService:
 14 |     """Service layer for insights operations using API."""
 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self):
 17 |         logger.info("Using API for insights operations")
 18 | 
 19 |     def get_source_insights(self, source_id: str) -> List[SourceInsight]:
 20 |         """Get all insights for a specific source."""
 21 |         insights_data = api_client.get_source_insights(source_id)
 22 |         # Convert API response to SourceInsight objects
 23 |         insights = []
 24 |         for insight_data in insights_data:
 25 |             insight = SourceInsight(
 26 |                 insight_type=insight_data["insight_type"],
 27 |                 content=insight_data["content"],
 28 |             )
 29 |             insight.id = insight_data["id"]
 30 |             insight.created = insight_data["created"]
 31 |             insight.updated = insight_data["updated"]
 32 |             insights.append(insight)
 33 |         return insights
 34 | 
 35 |     def get_insight(self, insight_id: str) -> SourceInsight:
 36 |         """Get a specific insight."""
 37 |         insight_response = api_client.get_insight(insight_id)
 38 |         insight_data = (
 39 |             insight_response
 40 |             if isinstance(insight_response, dict)
 41 |             else insight_response[0]
 42 |         )
 43 |         insight = SourceInsight(
 44 |             insight_type=insight_data["insight_type"],
 45 |             content=insight_data["content"],
 46 |         )
 47 |         insight.id = insight_data["id"]
 48 |         insight.created = insight_data["created"]
 49 |         insight.updated = insight_data["updated"]
 50 |         # Note: source_id from API response is not stored; use await insight.get_source() if needed
 51 |         return insight
 52 | 
 53 |     def delete_insight(self, insight_id: str) -> bool:
 54 |         """Delete a specific insight."""
 55 |         api_client.delete_insight(insight_id)
 56 |         return True
 57 | 
 58 |     def save_insight_as_note(
 59 |         self, insight_id: str, notebook_id: Optional[str] = None
 60 |     ) -> Note:
 61 |         """Convert an insight to a note."""
 62 |         note_response = api_client.save_insight_as_note(insight_id, notebook_id)
 63 |         note_data = (
 64 |             note_response if isinstance(note_response, dict) else note_response[0]
 65 |         )
 66 |         note = Note(
 67 |             title=note_data["title"],
 68 |             content=note_data["content"],
 69 |             note_type=note_data["note_type"],
 70 |         )
 71 |         note.id = note_data["id"]
 72 |         note.created = note_data["created"]
 73 |         note.updated = note_data["updated"]
 74 |         return note
 75 | 
 76 |     def create_source_insight(
 77 |         self, source_id: str, transformation_id: str, model_id: Optional[str] = None
 78 |     ) -> SourceInsight:
 79 |         """Create a new insight for a source by running a transformation."""
 80 |         insight_response = api_client.create_source_insight(
 81 |             source_id, transformation_id, model_id
 82 |         )
 83 |         insight_data = (
 84 |             insight_response
 85 |             if isinstance(insight_response, dict)
 86 |             else insight_response[0]
 87 |         )
 88 |         insight = SourceInsight(
 89 |             insight_type=insight_data["insight_type"],
 90 |             content=insight_data["content"],
 91 |         )
 92 |         insight.id = insight_data["id"]
 93 |         insight.created = insight_data["created"]
 94 |         insight.updated = insight_data["updated"]
 95 |         # Note: source_id from API response is not stored; use await insight.get_source() if needed
 96 |         return insight
 97 | 
 98 | 
 99 | # Global service instance
100 | insights_service = InsightsService()
101 |

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useState } from 'react'
  4 | import {
  5 |   Dialog,
  6 |   DialogContent,
  7 |   DialogDescription,
  8 |   DialogFooter,
  9 |   DialogHeader,
 10 |   DialogTitle,
 11 | } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
 12 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
 13 | import { CheckboxList } from '@/components/ui/checkbox-list'
 14 | import { useNotebooks } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notebooks'
 15 | import { useCreateNote } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notes'
 16 | import { LoadingSpinner } from '@/components/common/LoadingSpinner'
 17 | import { toast } from 'sonner'
 18 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 19 | 
 20 | interface SaveToNotebooksDialogProps {
 21 |   open: boolean
 22 |   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
 23 |   question: string
 24 |   answer: string
 25 | }
 26 | 
 27 | export function SaveToNotebooksDialog({
 28 |   open,
 29 |   onOpenChange,
 30 |   question,
 31 |   answer
 32 | }: SaveToNotebooksDialogProps) {
 33 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 34 |   const [selectedNotebooks, setSelectedNotebooks] = useState<string[]>([])
 35 |   const { data: notebooks, isLoading } = useNotebooks(false) // false = not archived
 36 |   const createNote = useCreateNote()
 37 | 
 38 |   const handleToggle = (notebookId: string) => {
 39 |     setSelectedNotebooks(prev =>
 40 |       prev.includes(notebookId)
 41 |         ? prev.filter(id => id !== notebookId)
 42 |         : [...prev, notebookId]
 43 |     )
 44 |   }
 45 | 
 46 |   const handleSave = async () => {
 47 |     if (selectedNotebooks.length === 0) {
 48 |       toast.error(t.searchPage.selectNotebook)
 49 |       return
 50 |     }
 51 | 
 52 |     try {
 53 |       // Create note in each selected notebook
 54 |       for (const notebookId of selectedNotebooks) {
 55 |         await createNote.mutateAsync({
 56 |           title: question,
 57 |           content: answer,
 58 |           note_type: 'ai',
 59 |           notebook_id: notebookId
 60 |         })
 61 |       }
 62 | 
 63 |       toast.success(t.searchPage.saveSuccess)
 64 |       setSelectedNotebooks([])
 65 |       onOpenChange(false)
 66 |     } catch {
 67 |       toast.error(t.searchPage.saveError)
 68 |     }
 69 |   }
 70 | 
 71 |   const notebookItems = notebooks?.map(nb => ({
 72 |     id: nb.id,
 73 |     title: nb.name,
 74 |     description: nb.description || undefined
 75 |   })) || []
 76 | 
 77 |   return (
 78 |     <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
 79 |       <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
 80 |         <DialogHeader>
 81 |           <DialogTitle>{t.searchPage.saveToNotebooks}</DialogTitle>
 82 |           <DialogDescription>
 83 |             {t.searchPage.selectNotebook}
 84 |           </DialogDescription>
 85 |         </DialogHeader>
 86 | 
 87 |         <div className="py-4">
 88 |           {isLoading ? (
 89 |             <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
 90 |               <LoadingSpinner />
 91 |             </div>
 92 |           ) : (
 93 |             <CheckboxList
 94 |               items={notebookItems}
 95 |               selectedIds={selectedNotebooks}
 96 |               onToggle={handleToggle}
 97 |               emptyMessage={t.sources.noNotebooksFound}
 98 |             />
 99 |           )}
100 |         </div>
101 | 
102 |         <DialogFooter>
103 |           <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
104 |             {t.common.cancel}
105 |           </Button>
106 |           <Button
107 |             onClick={handleSave}
108 |             disabled={selectedNotebooks.length === 0 || createNote.isPending}
109 |           >
110 |             {createNote.isPending ? (
111 |               <>
112 |                 <LoadingSpinner size="sm" className="mr-2" />
113 |                 {t.searchPage.saving}
114 |               </>
115 |             ) : (
116 |               t.searchPage.saveToNotebook
117 |             )}
118 |           </Button>
119 |         </DialogFooter>
120 |       </DialogContent>
121 |     </Dialog>
122 |   )
123 | }
124 |

  1 | 'use client'

  3 | import { useState } from 'react'
  4 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
  5 | import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
  6 | import { Save, Copy, Loader2, Check } from 'lucide-react'
  7 | import { useCreateNote } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notes'
  8 | import { toast } from 'sonner'
  9 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 10 | 
 11 | interface MessageActionsProps {
 12 |   content: string
 13 |   notebookId?: string
 14 | }
 15 | 
 16 | export function MessageActions({ content, notebookId }: MessageActionsProps) {
 17 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 18 |   const [copySuccess, setCopySuccess] = useState(false)
 19 |   const createNote = useCreateNote()
 20 | 
 21 |   const handleSaveToNote = () => {
 22 |     if (!notebookId) {
 23 |       toast.error(t.sources.cannotSaveNoteNoNotebook)
 24 |       return
 25 |     }
 26 | 
 27 |     createNote.mutate({
 28 |       content,
 29 |       note_type: 'ai',
 30 |       notebook_id: notebookId,
 31 |       // Title will be auto-generated by the API for AI notes
 32 |     })
 33 |   }
 34 | 
 35 |   const handleCopyToClipboard = async () => {
 36 |     try {
 37 |       // Try modern clipboard API first
 38 |       if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
 39 |         await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content)
 40 |         toast.success(t.common.copyToClipboard)
 41 |         setCopySuccess(true)
 42 |         setTimeout(() => setCopySuccess(false), 2000)
 43 |       } else {
 44 |         // Fallback for older browsers
 45 |         const textArea = document.createElement('textarea')
 46 |         textArea.value = content
 47 |         textArea.style.position = 'fixed'
 48 |         textArea.style.left = '-999999px'
 49 |         textArea.style.top = '-999999px'
 50 |         document.body.appendChild(textArea)
 51 |         textArea.focus()
 52 |         textArea.select()
 53 | 
 54 |         try {
 55 |           document.execCommand('copy')
 56 |           toast.success(t.common.copyToClipboard)
 57 |           setCopySuccess(true)
 58 |           setTimeout(() => setCopySuccess(false), 2000)
 59 |         } catch {
 60 |           toast.error(t.common.error)
 61 |         }
 62 | 
 63 |         document.body.removeChild(textArea)
 64 |       }
 65 |     } catch (err) {
 66 |       console.error('Failed to copy to clipboard:', err)
 67 |       toast.error(t.common.error)
 68 |     }
 69 |   }
 70 | 
 71 |   return (
 72 |     <TooltipProvider>
 73 |       <div className="flex gap-1">
 74 |         {notebookId && (
 75 |           <Tooltip>
 76 |             <TooltipTrigger asChild>
 77 |               <Button
 78 |                 variant="ghost"
 79 |                 size="sm"
 80 |                 className="h-7 px-2"
 81 |                 onClick={handleSaveToNote}
 82 |                 disabled={createNote.isPending}
 83 |               >
 84 |                 {createNote.isPending ? (
 85 |                   <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
 86 |                 ) : (
 87 |                   <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
 88 |                 )}
 89 |               </Button>
 90 |             </TooltipTrigger>
 91 |             <TooltipContent>
 92 |               <p>{t.common.saveToNote}</p>
 93 |             </TooltipContent>
 94 |           </Tooltip>
 95 |         )}
 96 |         <Tooltip>
 97 |           <TooltipTrigger asChild>
 98 |             <Button
 99 |               variant="ghost"
100 |               size="sm"
101 |               className="h-7 px-2"
102 |               onClick={handleCopyToClipboard}
103 |               disabled={createNote.isPending}
104 |             >
105 |               {copySuccess ? (
106 |                 <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-green-500" />
107 |               ) : (
108 |                 <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
109 |               )}
110 |             </Button>
111 |           </TooltipTrigger>
112 |           <TooltipContent>
113 |             <p>{t.common.copyToClipboard}</p>
114 |           </TooltipContent>
115 |         </Tooltip>
116 |       </div>
117 |     </TooltipProvider>
118 |   )
119 | }

/docs/1-INSTALLATION/from-source.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # From Source Installation
  2 | 
  3 | Clone the repository and run locally. **For developers and contributors.**
  4 | 
  5 | ## Prerequisites
  6 | 
  7 | - **Python 3.11+** - [Download](https://www.python.org/)
  8 | - **Node.js 18+** - [Download](https://nodejs.org/)
  9 | - **Git** - [Download](https://git-scm.com/)
 10 | - **Docker** (for SurrealDB) - [Download](https://docker.com/)
 11 | - **uv** (Python package manager) - `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
 12 | - API key from OpenAI or similar (or use Ollama for free)
 13 | 
 14 | ## Quick Setup (10 minutes)
 15 | 
 16 | ### 1. Clone Repository
 17 | 
 18 | ```bash
 19 | git clone https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook.git
 20 | cd open-notebook
 21 | 
 22 | # If you forked it:
 23 | git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/open-notebook.git
 24 | cd open-notebook
 25 | git remote add upstream https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook.git
 26 | ```
 27 | 
 28 | ### 2. Install Python Dependencies
 29 | 
 30 | ```bash
 31 | uv sync
 32 | uv pip install python-magic
 33 | ```
 34 | 
 35 | #### 2.1 Alternative: Conda Setup (Optional)
 36 | 
 37 | If you prefer using **Conda** to manage your environments, follow these steps instead of the standard `uv sync`:
 38 | 
 39 | ```bash
 40 | # Create and activate the environment
 41 | conda create -n open-notebook python=3.11 -y
 42 | conda activate open-notebook
 43 | 
 44 | # Install uv inside conda to maintain compatibility with the Makefile
 45 | conda install -c conda-forge uv nodejs -y
 46 | 
 47 | # Sync dependencies
 48 | uv sync
 49 | ```
 50 | 
 51 | > **Note**: Installing `uv` inside your Conda environment ensures that commands like `make start-all` and `make api` continue to work seamlessly.
 52 | 
 53 | ### 3. Start SurrealDB
 54 | 
 55 | ```bash
 56 | # Terminal 1
 57 | make database
 58 | # or: docker compose up surrealdb
 59 | ```
 60 | 
 61 | ### 4. Set Environment Variables
 62 | 
 63 | ```bash
 64 | cp .env.example .env
 65 | # Edit .env and add your API key:
 66 | # OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
 67 | # (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, etc.)
 68 | ```
 69 | 
 70 | ### 5. Start API
 71 | 
 72 | ```bash
 73 | # Terminal 2
 74 | make api
 75 | # or: uv run --env-file .env uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5055
 76 | ```
 77 | 
 78 | ### 6. Start Frontend
 79 | 
 80 | ```bash
 81 | # Terminal 3
 82 | cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
 83 | ```
 84 | 
 85 | ### 7. Access
 86 | 
 87 | - **Frontend**: http://localhost:3000
 88 | - **API Docs**: http://localhost:5055/docs
 89 | - **Database**: http://localhost:8000
 90 | 
 91 | ---
 92 | 
 93 | ## Development Workflow
 94 | 
 95 | ### Code Quality
 96 | 
 97 | ```bash
 98 | # Format and lint Python
 99 | make ruff
100 | # or: ruff check . --fix
101 | 
102 | # Type checking
103 | make lint
104 | # or: uv run python -m mypy .
105 | ```
106 | 
107 | ### Run Tests
108 | 
109 | ```bash
110 | uv run pytest tests/
111 | ```
112 | 
113 | ### Common Commands
114 | 
115 | ```bash
116 | # Start everything
117 | make start-all
118 | 
119 | # View API docs
120 | open http://localhost:5055/docs
121 | 
122 | # Check database migrations
123 | # (Auto-run on API startup)
124 | 
125 | # Clean up
126 | make clean
127 | ```
128 | 
129 | ---
130 | 
131 | ## Troubleshooting
132 | 
133 | ### Python version too old
134 | 
135 | ```bash
136 | python --version  # Check version
137 | uv sync --python 3.11  # Use specific version
138 | ```
139 | 
140 | ### npm: command not found
141 | 
142 | Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org/
143 | 
144 | ### Database connection errors
145 | 
146 | ```bash
147 | docker ps  # Check SurrealDB running
148 | docker logs surrealdb  # View logs
149 | ```
150 | 
151 | ### Port 5055 already in use
152 | 
153 | ```bash
154 | # Use different port
155 | uv run uvicorn api.main:app --port 5056
156 | ```
157 | 
158 | ---
159 | 
160 | ## Next Steps
161 | 
162 | 1. Read [Development Guide](../7-DEVELOPMENT/quick-start.md)
163 | 2. See [Architecture Overview](../7-DEVELOPMENT/architecture.md)
164 | 3. Check [Contributing Guide](../7-DEVELOPMENT/contributing.md)
165 | 
166 | ---
167 | 
168 | ## Getting Help
169 | 
170 | - **Discord**: [Community](https://discord.gg/37XJPXfz2w)
171 | - **Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/issues)
172 |

 28 |   open,
 29 |   onOpenChange,
 30 |   onConfirm,
 31 |   oldModelName,
 32 |   newModelName
 33 | }: EmbeddingModelChangeDialogProps) {
 34 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 35 |   const router = useRouter()
 36 |   const [isConfirming, setIsConfirming] = useState(false)
 37 | 
 38 |   const handleConfirmAndRebuild = () => {
 39 |     setIsConfirming(true)
 40 |     onConfirm()
 41 |     // Give a moment for the model to update, then redirect
 42 |     setTimeout(() => {
 43 |       router.push('/advanced')
 44 |       onOpenChange(false)
 45 |       setIsConfirming(false)
 46 |     }, 500)
 47 |   }
 48 | 
 49 |   const handleConfirmOnly = () => {
 50 |     onConfirm()
 51 |     onOpenChange(false)
 52 |   }
 53 | 
 54 |   return (
 55 |     <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
 56 |       <AlertDialogContent className="max-w-lg">
 57 |         <AlertDialogHeader>
 58 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
 59 |             <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-500" />
 60 |             <AlertDialogTitle>{t.models.embeddingChangeTitle}</AlertDialogTitle>
 61 |           </div>
 62 |           <AlertDialogDescription asChild>
 63 |             <div className="space-y-3 text-base text-muted-foreground">
 64 |               <p>
 65 |                 {t.models.embeddingChangeConfirm
 66 |                   .replace('{from}', oldModelName || '...')
 67 |                   .replace('{to}', newModelName || '...')}
 68 |               </p>
 69 | 
 70 |               <div className="bg-muted p-4 rounded-md space-y-2">
 71 |                 <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">⚠️ {t.models.rebuildRequired}</p>
 72 |                 <p className="text-sm">
 73 |                   {t.models.rebuildReason}
 74 |                 </p>
 75 |               </div>
 76 | 
 77 |               <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
 78 |                 <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{t.models.whatHappensNext}</p>
 79 |                 <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 ml-2">
 80 |                   <li>{t.models.step1}</li>
 81 |                   <li>{t.models.step2}</li>
 82 |                   <li>{t.models.step3}</li>
 83 |                   <li>{t.models.step4}</li>
 84 |                 </ul>
 85 |               </div>
 86 | 
 87 |               <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
 88 |                 {t.models.proceedToRebuildPrompt}
 89 |               </p>
 90 |             </div>
 91 |           </AlertDialogDescription>
 92 |         </AlertDialogHeader>
 93 |         <AlertDialogFooter className="flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
 94 |           <AlertDialogCancel disabled={isConfirming}>
 95 |             {t.common.cancel}
 96 |           </AlertDialogCancel>
 97 |           <Button
 98 |             variant="outline"
 99 |             onClick={handleConfirmOnly}
100 |             disabled={isConfirming}
101 |           >
102 |             {t.models.changeModelOnly}
103 |           </Button>
104 |           <AlertDialogAction
105 |             onClick={handleConfirmAndRebuild}
106 |             disabled={isConfirming}
107 |             className="bg-primary"
108 |           >
109 |             <ExternalLink className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
110 |             {t.models.changeAndRebuild}
111 |           </AlertDialogAction>
112 |         </AlertDialogFooter>
113 |       </AlertDialogContent>
114 |     </AlertDialog>
115 |   )
116 | }
117 |

  1 | # Build stage
  2 | FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS builder
  3 | 
  4 | # Install uv using the official method
  5 | COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /bin/
  6 | 
  7 | # Install system dependencies required for building certain Python packages
  8 | # Add Node.js 20.x LTS for building frontend
  9 | # NOTE: gcc/g++/make removed - uv should download pre-built wheels. Add back if build fails.
 10 | # NOTE: gcc/g++/make required for some python dependencies
 11 | RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
 12 |     curl \
 13 |     build-essential \
 14 |     && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - \
 15 |     && apt-get install -y nodejs \
 16 |     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 17 | 
 18 | # Set build optimization environment variables
 19 | ENV MAKEFLAGS="-j$(nproc)"
 20 | ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
 21 | ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
 22 | ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
 23 | ENV UV_LINK_MODE=copy
 24 | 
 25 | # Set the working directory in the container to /app
 26 | WORKDIR /app
 27 | 
 28 | # Copy dependency files and minimal package structure first for better layer caching
 29 | COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
 30 | COPY open_notebook/__init__.py ./open_notebook/__init__.py
 31 | 
 32 | # Install dependencies with optimizations (this layer will be cached unless dependencies change)
 33 | RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev
 34 | 
 35 | # Copy the rest of the application code
 36 | COPY . /app
 37 | 
 38 | # Install frontend dependencies and build
 39 | WORKDIR /app/frontend
 40 | ARG NPM_REGISTRY=https://registry.npmjs.org/
 41 | COPY frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json ./
 42 | RUN npm config set registry ${NPM_REGISTRY}
 43 | RUN npm ci
 44 | COPY frontend/ ./
 45 | RUN npm run build
 46 | 
 47 | # Return to app root
 48 | WORKDIR /app
 49 | 
 50 | # Runtime stage
 51 | FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS runtime
 52 | 
 53 | # Install only runtime system dependencies (no build tools)
 54 | # Add Node.js 20.x LTS for running frontend
 55 | RUN apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
 56 |     ffmpeg \
 57 |     supervisor \
 58 |     curl \
 59 |     && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - \
 60 |     && apt-get install -y nodejs \
 61 |     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 62 | 
 63 | # Install uv using the official method
 64 | COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /bin/
 65 | 
 66 | # Set the working directory in the container to /app
 67 | WORKDIR /app
 68 | 
 69 | # Copy the virtual environment from builder stage
 70 | COPY --from=builder /app/.venv /app/.venv
 71 | 
 72 | # Copy the source code (the rest)
 73 | COPY . /app
 74 | 
 75 | # Ensure uv uses the existing venv without attempting network operations
 76 | ENV UV_NO_SYNC=1
 77 | ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/app/.venv
 78 | 
 79 | # Bind Next.js to all interfaces (required for Docker networking and reverse proxies)
 80 | ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
 81 | 
 82 | # Copy built frontend from builder stage
 83 | COPY --from=builder /app/frontend/.next/standalone /app/frontend/
 84 | COPY --from=builder /app/frontend/.next/static /app/frontend/.next/static
 85 | COPY --from=builder /app/frontend/public /app/frontend/public
 86 | COPY --from=builder /app/frontend/start-server.js /app/frontend/start-server.js
 87 | 
 88 | # Expose ports for Frontend and API
 89 | EXPOSE 8502 5055
 90 | 
 91 | RUN mkdir -p /app/data
 92 | 
 93 | # Copy and make executable the wait-for-api script
 94 | COPY scripts/wait-for-api.sh /app/scripts/wait-for-api.sh
 95 | RUN chmod +x /app/scripts/wait-for-api.sh
 96 | 
 97 | # Copy supervisord configuration
 98 | COPY supervisord.conf /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf
 99 | 
100 | # Create log directories
101 | RUN mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor
102 | 
103 | # Runtime API URL Configuration
104 | # The API_URL environment variable can be set at container runtime to configure
105 | # where the frontend should connect to the API. This allows the same Docker image
106 | # to work in different deployment scenarios without rebuilding.
107 | #
108 | # If not set, the system will auto-detect based on incoming requests.
109 | # Set API_URL when using reverse proxies or custom domains.
110 | #
111 | # Example: docker run -e API_URL=https://your-domain.com/api ...
112 | 
113 | CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf"]
114 |

  1 | REMOVE TABLE IF EXISTS chat_session;

  6 | REMOVE FUNCTION fn::vector_search;
  7 | 
  8 | 
  9 | DEFINE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS fn::vector_search($query: array<float>, $match_count: int, $sources:bool, $show_notes:bool) {
 10 |    
 11 |     let $source_embedding_search = 
 12 |          IF $sources {(
 13 |             SELECT source as item_id, content, vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
 14 |             FROM source_embedding LIMIT $match_count)}
 15 |         ELSE { [] };
 16 | 
 17 |     
 18 |     let $source_insight_search = 
 19 |          IF $sources {(
 20 |              SELECT source as item_id, content, vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
 21 |                 FROM source_insight LIMIT $match_count)}
 22 |         ELSE { [] };
 23 | 
 24 |     
 25 |      let $note_content_search = 
 26 |          IF $show_notes {(
 27 |                 SELECT id as item_id, content, vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
 28 |                 FROM note LIMIT $match_count)}
 29 | 
 30 |         ELSE { [] };
 31 | 
 32 |     let $source_chunk_results = array::union($source_embedding_search, $source_insight_search);
 33 |     
 34 |     let $source_results = array::union($source_chunk_results, $source_insight_search);
 35 | 
 36 |     let $note_results = $note_content_search;
 37 |     let $final_results = array::union($source_results, $note_results );
 38 | 
 39 |     RETURN (SELECT item_id, math::max(similarity) as similarity from $final_results
 40 |         group by item_id ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT $match_count);
 41 |     
 42 |     
 43 | };
 44 | 
 45 | REMOVE FUNCTION fn::text_search;
 46 | 
 47 | 
 48 | DEFINE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS fn::text_search($query_text: string, $match_count: int, $sources:bool, $show_notes:bool) {
 49 |   
 50 |     let $source_title_search = 
 51 |         IF $sources {(
 52 |             SELECT id as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 53 |             FROM source
 54 |             WHERE title @1@ $query_text
 55 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 56 |         ELSE { [] };
 57 |     
 58 |     let $source_embedding_search = 
 59 |          IF $sources {(
 60 |              SELECT source as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 61 |             FROM source_embedding
 62 |             WHERE content @1@ $query_text
 63 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 64 |         ELSE { [] };
 65 | 
 66 |     let $source_full_search = 
 67 |          IF $sources {(
 68 |             SELECT source as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 69 |             FROM source
 70 |             WHERE full_text @1@ $query_text
 71 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 72 |         ELSE { [] };
 73 |     
 74 |     let $source_insight_search = 
 75 |          IF $sources {(
 76 |              SELECT source as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 77 |             FROM source_insight
 78 |             WHERE content @1@ $query_text
 79 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 80 |         ELSE { [] };
 81 | 
 82 |     let $note_title_search = 
 83 |          IF $show_notes {(
 84 |              SELECT id as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 85 |             FROM note
 86 |             WHERE title @1@ $query_text
 87 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 88 |         ELSE { [] };
 89 | 
 90 |      let $note_content_search = 
 91 |          IF $show_notes {(
 92 |              SELECT id as item_id, math::max(search::score(1)) AS relevance
 93 |             FROM note
 94 |             WHERE content @1@ $query_text
 95 |             GROUP BY item_id)}
 96 |         ELSE { [] };
 97 | 
 98 |     let $source_chunk_results = array::union($source_embedding_search, $source_full_search);
 99 |     
100 |     let $source_asset_results = array::union($source_title_search, $source_insight_search);
101 | 
102 |     let $source_results = array::union($source_chunk_results, $source_asset_results );
103 |     let $note_results = array::union($note_title_search, $note_content_search );
104 |     let $final_results = array::union($source_results, $note_results );
105 | 
106 |     RETURN (SELECT item_id, math::max(relevance) as relevance from $final_results
107 |         group by item_id ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT $match_count);
108 |     
109 |     
110 | };

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useMemo } from 'react'
  4 | import { useNotebookChat } from '@/lib/hooks/useNotebookChat'
  5 | import { useSources } from '@/lib/hooks/use-sources'
  6 | import { useNotes } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notes'
  7 | import { ChatPanel } from '@/components/source/ChatPanel'
  8 | import { LoadingSpinner } from '@/components/common/LoadingSpinner'
  9 | import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card'
 10 | import { AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react'
 11 | import { ContextSelections } from '../[id]/page'
 12 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 13 | 
 14 | interface ChatColumnProps {
 15 |   notebookId: string
 16 |   contextSelections: ContextSelections
 17 | }
 18 | 
 19 | export function ChatColumn({ notebookId, contextSelections }: ChatColumnProps) {
 20 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 21 | 
 22 |   // Fetch sources and notes for this notebook
 23 |   const { data: sources = [], isLoading: sourcesLoading } = useSources(notebookId)
 24 |   const { data: notes = [], isLoading: notesLoading } = useNotes(notebookId)
 25 | 
 26 |   // Initialize notebook chat hook
 27 |   const chat = useNotebookChat({
 28 |     notebookId,
 29 |     sources,
 30 |     notes,
 31 |     contextSelections
 32 |   })
 33 | 
 34 |   // Calculate context stats for indicator
 35 |   const contextStats = useMemo(() => {
 36 |     let sourcesInsights = 0
 37 |     let sourcesFull = 0
 38 |     let notesCount = 0
 39 | 
 40 |     // Count sources by mode
 41 |     sources.forEach(source => {
 42 |       const mode = contextSelections.sources[source.id]
 43 |       if (mode === 'insights') {
 44 |         sourcesInsights++
 45 |       } else if (mode === 'full') {
 46 |         sourcesFull++
 47 |       }
 48 |     })
 49 | 
 50 |     // Count notes that are included (not 'off')
 51 |     notes.forEach(note => {
 52 |       const mode = contextSelections.notes[note.id]
 53 |       if (mode === 'full') {
 54 |         notesCount++
 55 |       }
 56 |     })
 57 | 
 58 |     return {
 59 |       sourcesInsights,
 60 |       sourcesFull,
 61 |       notesCount,
 62 |       tokenCount: chat.tokenCount,
 63 |       charCount: chat.charCount
 64 |     }
 65 |   }, [sources, notes, contextSelections, chat.tokenCount, chat.charCount])
 66 | 
 67 |   // Show loading state while sources/notes are being fetched
 68 |   if (sourcesLoading || notesLoading) {
 69 |     return (
 70 |       <Card className="h-full flex flex-col">
 71 |         <CardContent className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
 72 |           <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
 73 |         </CardContent>
 74 |       </Card>
 75 |     )
 76 |   }
 77 | 
 78 |   // Show error state if data fetch failed (unlikely but good to handle)
 79 |   if (!sources && !notes) {
 80 |     return (
 81 |       <Card className="h-full flex flex-col">
 82 |         <CardContent className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
 83 |           <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground">
 84 |             <AlertCircle className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
 85 |             <p className="text-sm">{t.chat.unableToLoadChat}</p>
 86 |             <p className="text-xs mt-2">{t.common.refreshPage || 'Please try refreshing the page'}</p>
 87 |           </div>
 88 |         </CardContent>
 89 |       </Card>
 90 |     )
 91 |   }
 92 | 
 93 |   return (
 94 |     <ChatPanel
 95 |       title={t.chat.chatWithNotebook}
 96 |       contextType="notebook"
 97 |       messages={chat.messages}
 98 |       isStreaming={chat.isSending}
 99 |       contextIndicators={null}
100 |       onSendMessage={(message, modelOverride) => chat.sendMessage(message, modelOverride)}
101 |       modelOverride={chat.currentSession?.model_override ?? chat.pendingModelOverride ?? undefined}
102 |       onModelChange={(model) => chat.setModelOverride(model ?? null)}
103 |       sessions={chat.sessions}
104 |       currentSessionId={chat.currentSessionId}
105 |       onCreateSession={(title) => chat.createSession(title)}
106 |       onSelectSession={chat.switchSession}
107 |       onUpdateSession={(sessionId, title) => chat.updateSession(sessionId, { title })}
108 |       onDeleteSession={chat.deleteSession}
109 |       loadingSessions={chat.loadingSessions}
110 |       notebookContextStats={contextStats}
111 |       notebookId={notebookId}
112 |     />
113 |   )
114 | }
115 |

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
  4 | 
  5 | import { AppShell } from '@/components/layout/AppShell'
  6 | import { NotebookList } from './components/NotebookList'
  7 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
  8 | import { Plus, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'
  9 | import { useNotebooks } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notebooks'
 10 | import { CreateNotebookDialog } from '@/components/notebooks/CreateNotebookDialog'
 11 | import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
 12 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 13 | 
 14 | export default function NotebooksPage() {
 15 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 16 |   const [createDialogOpen, setCreateDialogOpen] = useState(false)
 17 |   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('')
 18 |   const { data: notebooks, isLoading, refetch } = useNotebooks(false)
 19 |   const { data: archivedNotebooks } = useNotebooks(true)
 20 | 
 21 |   const normalizedQuery = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase()
 22 | 
 23 |   const filteredActive = useMemo(() => {
 24 |     if (!notebooks) {
 25 |       return undefined
 26 |     }
 27 |     if (!normalizedQuery) {
 28 |       return notebooks
 29 |     }
 30 |     return notebooks.filter((notebook) =>
 31 |       notebook.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
 32 |     )
 33 |   }, [notebooks, normalizedQuery])
 34 | 
 35 |   const filteredArchived = useMemo(() => {
 36 |     if (!archivedNotebooks) {
 37 |       return undefined
 38 |     }
 39 |     if (!normalizedQuery) {
 40 |       return archivedNotebooks
 41 |     }
 42 |     return archivedNotebooks.filter((notebook) =>
 43 |       notebook.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
 44 |     )
 45 |   }, [archivedNotebooks, normalizedQuery])
 46 | 
 47 |   const hasArchived = (archivedNotebooks?.length ?? 0) > 0
 48 |   const isSearching = normalizedQuery.length > 0
 49 | 
 50 |   return (
 51 |     <AppShell>
 52 |       <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
 53 |         <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
 54 |         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 55 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
 56 |             <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{t.notebooks.title}</h1>
 57 |             <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => refetch()}>
 58 |               <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
 59 |             </Button>
 60 |           </div>
 61 |           <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-4">
 62 |             <Input
 63 |               id="notebook-search"
 64 |               name="notebook-search"
 65 |               value={searchTerm}
 66 |               onChange={(event) => setSearchTerm(event.target.value)}
 67 |               placeholder={t.notebooks.searchPlaceholder}
 68 |               autoComplete="off"
 69 |               aria-label={t.common.accessibility?.searchNotebooks || "Search notebooks"}
 70 |               className="w-full sm:w-64"
 71 |             />
 72 |             <Button onClick={() => setCreateDialogOpen(true)}>
 73 |               <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
 74 |               {t.notebooks.newNotebook}
 75 |             </Button>
 76 |           </div>
 77 |         </div>
 78 |         
 79 |         <div className="space-y-8">
 80 |           <NotebookList 
 81 |             notebooks={filteredActive} 
 82 |             isLoading={isLoading}
 83 |             title={t.notebooks.activeNotebooks}
 84 |             emptyTitle={isSearching ? t.common.noMatches : undefined}
 85 |             emptyDescription={isSearching ? t.common.tryDifferentSearch : undefined}
 86 |             onAction={!isSearching ? () => setCreateDialogOpen(true) : undefined}
 87 |             actionLabel={!isSearching ? t.notebooks.newNotebook : undefined}
 88 |           />
 89 |           
 90 |           {hasArchived && (
 91 |             <NotebookList 
 92 |               notebooks={filteredArchived} 
 93 |               isLoading={false}
 94 |               title={t.notebooks.archivedNotebooks}
 95 |               collapsible
 96 |               emptyTitle={isSearching ? t.common.noMatches : undefined}
 97 |               emptyDescription={isSearching ? t.common.tryDifferentSearch : undefined}
 98 |             />
 99 |           )}
100 |         </div>
101 |         </div>
102 |       </div>
103 | 
104 |       <CreateNotebookDialog
105 |         open={createDialogOpen}
106 |         onOpenChange={setCreateDialogOpen}
107 |       />
108 |     </AppShell>
109 |   )
110 | }
111 |

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
  4 | import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card'
  5 | import { getConfig } from '@/lib/config'
  6 | import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
  7 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
  8 | 
  9 | export function SystemInfo() {
 10 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 11 |   const [config, setConfig] = useState<{
 12 |     version: string
 13 |     latestVersion?: string | null
 14 |     hasUpdate?: boolean
 15 |   } | null>(null)
 16 |   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
 17 | 
 18 |   useEffect(() => {
 19 |     const loadConfig = async () => {
 20 |       try {
 21 |         const cfg = await getConfig()
 22 |         setConfig(cfg)
 23 |       } catch (error) {
 24 |         console.error('Failed to load config:', error)
 25 |       } finally {
 26 |         setIsLoading(false)
 27 |       }
 28 |     }
 29 | 
 30 |     loadConfig()
 31 |   }, [])
 32 | 
 33 |   if (isLoading) {
 34 |     return (
 35 |       <Card className="p-6">
 36 |         <div className="space-y-4">
 37 |           <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t.advanced.systemInfo}</h2>
 38 |           <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t.common.loading}</div>
 39 |         </div>
 40 |       </Card>
 41 |     )
 42 |   }
 43 | 
 44 |   return (
 45 |     <Card className="p-6">
 46 |       <div className="space-y-4">
 47 |         <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t.advanced.systemInfo}</h2>
 48 | 
 49 |         <div className="space-y-3">
 50 |           {/* Current Version */}
 51 |           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 52 |             <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t.advanced.currentVersion}</span>
 53 |             <Badge variant="outline">{config?.version || t.advanced.unknown}</Badge>
 54 |           </div>
 55 | 
 56 |           {/* Latest Version */}
 57 |           {config?.latestVersion && (
 58 |             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 59 |               <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t.advanced.latestVersion}</span>
 60 |               <Badge variant="outline">{config.latestVersion}</Badge>
 61 |             </div>
 62 |           )}
 63 | 
 64 |           {/* Update Status */}
 65 |           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 66 |             <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t.advanced.status}</span>
 67 |             {config?.hasUpdate ? (
 68 |               <Badge variant="destructive">
 69 |                 {t.advanced.updateAvailable.replace('{version}', config.latestVersion || '')}
 70 |               </Badge>
 71 |             ) : config?.latestVersion ? (
 72 |               <Badge variant="outline" className="text-green-600 border-green-600">
 73 |                 {t.advanced.upToDate}
 74 |               </Badge>
 75 |             ) : (
 76 |               <Badge variant="outline" className="text-muted-foreground">
 77 |                 {t.advanced.unknown}
 78 |               </Badge>
 79 |             )}
 80 |           </div>
 81 | 
 82 |           {/* GitHub Repository Link */}
 83 |           {config?.hasUpdate && (
 84 |             <div className="pt-2 border-t">
 85 |               <a
 86 |                 href="https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook"
 87 |                 target="_blank"
 88 |                 rel="noopener noreferrer"
 89 |                 className="text-sm text-primary hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1"
 90 |               >
 91 |                 {t.advanced.viewOnGithub}
 92 |                 <svg
 93 |                   className="w-4 h-4"
 94 |                   fill="none"
 95 |                   stroke="currentColor"
 96 |                   viewBox="0 0 24 24"
 97 |                 >
 98 |                   <path
 99 |                     strokeLinecap="round"
100 |                     strokeLinejoin="round"
101 |                     strokeWidth={2}
102 |                     d="M10 6H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-4M14 4h6m0 0v6m0-6L10 14"
103 |                   />
104 |                 </svg>
105 |               </a>
106 |             </div>
107 |           )}
108 | 
109 |           {/* Version Check Failed Message */}
110 |           {!config?.latestVersion && config?.version && (
111 |             <div className="pt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
112 |               {t.advanced.updateCheckFailed}
113 |             </div>
114 |           )}
115 |         </div>
116 |       </div>
117 |     </Card>
118 |   )

/frontend/src/components/sources/README.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # AddSourceDialog Component
  2 | 
  3 | The `AddSourceDialog` component provides a comprehensive interface for adding new sources to notebooks with async processing support.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Features
  6 | 
  7 | - **Multi-type source support**: Links, file uploads, and text content
  8 | - **Multi-notebook selection**: Add sources to multiple notebooks simultaneously  
  9 | - **Transformations**: Apply transformations during source processing
 10 | - **Async processing**: Background processing with status monitoring
 11 | - **Form validation**: Comprehensive validation with Zod and React Hook Form
 12 | - **File upload support**: Handle file uploads with progress indicators
 13 | - **Responsive design**: Works well on desktop and mobile
 14 | 
 15 | ## Usage
 16 | 
 17 | ### Basic Usage
 18 | 
 19 | ```tsx
 20 | import { AddSourceDialog } from '@/components/sources'
 21 | 
 22 | function MyComponent() {
 23 |   const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false)
 24 | 
 25 |   return (
 26 |     <>
 27 |       <button onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>
 28 |         Add Source
 29 |       </button>
 30 |       
 31 |       <AddSourceDialog
 32 |         open={dialogOpen}
 33 |         onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
 34 |       />
 35 |     </>
 36 |   )
 37 | }
 38 | ```
 39 | 
 40 | ### With Default Notebook
 41 | 
 42 | ```tsx
 43 | <AddSourceDialog
 44 |   open={dialogOpen}
 45 |   onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
 46 |   defaultNotebookId="notebook:123"
 47 | />
 48 | ```
 49 | 
 50 | ### Using the Button Component
 51 | 
 52 | ```tsx
 53 | import { AddSourceButton } from '@/components/sources'
 54 | 
 55 | function MyComponent() {
 56 |   return (
 57 |     <AddSourceButton 
 58 |       defaultNotebookId="notebook:123"
 59 |       variant="outline"
 60 |       size="sm"
 61 |     />
 62 |   )
 63 | }
 64 | ```
 65 | 
 66 | ## Props
 67 | 
 68 | ### AddSourceDialog
 69 | 
 70 | | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
 71 | |------|------|---------|-------------|
 72 | | `open` | `boolean` | - | Controls dialog visibility |
 73 | | `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | - | Called when dialog should open/close |
 74 | | `defaultNotebookId` | `string` | - | Pre-select a notebook |
 75 | 
 76 | ### AddSourceButton
 77 | 
 78 | | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
 79 | |------|------|---------|-------------|
 80 | | `defaultNotebookId` | `string` | - | Pre-select a notebook in dialog |
 81 | | `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost'` | `'default'` | Button styling variant |
 82 | | `size` | `'sm' \| 'default' \| 'lg'` | `'default'` | Button size |
 83 | | `className` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes |
 84 | 
 85 | ## Source Types
 86 | 
 87 | ### Link Sources
 88 | - Requires a valid URL
 89 | - Automatically extracts content from web pages
 90 | - Supports most web content formats
 91 | 
 92 | ### File Upload Sources  
 93 | - Supports: PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MD, EPUB
 94 | - Handles large files with async processing
 95 | - Shows upload progress
 96 | 
 97 | ### Text Sources
 98 | - Direct text input
 99 | - Useful for pasting content
100 | - Supports markdown formatting
101 | 
102 | ## Processing Options
103 | 
104 | ### Embedding
105 | - **Enabled by default**: Makes sources searchable via vector search
106 | - **Disable for**: Sources you don't want in search results
107 | 
108 | ### Async Processing (Recommended)
109 | - **Default**: Background processing for better UX
110 | - **Benefits**: Non-blocking, handles large files, progress monitoring
111 | - **Disable for**: Small sources that need immediate processing
112 | 
113 | ## Integration with Hooks
114 | 
115 | The component integrates with several custom hooks:
116 | 
117 | - `useNotebooks()` - Fetches available notebooks
118 | - `useTransformations()` - Fetches available transformations  
119 | - `useCreateSource()` - Handles source creation
120 | - `useSourceStatus()` - Monitors processing status
121 | 
122 | ## Error Handling
123 | 
124 | The component includes comprehensive error handling:
125 | 
126 | - Form validation errors are shown inline
127 | - Network errors show toast notifications
128 | - File upload errors are handled gracefully
129 | - Processing errors are displayed with retry options
130 | 
131 | ## Accessibility
132 | 
133 | - Full keyboard navigation support
134 | - Screen reader friendly
135 | - ARIA labels and descriptions
136 | - Focus management
137 | 
138 | ## Dependencies
139 | 
140 | - React Hook Form for form handling
141 | - Zod for validation
142 | - TanStack Query for data fetching
143 | - shadcn/ui for components
144 | - Lucide React for icons

/frontend/src/lib/hooks/CLAUDE.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | # Hooks Module
 2 | 
 3 | React hooks for API data fetching, state management, and complex workflows (chat, streaming, file handling).
 4 | 
 5 | ## Key Components
 6 | 
 7 | - **Query hooks** (`useNotebookSources`, `useSource`, `useSources`): TanStack Query wrappers for source data with infinite scroll and refetch strategies
 8 | - **Mutation hooks** (`useCreateSource`, `useUpdateSource`, `useDeleteSource`, `useFileUpload`, `useRetrySource`): Server mutations with toast notifications and cache invalidation
 9 | - **Chat hooks** (`useNotebookChat`, `useSourceChat`): Complex session management, context building, and message streaming
10 | - **Streaming hooks** (`useAsk`): SSE parsing for multi-stage Ask workflows (strategy → answers → final answer)
11 | - **Model/config hooks** (`useModels`, `useSettings`, `useTransformations`): Application-level settings and model management
12 | - **Utility hooks** (`useMediaQuery`, `useToast`, `useNavigation`, `useAuth`): UI state and auth checking
13 | - **i18n hook** (`useTranslation`): Proxy-based translation access with `t.section.key` pattern and language switching
14 | 
15 | ## Important Patterns
16 | 
17 | - **TanStack Query integration**: All data hooks use `useQuery`/`useMutation` with `QUERY_KEYS` for cache consistency
18 | - **Optimistic updates**: Mutations add local state before server response (e.g., notebook chat messages)
19 | - **Cache invalidation**: Broad invalidation of query keys on mutations (e.g., `['sources']` catches all source queries)
20 | - **Auto-refetch on return**: `refetchOnWindowFocus: true` on frequently-changing data (sources, notebooks)
21 | - **Manual refetch controls**: Hooks return `refetch()` for parent components to trigger refresh
22 | - **SSE streaming pattern**: `useAsk` manually parses newline-delimited JSON from `/api/search/ask`; handles incomplete buffers
23 | - **Status polling**: `useSourceStatus` auto-refetches every 2s while `status === 'running' | 'queued' | 'new'`
24 | - **Context building**: `useNotebookChat.buildContext()` assembles selected sources + notes with token/char counts
25 | - **i18n Proxy pattern**: `useTranslation` returns `t` object with Proxy; access `t.section.key` instead of `t('section.key')`
26 | 
27 | ## Key Dependencies
28 | 
29 | - `@tanstack/react-query`: Data fetching and caching
30 | - `sonner`: Toast notifications
31 | - `@/lib/api/*`: API module exports (sourcesApi, chatApi, searchApi, etc.)
32 | - `@/lib/types/api`: TypeScript response types
33 | - Zustand stores: `useAuthStore`, modal managers
34 | 
35 | ## How to Add New Hooks
36 | 
37 | 1. **Data queries**: Create `useQuery` hook wrapping API call; use `QUERY_KEYS.entityName(id)` for cache key
38 | 2. **Mutations**: Create `useMutation` hook with `onSuccess` cache invalidation + toast feedback
39 | 3. **Complex state**: Use `useState` + callbacks for local state (see `useAsk`, `useNotebookChat`)
40 | 4. **Return shape**: Export object with both state and action functions for composability
41 | 
42 | ## Important Quirks & Gotchas
43 | 
44 | - **Cache invalidation breadth**: Invalidating `['sources']` affects ALL source queries; be precise if performance matters
45 | - **Optimistic updates + error handling**: `useNotebookChat` removes optimistic messages on error; ensure cleanup
46 | - **SSE buffer handling**: `useAsk` keeps incomplete lines in buffer between reads; incomplete JSON silently skipped
47 | - **Model override timing**: `useNotebookChat` stores pending model override if no session exists; applied on session creation
48 | - **Pagination cursor**: `useNotebookSources` uses offset-based pagination; `nextOffset` calculated from page size
49 | - **Status polling race**: `useSourceStatus` may refetch stale data before server catches up; retry logic has 3-attempt limit
50 | - **Keyboard trap in dialogs**: Some hooks manage modal state; ensure Dialog/Modal components handle escape key properly
51 | - **Form data handling**: `useFileUpload` and source creation convert JSON fields to strings in FormData
52 | - **useTranslation depth limit**: Proxy limits nesting to 4 levels; deeper access returns path string as fallback
53 | - **useTranslation loop detection**: >1000 accesses to same key in 1s triggers error and breaks recursion
54 | 
55 | ## Testing Patterns
56 | 
57 | ```typescript
58 | // Mock API
59 | const mockApi = {
60 |   list: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([...])
61 | }
62 | 
63 | // Test hook with QueryClientProvider + wrapper
64 | render(<Component />, { wrapper: QueryClientProvider })
65 | 
66 | // Assert mutations trigger cache invalidation
67 | await waitFor(() => expect(queryClient.invalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalled())
68 | ```
69 |

 17 | // Helper function to format large numbers with K/M suffixes
 18 | function formatNumber(num: number): string {
 19 |   if (num >= 1000000) {
 20 |     return `${(num / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`
 21 |   }
 22 |   if (num >= 1000) {
 23 |     return `${(num / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`
 24 |   }
 25 |   return num.toString()
 26 | }

100 |

109 |           {charCount !== undefined && charCount > 0 && (

111 |           )}
112 |         </div>
113 |       )}
114 |     </div>
115 |   )

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useId, type RefObject } from 'react'
  4 | import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
  5 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
  6 | 
  7 | interface InlineEditProps {
  8 |   value: string
  9 |   onSave: (value: string) => void | Promise<void>
 10 |   className?: string
 11 |   inputClassName?: string
 12 |   placeholder?: string
 13 |   multiline?: boolean
 14 |   emptyText?: string
 15 |   id?: string
 16 |   name?: string
 17 |   autocomplete?: string
 18 | }
 19 | 
 20 | export function InlineEdit({
 21 |   value,
 22 |   onSave,
 23 |   className,
 24 |   inputClassName,
 25 |   placeholder,
 26 |   multiline = false,
 27 |   emptyText,
 28 |   id: providedId,
 29 |   name,
 30 |   autocomplete = 'off'
 31 | }: InlineEditProps) {
 32 |   const generatedId = useId()
 33 |   const id = providedId || generatedId
 34 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 35 |   const defaultEmptyText = emptyText || t.common.clickToEdit
 36 |   const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false)
 37 |   const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value)
 38 |   const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false)
 39 |   const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>(null)
 40 | 
 41 |   useEffect(() => {
 42 |     if (isEditing && inputRef.current) {
 43 |       inputRef.current.focus()
 44 |       inputRef.current.select()
 45 |     }
 46 |   }, [isEditing])
 47 | 
 48 |   useEffect(() => {
 49 |     setEditValue(value)
 50 |   }, [value])
 51 | 
 52 |   const handleSave = async () => {
 53 |     if (editValue.trim() === value.trim()) {
 54 |       setIsEditing(false)
 55 |       return
 56 |     }
 57 | 
 58 |     setIsSaving(true)
 59 |     try {
 60 |       await onSave(editValue.trim())
 61 |       setIsEditing(false)
 62 |     } catch {
 63 |       // Reset on error
 64 |       setEditValue(value)
 65 |     } finally {
 66 |       setIsSaving(false)
 67 |     }
 68 |   }
 69 | 
 70 |   const handleCancel = () => {
 71 |     setEditValue(value)
 72 |     setIsEditing(false)
 73 |   }
 74 | 
 75 |   const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
 76 |     if (e.key === 'Enter' && !multiline) {
 77 |       e.preventDefault()
 78 |       handleSave()
 79 |     } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
 80 |       e.preventDefault()
 81 |       handleCancel()
 82 |     }
 83 |   }
 84 | 
 85 |   if (!isEditing) {
 86 |     return (
 87 |       <button
 88 |         type="button"
 89 |         className={cn(
 90 |           "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1 -mx-2 -my-1 transition-colors text-left w-full",
 91 |           className
 92 |         )}
 93 |         onClick={(e) => {
 94 |           e.preventDefault()
 95 |           e.stopPropagation()
 96 |           setIsEditing(true)
 97 |         }}
 98 |       >
 99 |         {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground">{defaultEmptyText}</span>}
100 |       </button>
101 |     )
102 |   }
103 | 
104 |   if (multiline) {
105 |     return (
106 |       <textarea
107 |         ref={inputRef as RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement>}
108 |         value={editValue}
109 |         onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
110 |         onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
111 |         onBlur={() => {
112 |           if (!isSaving && editValue.trim() !== value.trim()) {
113 |             handleSave()
114 |           } else if (editValue.trim() === value.trim()) {
115 |             setIsEditing(false)
116 |           }
117 |         }}
118 |         className={cn(
119 |           "px-2 py-1 bg-background border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary w-full",
120 |           "min-h-[60px] resize-none",
121 |           inputClassName
122 |         )}
123 |         placeholder={placeholder}
124 |         disabled={isSaving}
125 |         id={id}
126 |         name={name}
127 |         autoComplete={autocomplete}
128 |       />
129 |     )
130 |   }
131 | 
132 |   return (
133 |     <input
134 |       ref={inputRef as RefObject<HTMLInputElement>}
135 |       value={editValue}
136 |       onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
137 |       onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
138 |       onBlur={() => {
139 |         if (!isSaving && editValue.trim() !== value.trim()) {
140 |           handleSave()
141 |         } else if (editValue.trim() === value.trim()) {
142 |           setIsEditing(false)
143 |         }
144 |       }}
145 |       className={cn(
146 |         "px-2 py-1 bg-background border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary w-full",
147 |         inputClassName
148 |       )}
149 |       placeholder={placeholder}
150 |       disabled={isSaving}
151 |       id={id}
152 |       name={name}
153 |       autoComplete={autocomplete}
154 |     />
155 |   )
156 | }

/docs/0-START-HERE/quick-start-openai.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # Quick Start - OpenAI (5 minutes)
  2 | 
  3 | Get Open Notebook running with OpenAI's GPT models. Fast, powerful, and simple.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Prerequisites
  6 | 
  7 | 1. **Docker Desktop** installed
  8 |    - [Download here](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/)
  9 |    - Already have it? Skip to step 2
 10 | 
 11 | 2. **OpenAI API Key** (required)
 12 |    - Go to https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
 13 |    - Create account → Create new secret key
 14 |    - Add at least $5 in credits to your account
 15 |    - Copy the key (starts with `sk-`)
 16 | 
 17 | ## Step 1: Create Configuration (1 min)
 18 | 
 19 | Create a new folder `open-notebook` and add this file:
 20 | 
 21 | **docker-compose.yml**:
 22 | ```yaml
 23 | services:
 24 |   surrealdb:
 25 |     image: surrealdb/surrealdb:v2
 26 |     command: start --user root --pass password --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 rocksdb:/mydata/mydatabase.db
 27 |     ports:
 28 |       - "8000:8000"
 29 |     volumes:
 30 |       - ./surreal_data:/mydata
 31 | 
 32 |   open_notebook:
 33 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest
 34 |     pull_policy: always
 35 |     ports:
 36 |       - "8502:8502"  # Web UI
 37 |       - "5055:5055"  # API
 38 |     environment:
 39 |       # Your OpenAI key
 40 |       - OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
 41 | 
 42 |       # Database (required)
 43 |       - SURREAL_URL=ws://surrealdb:8000/rpc
 44 |       - SURREAL_USER=root
 45 |       - SURREAL_PASSWORD=password
 46 |       - SURREAL_NAMESPACE=open_notebook
 47 |       - SURREAL_DATABASE=open_notebook
 48 |     volumes:
 49 |       - ./notebook_data:/app/data
 50 |     depends_on:
 51 |       - surrealdb
 52 |     restart: always
 53 | 
 54 | ```
 55 | 
 56 | **Edit the file:**
 57 | - Replace `sk-...` with your actual OpenAI API key
 58 | 
 59 | ---
 60 | 
 61 | ## Step 2: Start Services (1 min)
 62 | 
 63 | Open terminal in your `open-notebook` folder:
 64 | 
 65 | ```bash
 66 | docker compose up -d
 67 | ```
 68 | 
 69 | Wait 15-20 seconds for services to start.
 70 | 
 71 | ---
 72 | 
 73 | ## Step 3: Access Open Notebook (instant)
 74 | 
 75 | Open your browser:
 76 | ```
 77 | http://localhost:8502
 78 | ```
 79 | 
 80 | You should see the Open Notebook interface!
 81 | 
 82 | ---
 83 | 
 84 | ## Step 4: Create Your First Notebook (1 min)
 85 | 
 86 | 1. Click **New Notebook**
 87 | 2. Name: "My Research"
 88 | 3. Click **Create**
 89 | 
 90 | ---
 91 | 
 92 | ## Step 5: Add a Source (1 min)
 93 | 
 94 | 1. Click **Add Source**
 95 | 2. Choose **Web Link**
 96 | 3. Paste: `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence`
 97 | 4. Click **Add**
 98 | 5. Wait for processing (30-60 seconds)
 99 | 
100 | ---
101 | 
102 | ## Step 6: Chat With Your Content (1 min)
103 | 
104 | 1. Go to **Chat**
105 | 2. Type: "What is artificial intelligence?"
106 | 3. Click **Send**
107 | 4. Watch as GPT responds with information from your source!
108 | 
109 | ---
110 | 
111 | ## Verification Checklist
112 | 
113 | - [ ] Docker is running
114 | - [ ] You can access `http://localhost:8502`
115 | - [ ] You created a notebook
116 | - [ ] You added a source
117 | - [ ] Chat works
118 | 
119 | **All checked?** 🎉 You have a fully working AI research assistant!
120 | 
121 | ---
122 | 
123 | ## Using Different Models
124 | 
125 | In your notebook, go to **Settings** → **Models** to choose:
126 | - `gpt-4o` - Best quality (recommended)
127 | - `gpt-4o-mini` - Fast and cheap (good for testing)
128 | 
129 | ---
130 | 
131 | ## Troubleshooting
132 | 
133 | ### "Port 8502 already in use"
134 | 
135 | Change the port in docker-compose.yml:
136 | ```yaml
137 | ports:
138 |   - "8503:8502"  # Use 8503 instead
139 | ```
140 | 
141 | Then access at `http://localhost:8503`
142 | 
143 | ### "API key not working"
144 | 
145 | 1. Double-check your API key (no extra spaces)
146 | 2. Verify you added credits at https://platform.openai.com
147 | 3. Restart: `docker compose restart api`
148 | 
149 | ### "Cannot connect to server"
150 | 
151 | ```bash
152 | docker ps  # Check all services running
153 | docker compose logs  # View logs
154 | docker compose restart  # Restart everything
155 | ```
156 | 
157 | ---
158 | 
159 | ## Next Steps
160 | 
161 | 1. **Add Your Own Content**: PDFs, web links, documents
162 | 2. **Explore Features**: Podcasts, transformations, search
163 | 3. **Full Documentation**: [See all features](../3-USER-GUIDE/index.md)
164 | 
165 | ---
166 | 
167 | ## Cost Estimate
168 | 
169 | OpenAI pricing (approximate):
170 | - **Conversation**: $0.01-0.10 per 1K tokens
171 | - **Embeddings**: $0.02 per 1M tokens
172 | - **Typical usage**: $1-5/month for light use, $20-50/month for heavy use
173 | 
174 | Check https://openai.com/pricing for current rates.
175 | 
176 | ---
177 | 
178 | **Need help?** Join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/37XJPXfz2w)!
179 |
