/open_notebook/utils/text_utils.py:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | """
  2 | Text utilities for Open Notebook.
  3 | Extracted from main utils to avoid circular imports.
  4 | """
  5 | 
  6 | import re
  7 | import unicodedata
  8 | from typing import Tuple
  9 | 
 10 | # Patterns for matching thinking content in AI responses
 11 | # Standard pattern: <think>...</think>
 12 | THINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r"<think>(.*?)</think>", re.DOTALL)
 13 | # Pattern for malformed output: content</think> (missing opening tag)
 14 | THINK_PATTERN_NO_OPEN = re.compile(r"^(.*?)</think>", re.DOTALL)
 15 | 
 16 | 
 17 | def remove_non_ascii(text: str) -> str:
 18 |     """Remove non-ASCII characters from text."""
 19 |     return re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F]+", "", text)
 20 | 
 21 | 
 22 | def remove_non_printable(text: str) -> str:
 23 |     """Remove non-printable characters from text."""
 24 |     # Replace any special Unicode whitespace characters with a regular space
 25 |     text = re.sub(r"[\u2000-\u200B\u202F\u205F\u3000]", " ", text)
 26 | 
 27 |     # Replace unusual line terminators with a single newline
 28 |     text = re.sub(r"[\u2028\u2029\r]", "\n", text)
 29 | 
 30 |     # Remove control characters, except newlines and tabs
 31 |     text = "".join(
 32 |         char for char in text if unicodedata.category(char)[0] != "C" or char in "\n\t"
 33 |     )
 34 | 
 35 |     # Replace non-breaking spaces with regular spaces
 36 |     text = text.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()
 37 | 
 38 |     # Keep letters (including accented ones), numbers, spaces, newlines, tabs, and basic punctuation
 39 |     return re.sub(r"[^\w\s.,!?\-\n\t]", "", text, flags=re.UNICODE)
 40 | 
 41 | 
 42 | def parse_thinking_content(content: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
 43 |     """
 44 |     Parse message content to extract thinking content from <think> tags.
 45 | 
 46 |     Handles both well-formed tags and malformed output where the opening
 47 |     <think> tag is missing but </think> is present.
 48 | 
 49 |     Args:
 50 |         content (str): The original message content
 51 | 
 52 |     Returns:
 53 |         Tuple[str, str]: (thinking_content, cleaned_content)
 54 |             - thinking_content: Content from within <think> tags
 55 |             - cleaned_content: Original content with <think> blocks removed
 56 | 
 57 |     Example:
 58 |         >>> content = "<think>Let me analyze this</think>Here's my answer"
 59 |         >>> thinking, cleaned = parse_thinking_content(content)
 60 |         >>> print(thinking)
 61 |         "Let me analyze this"
 62 |         >>> print(cleaned)
 63 |         "Here's my answer"
 64 |     """
 65 |     # Input validation
 66 |     if not isinstance(content, str):
 67 |         return "", str(content) if content is not None else ""
 68 | 
 69 |     # Limit processing for very large content (100KB limit)
 70 |     if len(content) > 100000:
 71 |         return "", content
 72 | 
 73 |     # Find all well-formed thinking blocks
 74 |     thinking_matches = THINK_PATTERN.findall(content)
 75 | 
 76 |     if thinking_matches:
 77 |         # Join all thinking content with double newlines
 78 |         thinking_content = "\n\n".join(match.strip() for match in thinking_matches)
 79 | 
 80 |         # Remove all <think>...</think> blocks from the original content
 81 |         cleaned_content = THINK_PATTERN.sub("", content)
 82 | 
 83 |         # Clean up extra whitespace
 84 |         cleaned_content = re.sub(r"\n\s*\n\s*\n", "\n\n", cleaned_content).strip()
 85 | 
 86 |         return thinking_content, cleaned_content
 87 | 
 88 |     # Handle malformed output: content</think> (missing opening tag)
 89 |     # Some models like Nemotron output thinking without the opening <think> tag
 90 |     malformed_match = THINK_PATTERN_NO_OPEN.match(content)
 91 |     if malformed_match:
 92 |         thinking_content = malformed_match.group(1).strip()
 93 |         # Remove the thinking content and </think> tag
 94 |         cleaned_content = content[malformed_match.end() :].strip()
 95 |         return thinking_content, cleaned_content
 96 | 
 97 |     return "", content
 98 | 
 99 | 
100 | def clean_thinking_content(content: str) -> str:
101 |     """
102 |     Remove thinking content from AI responses, returning only the cleaned content.
103 | 
104 |     This is a convenience function for cases where you only need the cleaned
105 |     content and don't need access to the thinking process.
106 | 
107 |     Args:
108 |         content (str): The original message content with potential <think> tags
109 | 
110 |     Returns:
111 |         str: Content with <think> blocks removed and whitespace cleaned
112 | 
113 |     Example:
114 |         >>> content = "<think>Let me think...</think>Here's the answer"
115 |         >>> clean_thinking_content(content)
116 |         "Here's the answer"
117 |     """
118 |     _, cleaned_content = parse_thinking_content(content)
119 |     return cleaned_content
120 |

  1 | from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
  2 | from loguru import logger
  3 | 
  4 | from api.command_service import CommandService
  5 | from api.models import EmbedRequest, EmbedResponse
  6 | from open_notebook.ai.models import model_manager
  7 | from open_notebook.domain.notebook import Note, Source
  8 | 
  9 | router = APIRouter()
 10 | 
 11 | 
 12 | @router.post("/embed", response_model=EmbedResponse)
 13 | async def embed_content(embed_request: EmbedRequest):
 14 |     """Embed content for vector search."""
 15 |     try:
 16 |         # Check if embedding model is available
 17 |         if not await model_manager.get_embedding_model():
 18 |             raise HTTPException(
 19 |                 status_code=400,
 20 |                 detail="No embedding model configured. Please configure one in the Models section.",
 21 |             )
 22 | 
 23 |         item_id = embed_request.item_id
 24 |         item_type = embed_request.item_type.lower()
 25 | 
 26 |         # Validate item type
 27 |         if item_type not in ["source", "note"]:
 28 |             raise HTTPException(
 29 |                 status_code=400, detail="Item type must be either 'source' or 'note'"
 30 |             )
 31 | 
 32 |         # Branch based on processing mode
 33 |         if embed_request.async_processing:
 34 |             # ASYNC PATH: Submit command for background processing
 35 |             logger.info(f"Using async processing for {item_type} {item_id}")
 36 | 
 37 |             try:
 38 |                 # Import commands to ensure they're registered
 39 |                 import commands.embedding_commands  # noqa: F401
 40 | 
 41 |                 # Submit type-specific command
 42 |                 if item_type == "source":
 43 |                     command_name = "embed_source"
 44 |                     command_input = {"source_id": item_id}
 45 |                 else:  # note
 46 |                     command_name = "embed_note"
 47 |                     command_input = {"note_id": item_id}
 48 | 
 49 |                 command_id = await CommandService.submit_command_job(
 50 |                     "open_notebook",
 51 |                     command_name,
 52 |                     command_input,
 53 |                 )
 54 | 
 55 |                 logger.info(f"Submitted async {command_name} command: {command_id}")
 56 | 
 57 |                 return EmbedResponse(
 58 |                     success=True,
 59 |                     message="Embedding queued for background processing",
 60 |                     item_id=item_id,
 61 |                     item_type=item_type,
 62 |                     command_id=command_id,
 63 |                 )
 64 | 
 65 |             except Exception as e:
 66 |                 logger.error(f"Failed to submit async embedding command: {e}")
 67 |                 raise HTTPException(
 68 |                     status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to queue embedding: {str(e)}"
 69 |                 )
 70 | 
 71 |         else:
 72 |             # DOMAIN MODEL PATH: Submit job via domain model convenience methods
 73 |             # These methods internally call submit_command() - still fire-and-forget
 74 |             logger.info(f"Using domain model path for {item_type} {item_id}")
 75 | 
 76 |             command_id = None
 77 | 
 78 |             # Get the item and submit embedding job
 79 |             if item_type == "source":
 80 |                 source_item = await Source.get(item_id)
 81 |                 if not source_item:
 82 |                     raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Source not found")
 83 | 
 84 |                 # Submit embed_source job (returns command_id for tracking)
 85 |                 command_id = await source_item.vectorize()
 86 |                 message = "Source embedding job submitted"
 87 | 
 88 |             elif item_type == "note":
 89 |                 note_item = await Note.get(item_id)
 90 |                 if not note_item:
 91 |                     raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Note not found")
 92 | 
 93 |                 # Note.save() internally submits embed_note command and returns command_id
 94 |                 command_id = await note_item.save()
 95 |                 message = "Note embedding job submitted"
 96 | 
 97 |             return EmbedResponse(
 98 |                 success=True,
 99 |                 message=message,
100 |                 item_id=item_id,
101 |                 item_type=item_type,
102 |                 command_id=command_id,
103 |             )
104 | 
105 |     except HTTPException:
106 |         raise
107 |     except Exception as e:
108 |         logger.error(
109 |             f"Error embedding {embed_request.item_type} {embed_request.item_id}: {str(e)}"
110 |         )
111 |         raise HTTPException(
112 |             status_code=500, detail=f"Error embedding content: {str(e)}"
113 |         )
114 |

 13 | class EpisodeProfilesService:
 14 |     """Service layer for episode profiles operations using API."""
 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self):
 17 |         logger.info("Using API for episode profiles operations")
 18 | 
 19 |     def get_all_episode_profiles(self) -> List[EpisodeProfile]:
 20 |         """Get all episode profiles."""
 21 |         profiles_data = api_client.get_episode_profiles()
 22 |         # Convert API response to EpisodeProfile objects
 23 |         profiles = []
 24 |         for profile_data in profiles_data:
 25 |             profile = EpisodeProfile(
 26 |                 name=profile_data["name"],
 27 |                 description=profile_data.get("description", ""),
 28 |                 speaker_config=profile_data["speaker_config"],
 29 |                 outline_provider=profile_data["outline_provider"],
 30 |                 outline_model=profile_data["outline_model"],
 31 |                 transcript_provider=profile_data["transcript_provider"],
 32 |                 transcript_model=profile_data["transcript_model"],
 33 |                 default_briefing=profile_data["default_briefing"],
 34 |                 num_segments=profile_data["num_segments"],
 35 |             )
 36 |             profile.id = profile_data["id"]
 37 |             profiles.append(profile)
 38 |         return profiles
 39 | 
 40 |     def get_episode_profile(self, profile_name: str) -> EpisodeProfile:
 41 |         """Get a specific episode profile by name."""
 42 |         profile_response = api_client.get_episode_profile(profile_name)
 43 |         profile_data = (
 44 |             profile_response
 45 |             if isinstance(profile_response, dict)
 46 |             else profile_response[0]
 47 |         )
 48 |         profile = EpisodeProfile(
 49 |             name=profile_data["name"],
 50 |             description=profile_data.get("description", ""),
 51 |             speaker_config=profile_data["speaker_config"],
 52 |             outline_provider=profile_data["outline_provider"],
 53 |             outline_model=profile_data["outline_model"],
 54 |             transcript_provider=profile_data["transcript_provider"],
 55 |             transcript_model=profile_data["transcript_model"],
 56 |             default_briefing=profile_data["default_briefing"],
 57 |             num_segments=profile_data["num_segments"],
 58 |         )
 59 |         profile.id = profile_data["id"]
 60 |         return profile
 61 | 
 62 |     def create_episode_profile(
 63 |         self,
 64 |         name: str,
 65 |         description: str = "",
 66 |         speaker_config: str = "",
 67 |         outline_provider: str = "",
 68 |         outline_model: str = "",
 69 |         transcript_provider: str = "",
 70 |         transcript_model: str = "",
 71 |         default_briefing: str = "",
 72 |         num_segments: int = 5,
 73 |     ) -> EpisodeProfile:
 74 |         """Create a new episode profile."""
 75 |         profile_response = api_client.create_episode_profile(
 76 |             name=name,
 77 |             description=description,
 78 |             speaker_config=speaker_config,
 79 |             outline_provider=outline_provider,
 80 |             outline_model=outline_model,
 81 |             transcript_provider=transcript_provider,
 82 |             transcript_model=transcript_model,
 83 |             default_briefing=default_briefing,
 84 |             num_segments=num_segments,
 85 |         )
 86 |         profile_data = (
 87 |             profile_response
 88 |             if isinstance(profile_response, dict)
 89 |             else profile_response[0]
 90 |         )
 91 |         profile = EpisodeProfile(
 92 |             name=profile_data["name"],
 93 |             description=profile_data.get("description", ""),
 94 |             speaker_config=profile_data["speaker_config"],
 95 |             outline_provider=profile_data["outline_provider"],
 96 |             outline_model=profile_data["outline_model"],
 97 |             transcript_provider=profile_data["transcript_provider"],
 98 |             transcript_model=profile_data["transcript_model"],
 99 |             default_briefing=profile_data["default_briefing"],
100 |             num_segments=profile_data["num_segments"],
101 |         )
102 |         profile.id = profile_data["id"]
103 |         return profile

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useState } from 'react'
  4 | import { NotebookResponse } from '@/lib/types/api'
  5 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
  6 | import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
  7 | import { Archive, ArchiveRestore, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
  8 | import { useUpdateNotebook } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notebooks'
  9 | import { NotebookDeleteDialog } from './NotebookDeleteDialog'
 10 | import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns'
 11 | import { getDateLocale } from '@/lib/utils/date-locale'
 12 | import { InlineEdit } from '@/components/common/InlineEdit'
 13 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 14 | 
 15 | interface NotebookHeaderProps {
 16 |   notebook: NotebookResponse
 17 | }
 18 | 
 19 | export function NotebookHeader({ notebook }: NotebookHeaderProps) {
 20 |   const { t, language } = useTranslation()
 21 |   const dfLocale = getDateLocale(language)
 22 |   const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false)
 23 |   
 24 |   const updateNotebook = useUpdateNotebook()
 25 | 
 26 |   const handleUpdateName = async (name: string) => {
 27 |     if (!name || name === notebook.name) return
 28 |     
 29 |     await updateNotebook.mutateAsync({
 30 |       id: notebook.id,
 31 |       data: { name }
 32 |     })
 33 |   }
 34 | 
 35 |   const handleUpdateDescription = async (description: string) => {
 36 |     if (description === notebook.description) return
 37 |     
 38 |     await updateNotebook.mutateAsync({
 39 |       id: notebook.id,
 40 |       data: { description: description || undefined }
 41 |     })
 42 |   }
 43 | 
 44 |   const handleArchiveToggle = () => {
 45 |     updateNotebook.mutate({
 46 |       id: notebook.id,
 47 |       data: { archived: !notebook.archived }
 48 |     })
 49 |   }
 50 | 
 51 |   return (
 52 |     <>
 53 |       <div className="border-b pb-6">
 54 |         <div className="space-y-2">
 55 |           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 56 |             <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
 57 |               <InlineEdit
 58 |                 id="notebook-name"
 59 |                 name="notebook-name"
 60 |                 value={notebook.name}
 61 |                 onSave={handleUpdateName}
 62 |                 className="text-2xl font-bold"
 63 |                 inputClassName="text-2xl font-bold"
 64 |                 placeholder={t.notebooks.namePlaceholder}
 65 |               />
 66 |               {notebook.archived && (
 67 |                 <Badge variant="secondary">{t.notebooks.archived}</Badge>
 68 |               )}
 69 |             </div>
 70 |             <div className="flex gap-2">
 71 |               <Button
 72 |                 variant="outline"
 73 |                 size="sm"
 74 |                 onClick={handleArchiveToggle}
 75 |               >
 76 |                 {notebook.archived ? (
 77 |                   <>
 78 |                     <ArchiveRestore className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
 79 |                     {t.notebooks.unarchive}
 80 |                   </>
 81 |                 ) : (
 82 |                   <>
 83 |                     <Archive className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
 84 |                     {t.notebooks.archive}
 85 |                   </>
 86 |                 )}
 87 |               </Button>
 88 |               <Button
 89 |                 variant="outline"
 90 |                 size="sm"
 91 |                 onClick={() => setShowDeleteDialog(true)}
 92 |                 className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-700"
 93 |               >
 94 |                 <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
 95 |                 {t.common.delete}
 96 |               </Button>
 97 |             </div>
 98 |           </div>
 99 |           
100 |           <InlineEdit
101 |             id="notebook-description"
102 |             name="notebook-description"
103 |             value={notebook.description || ''}
104 |             onSave={handleUpdateDescription}
105 |             className="text-muted-foreground"
106 |             inputClassName="text-muted-foreground"
107 |             placeholder={t.notebooks.addDescription}
108 |             multiline
109 |             emptyText={t.notebooks.addDescription}
110 |           />
111 |           
112 |           <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
113 |             {t.common.created.replace('{time}', formatDistanceToNow(new Date(notebook.created), { addSuffix: true, locale: dfLocale }))} • 
114 |             {t.common.updated.replace('{time}', formatDistanceToNow(new Date(notebook.updated), { addSuffix: true, locale: dfLocale }))}
115 |           </div>
116 |         </div>
117 |       </div>
118 | 
119 |       <NotebookDeleteDialog
120 |         open={showDeleteDialog}
121 |         onOpenChange={setShowDeleteDialog}
122 |         notebookId={notebook.id}
123 |         notebookName={notebook.name}
124 |         redirectAfterDelete
125 |       />
126 |     </>
127 |   )
128 | }

  1 | """
  2 | Models service layer using API.
  3 | """
  4 | 
  5 | from typing import List, Optional
  6 | 
  7 | from loguru import logger
  8 | 
  9 | from api.client import api_client
 10 | from open_notebook.ai.models import DefaultModels, Model
 11 | 
 12 | 
 13 | class ModelsService:
 14 |     """Service layer for models operations using API."""
 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self):
 17 |         logger.info("Using API for models operations")
 18 | 
 19 |     def get_all_models(self, model_type: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Model]:
 20 |         """Get all models with optional type filtering."""
 21 |         models_data = api_client.get_models(model_type=model_type)
 22 |         # Convert API response to Model objects
 23 |         models = []
 24 |         for model_data in models_data:
 25 |             model = Model(
 26 |                 name=model_data["name"],
 27 |                 provider=model_data["provider"],
 28 |                 type=model_data["type"],
 29 |             )
 30 |             model.id = model_data["id"]
 31 |             model.created = model_data["created"]
 32 |             model.updated = model_data["updated"]
 33 |             models.append(model)
 34 |         return models
 35 | 
 36 |     def create_model(self, name: str, provider: str, model_type: str) -> Model:
 37 |         """Create a new model."""
 38 |         response = api_client.create_model(name, provider, model_type)
 39 |         model_data = response if isinstance(response, dict) else response[0]
 40 |         model = Model(
 41 |             name=model_data["name"],
 42 |             provider=model_data["provider"],
 43 |             type=model_data["type"],
 44 |         )
 45 |         model.id = model_data["id"]
 46 |         model.created = model_data["created"]
 47 |         model.updated = model_data["updated"]
 48 |         return model
 49 | 
 50 |     def delete_model(self, model_id: str) -> bool:
 51 |         """Delete a model."""
 52 |         api_client.delete_model(model_id)
 53 |         return True
 54 | 
 55 |     def get_default_models(self) -> DefaultModels:
 56 |         """Get default model assignments."""
 57 |         response = api_client.get_default_models()
 58 |         defaults_data = response if isinstance(response, dict) else response[0]
 59 |         defaults = DefaultModels()
 60 | 
 61 |         # Set the values from API response
 62 |         defaults.default_chat_model = defaults_data.get("default_chat_model")
 63 |         defaults.default_transformation_model = defaults_data.get(
 64 |             "default_transformation_model"
 65 |         )
 66 |         defaults.large_context_model = defaults_data.get("large_context_model")
 67 |         defaults.default_text_to_speech_model = defaults_data.get(
 68 |             "default_text_to_speech_model"
 69 |         )
 70 |         defaults.default_speech_to_text_model = defaults_data.get(
 71 |             "default_speech_to_text_model"
 72 |         )
 73 |         defaults.default_embedding_model = defaults_data.get("default_embedding_model")
 74 |         defaults.default_tools_model = defaults_data.get("default_tools_model")
 75 | 
 76 |         return defaults
 77 | 
 78 |     def update_default_models(self, defaults: DefaultModels) -> DefaultModels:
 79 |         """Update default model assignments."""
 80 |         updates = {
 81 |             "default_chat_model": defaults.default_chat_model,
 82 |             "default_transformation_model": defaults.default_transformation_model,
 83 |             "large_context_model": defaults.large_context_model,
 84 |             "default_text_to_speech_model": defaults.default_text_to_speech_model,
 85 |             "default_speech_to_text_model": defaults.default_speech_to_text_model,
 86 |             "default_embedding_model": defaults.default_embedding_model,
 87 |             "default_tools_model": defaults.default_tools_model,
 88 |         }
 89 | 
 90 |         response = api_client.update_default_models(**updates)
 91 |         defaults_data = response if isinstance(response, dict) else response[0]
 92 | 
 93 |         # Update the defaults object with the response
 94 |         defaults.default_chat_model = defaults_data.get("default_chat_model")
 95 |         defaults.default_transformation_model = defaults_data.get(
 96 |             "default_transformation_model"
 97 |         )
 98 |         defaults.large_context_model = defaults_data.get("large_context_model")
 99 |         defaults.default_text_to_speech_model = defaults_data.get(
100 |             "default_text_to_speech_model"
101 |         )
102 |         defaults.default_speech_to_text_model = defaults_data.get(
103 |             "default_speech_to_text_model"
104 |         )
105 |         defaults.default_embedding_model = defaults_data.get("default_embedding_model")
106 |         defaults.default_tools_model = defaults_data.get("default_tools_model")
107 | 
108 |         return defaults
109 | 
110 | 
111 | # Global service instance
112 | models_service = ModelsService()
113 |

  1 | """
  2 | Podcast service layer using API client.
  3 | This replaces direct httpx calls in the Streamlit pages.
  4 | """
  5 | 
  6 | from typing import Any, Dict, List
  7 | 
  8 | from loguru import logger
  9 | 
 10 | from api.client import api_client
 11 | 
 12 | 
 13 | class PodcastAPIService:
 14 |     """Service layer for podcast operations using API client."""
 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self):
 17 |         logger.info("Using API client for podcast operations")
 18 | 
 19 |     # Episode methods
 20 |     def get_episodes(self) -> List[Dict[Any, Any]]:
 21 |         """Get all podcast episodes."""
 22 |         result = api_client._make_request("GET", "/api/podcasts/episodes")
 23 |         return result if isinstance(result, list) else [result]
 24 | 
 25 |     def delete_episode(self, episode_id: str) -> bool:
 26 |         """Delete a podcast episode."""
 27 |         try:
 28 |             api_client._make_request("DELETE", f"/api/podcasts/episodes/{episode_id}")
 29 |             return True
 30 |         except Exception as e:
 31 |             logger.error(f"Failed to delete episode: {e}")
 32 |             return False
 33 | 
 34 |     # Episode Profile methods
 35 |     def get_episode_profiles(self) -> List[Dict]:
 36 |         """Get all episode profiles."""
 37 |         return api_client.get_episode_profiles()
 38 | 
 39 |     def create_episode_profile(self, profile_data: Dict) -> bool:
 40 |         """Create a new episode profile."""
 41 |         try:
 42 |             api_client.create_episode_profile(**profile_data)
 43 |             return True
 44 |         except Exception as e:
 45 |             logger.error(f"Failed to create episode profile: {e}")
 46 |             return False
 47 | 
 48 |     def update_episode_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: Dict) -> bool:
 49 |         """Update an episode profile."""
 50 |         try:
 51 |             api_client.update_episode_profile(profile_id, **profile_data)
 52 |             return True
 53 |         except Exception as e:
 54 |             logger.error(f"Failed to update episode profile: {e}")
 55 |             return False
 56 | 
 57 |     def delete_episode_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> bool:
 58 |         """Delete an episode profile."""
 59 |         try:
 60 |             api_client.delete_episode_profile(profile_id)
 61 |             return True
 62 |         except Exception as e:
 63 |             logger.error(f"Failed to delete episode profile: {e}")
 64 |             return False
 65 | 
 66 |     def duplicate_episode_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> bool:
 67 |         """Duplicate an episode profile."""
 68 |         try:
 69 |             api_client._make_request(
 70 |                 "POST", f"/api/episode-profiles/{profile_id}/duplicate"
 71 |             )
 72 |             return True
 73 |         except Exception as e:
 74 |             logger.error(f"Failed to duplicate episode profile: {e}")
 75 |             return False
 76 | 
 77 |     # Speaker Profile methods
 78 |     def get_speaker_profiles(self) -> List[Dict[Any, Any]]:
 79 |         """Get all speaker profiles."""
 80 |         result = api_client._make_request("GET", "/api/speaker-profiles")
 81 |         return result if isinstance(result, list) else [result]
 82 | 
 83 |     def create_speaker_profile(self, profile_data: Dict) -> bool:
 84 |         """Create a new speaker profile."""
 85 |         try:
 86 |             api_client._make_request("POST", "/api/speaker-profiles", json=profile_data)
 87 |             return True
 88 |         except Exception as e:
 89 |             logger.error(f"Failed to create speaker profile: {e}")
 90 |             return False
 91 | 
 92 |     def update_speaker_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: Dict) -> bool:
 93 |         """Update a speaker profile."""
 94 |         try:
 95 |             api_client._make_request(
 96 |                 "PUT", f"/api/speaker-profiles/{profile_id}", json=profile_data
 97 |             )
 98 |             return True
 99 |         except Exception as e:
100 |             logger.error(f"Failed to update speaker profile: {e}")
101 |             return False
102 | 
103 |     def delete_speaker_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> bool:
104 |         """Delete a speaker profile."""
105 |         try:
106 |             api_client._make_request("DELETE", f"/api/speaker-profiles/{profile_id}")
107 |             return True
108 |         except Exception as e:
109 |             logger.error(f"Failed to delete speaker profile: {e}")
110 |             return False
111 | 
112 |     def duplicate_speaker_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> bool:
113 |         """Duplicate a speaker profile."""
114 |         try:
115 |             api_client._make_request(
116 |                 "POST", f"/api/speaker-profiles/{profile_id}/duplicate"
117 |             )
118 |             return True
119 |         except Exception as e:
120 |             logger.error(f"Failed to duplicate speaker profile: {e}")
121 |             return False

  1 | import asyncio
  2 | import time
  3 | from typing import List, Optional
  4 | 
  5 | from loguru import logger
  6 | from pydantic import BaseModel
  7 | from surreal_commands import command
  8 | 
  9 | 
 10 | class TextProcessingInput(BaseModel):
 11 |     text: str
 12 |     operation: str = "uppercase"  # uppercase, lowercase, word_count, reverse
 13 |     delay_seconds: Optional[int] = None  # For testing async behavior
 14 | 
 15 | 
 16 | class TextProcessingOutput(BaseModel):
 17 |     success: bool
 18 |     original_text: str
 19 |     processed_text: Optional[str] = None
 20 |     word_count: Optional[int] = None
 21 |     processing_time: float
 22 |     error_message: Optional[str] = None
 23 | 
 24 | 
 25 | class DataAnalysisInput(BaseModel):
 26 |     numbers: List[float]
 27 |     analysis_type: str = "basic"  # basic, detailed
 28 |     delay_seconds: Optional[int] = None
 29 | 
 30 | 
 31 | class DataAnalysisOutput(BaseModel):
 32 |     success: bool
 33 |     analysis_type: str
 34 |     count: int
 35 |     sum: Optional[float] = None
 36 |     average: Optional[float] = None
 37 |     min_value: Optional[float] = None
 38 |     max_value: Optional[float] = None
 39 |     processing_time: float
 40 |     error_message: Optional[str] = None
 41 | 
 42 | 
 43 | @command("process_text", app="open_notebook")
 44 | async def process_text_command(input_data: TextProcessingInput) -> TextProcessingOutput:
 45 |     """
 46 |     Example command for text processing. Tests basic command functionality
 47 |     and demonstrates different processing types.
 48 |     """
 49 |     start_time = time.time()
 50 | 
 51 |     try:
 52 |         logger.info(f"Processing text with operation: {input_data.operation}")
 53 | 
 54 |         # Simulate processing delay if specified
 55 |         if input_data.delay_seconds:
 56 |             await asyncio.sleep(input_data.delay_seconds)
 57 | 
 58 |         processed_text = None
 59 |         word_count = None
 60 | 
 61 |         if input_data.operation == "uppercase":
 62 |             processed_text = input_data.text.upper()
 63 |         elif input_data.operation == "lowercase":
 64 |             processed_text = input_data.text.lower()
 65 |         elif input_data.operation == "reverse":
 66 |             processed_text = input_data.text[::-1]
 67 |         elif input_data.operation == "word_count":
 68 |             word_count = len(input_data.text.split())
 69 |             processed_text = f"Word count: {word_count}"
 70 |         else:
 71 |             raise ValueError(f"Unknown operation: {input_data.operation}")
 72 | 
 73 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
 74 | 
 75 |         return TextProcessingOutput(
 76 |             success=True,
 77 |             original_text=input_data.text,
 78 |             processed_text=processed_text,
 79 |             word_count=word_count,
 80 |             processing_time=processing_time,
 81 |         )
 82 | 
 83 |     except Exception as e:
 84 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
 85 |         logger.error(f"Text processing failed: {e}")
 86 |         return TextProcessingOutput(
 87 |             success=False,
 88 |             original_text=input_data.text,
 89 |             processing_time=processing_time,
 90 |             error_message=str(e),
 91 |         )
 92 | 
 93 | 
 94 | @command("analyze_data", app="open_notebook")
 95 | async def analyze_data_command(input_data: DataAnalysisInput) -> DataAnalysisOutput:
 96 |     """
 97 |     Example command for data analysis. Tests command with complex input/output
 98 |     and demonstrates error handling.
 99 |     """
100 |     start_time = time.time()
101 | 
102 |     try:
103 |         logger.info(
104 |             f"Analyzing {len(input_data.numbers)} numbers with {input_data.analysis_type} analysis"
105 |         )
106 | 
107 |         # Simulate processing delay if specified
108 |         if input_data.delay_seconds:
109 |             await asyncio.sleep(input_data.delay_seconds)
110 | 
111 |         if not input_data.numbers:
112 |             raise ValueError("No numbers provided for analysis")
113 | 
114 |         count = len(input_data.numbers)
115 |         sum_value = sum(input_data.numbers)
116 |         average = sum_value / count
117 |         min_value = min(input_data.numbers)
118 |         max_value = max(input_data.numbers)
119 | 
120 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
121 | 
122 |         return DataAnalysisOutput(
123 |             success=True,
124 |             analysis_type=input_data.analysis_type,
125 |             count=count,
126 |             sum=sum_value,
127 |             average=average,
128 |             min_value=min_value,
129 |             max_value=max_value,
130 |             processing_time=processing_time,
131 |         )
132 | 
133 |     except Exception as e:
134 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
135 |         logger.error(f"Data analysis failed: {e}")
136 |         return DataAnalysisOutput(
137 |             success=False,
138 |             analysis_type=input_data.analysis_type,
139 |             count=0,
140 |             processing_time=processing_time,
141 |             error_message=str(e),
142 |         )
143 |

 16 | interface StrategyData {

 18 |   searches: Array<{ term: string; instructions: string }>
 19 | }
 20 | 
 21 | interface AskState {
 22 |   isStreaming: boolean
 23 |   strategy: StrategyData | null
 24 |   answers: string[]
 25 |   finalAnswer: string | null
 26 |   error: string | null
 27 | }
 28 | 
 29 | export function useAsk() {
 30 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 31 |   const [state, setState] = useState<AskState>({
 32 |     isStreaming: false,
 33 |     strategy: null,
 34 |     answers: [],
 35 |     finalAnswer: null,
 36 |     error: null
 37 |   })
 38 | 
 39 |   const sendAsk = useCallback(async (question: string, models: AskModels) => {
 40 |     // Validate inputs
 41 |     if (!question.trim()) {
 42 |       toast.error(t('apiErrors.pleaseEnterQuestion'))
 43 |       return
 44 |     }
 45 | 
 46 |     if (!models.strategy || !models.answer || !models.finalAnswer) {
 47 |       toast.error(t('apiErrors.pleaseConfigureModels'))
 48 |       return
 49 |     }
 50 | 
 51 |     // Reset state
 52 |     setState({
 53 |       isStreaming: true,
 54 |       strategy: null,
 55 |       answers: [],
 56 |       finalAnswer: null,
 57 |       error: null
 58 |     })
 59 | 
 60 |     try {
 61 |       const response = await searchApi.askKnowledgeBase({
 62 |         question,
 63 |         strategy_model: models.strategy,
 64 |         answer_model: models.answer,
 65 |         final_answer_model: models.finalAnswer
 66 |       })
 67 | 
 68 |       if (!response) {
 69 |         throw new Error('No response body received from server')
 70 |       }
 71 | 
 72 |       const reader = response.getReader()
 73 |       const decoder = new TextDecoder()
 74 |       let buffer = ''
 75 | 
 76 |       while (true) {
 77 |         const { done, value } = await reader.read()
 78 | 
 79 |         if (done) {
 80 |           break
 81 |         }
 82 | 
 83 |         buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
 84 |         const lines = buffer.split('\n')
 85 | 
 86 |         // Keep the last incomplete line in buffer
 87 |         buffer = lines.pop() || ''
 88 | 
 89 |         for (const line of lines) {
 90 |           if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
 91 |             try {
 92 |               const jsonStr = line.slice(6).trim()
 93 |               if (!jsonStr) continue
 94 | 
 95 |               const data: AskStreamEvent = JSON.parse(jsonStr)
 96 | 
 97 |               if (data.type === 'strategy') {
 98 |                 setState(prev => ({
 99 |                   ...prev,
100 |                   strategy: {
101 |                     reasoning: data.reasoning || '',
102 |                     searches: data.searches || []
103 |                   }
104 |                 }))
105 |               } else if (data.type === 'answer') {
106 |                 setState(prev => ({
107 |                   ...prev,
108 |                   answers: [...prev.answers, data.content || '']
109 |                 }))
110 |               } else if (data.type === 'final_answer') {
111 |                 setState(prev => ({
112 |                   ...prev,
113 |                   finalAnswer: data.content || '',
114 |                   isStreaming: false
115 |                 }))
116 |               } else if (data.type === 'complete') {
117 |                 setState(prev => ({
118 |                   ...prev,
119 |                   isStreaming: false
120 |                 }))
121 |               } else if (data.type === 'error') {
122 |                 throw new Error(data.message || 'Stream error occurred')
123 |               }
124 |             } catch (e) {
125 |               console.error('Error parsing SSE data:', e, 'Line:', line)
126 |               // Don't throw - continue processing other lines
127 |             }
128 |           }
129 |         }
130 |       }
131 | 
132 |       // Ensure streaming is stopped
133 |       setState(prev => ({ ...prev, isStreaming: false }))
134 | 
135 |     } catch (error) {
136 |       const err = error as { message?: string }
137 |       const errorMessage = err.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
138 |       console.error('Ask error:', error)
139 | 
140 |       setState(prev => ({
141 |         ...prev,
142 |         isStreaming: false,
143 |         error: errorMessage
144 |       }))
145 | 
146 |       toast.error(t('apiErrors.askFailed'), {
147 |         description: t(getApiErrorKey(errorMessage))
148 |       })
149 |     }
150 |   }, [t])
151 | 
152 |   const reset = useCallback(() => {
153 |     setState({
154 |       isStreaming: false,
155 |       strategy: null,
156 |       answers: [],
157 |       finalAnswer: null,
158 |       error: null
159 |     })
160 |   }, [])
161 | 
162 |   return {
163 |     ...state,
164 |     sendAsk,
165 |     reset
166 |   }
167 | }
168 |

/docs/1-INSTALLATION/index.md:

  1 | # Installation Guide
  2 | 
  3 | Choose your installation route based on your setup and use case.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Quick Decision: Which Route?
  6 | 
  7 | ### 🚀 I want the easiest setup (Recommended for most)
  8 | **→ [Docker Compose](docker-compose.md)** - Multi-container setup, production-ready
  9 | - ✅ All features working
 10 | - ✅ Clear separation of services
 11 | - ✅ Easy to scale
 12 | - ✅ Works on Mac, Windows, Linux
 13 | - ⏱️ 5 minutes to running
 14 | 
 15 | ---
 16 | 
 17 | ### 🏠 I want everything in one container (Simplified)
 18 | **→ [Single Container](single-container.md)** - All-in-one for simple deployments
 19 | - ✅ Minimal configuration
 20 | - ✅ Lower resource usage
 21 | - ✅ Good for shared hosting
 22 | - ✅ Works on PikaPods, Railway, etc.
 23 | - ⏱️ 3 minutes to running
 24 | 
 25 | ---
 26 | 
 27 | ### 👨‍💻 I want to develop/contribute (Developers only)
 28 | **→ [From Source](from-source.md)** - Clone repo, set up locally
 29 | - ✅ Full control over code
 30 | - ✅ Easy to debug
 31 | - ✅ Can modify and test
 32 | - ⚠️ Requires Python 3.11+, Node.js
 33 | - ⏱️ 10 minutes to running
 34 | 
 35 | ---
 36 | 
 37 | 
 38 | ## System Requirements
 39 | 
 40 | ### Minimum
 41 | - **RAM**: 4GB
 42 | - **Storage**: 2GB for app + space for documents
 43 | - **CPU**: Any modern processor
 44 | - **Network**: Internet (optional for offline setup)
 45 | 
 46 | ### Recommended
 47 | - **RAM**: 8GB+
 48 | - **Storage**: 10GB+ for documents and models
 49 | - **CPU**: Multi-core processor
 50 | - **GPU**: Optional (speeds up local AI models)
 51 | 
 52 | ---
 53 | 
 54 | ## AI Provider Options
 55 | 
 56 | ### Cloud-Based (Pay-as-you-go)
 57 | - **OpenAI** - GPT-4, GPT-4o, fast and capable
 58 | - **Anthropic (Claude)** - Claude 3.5 Sonnet, excellent reasoning
 59 | - **Google Gemini** - Multimodal, cost-effective
 60 | - **Groq** - Ultra-fast inference
 61 | - **Others**: Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, OpenRouter
 62 | 
 63 | **Cost**: Usually $0.01-$0.10 per 1K tokens
 64 | **Speed**: Fast (sub-second)
 65 | **Privacy**: Your data sent to cloud
 66 | 
 67 | ### Local (Free, Private)
 68 | - **Ollama** - Run open-source models locally
 69 | - **LM Studio** - Desktop app for local models
 70 | - **Hugging Face models** - Download and run
 71 | 
 72 | **Cost**: $0 (just electricity)
 73 | **Speed**: Depends on your hardware (slow to medium)
 74 | **Privacy**: 100% offline
 75 | 
 76 | ---
 77 | 
 78 | ## Choose a Route
 79 | 
 80 | **Already know which way to go?** Pick your installation path:
 81 | 
 82 | - [Docker Compose](docker-compose.md) - **Most users**
 83 | - [Single Container](single-container.md) - **Shared hosting**
 84 | - [From Source](from-source.md) - **Developers**
 85 | 
 86 | > **Privacy-first?** Any installation method works with Ollama for 100% local AI. See [Local Quick Start](../0-START-HERE/quick-start-local.md).
 87 | 
 88 | ---
 89 | 
 90 | ## Pre-Installation Checklist
 91 | 
 92 | Before installing, you'll need:
 93 | 
 94 | - [ ] **Docker** (for Docker routes) or **Node.js 18+** (for source)
 95 | - [ ] **AI Provider API key** (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) OR willingness to use free local models
 96 | - [ ] **At least 4GB RAM** available
 97 | - [ ] **Stable internet** (or offline setup with Ollama)
 98 | 
 99 | ---
100 | 
101 | ## Detailed Installation Instructions
102 | 
103 | ### For Docker Users
104 | 1. Install [Docker Desktop](https://docker.com/products/docker-desktop)
105 | 2. Choose: [Docker Compose](docker-compose.md) or [Single Container](single-container.md)
106 | 3. Follow the step-by-step guide
107 | 4. Access at `http://localhost:8502`
108 | 
109 | ### For Source Installation (Developers)
110 | 1. Have Python 3.11+, Node.js 18+, Git installed
111 | 2. Follow [From Source](from-source.md)
112 | 3. Run `make start-all`
113 | 4. Access at `http://localhost:8502` (frontend) or `http://localhost:5055` (API)
114 | 
115 | ---
116 | 
117 | ## After Installation
118 | 
119 | Once you're up and running:
120 | 
121 | 1. **Configure Models** - Choose your AI provider in Settings
122 | 2. **Create First Notebook** - Start organizing research
123 | 3. **Add Sources** - PDFs, web links, documents
124 | 4. **Explore Features** - Chat, search, transformations
125 | 5. **Read Full Guide** - [User Guide](../3-USER-GUIDE/index.md)
126 | 
127 | ---
128 | 
129 | ## Troubleshooting During Installation
130 | 
131 | **Having issues?** Check the troubleshooting section in your chosen installation guide, or see [Quick Fixes](../6-TROUBLESHOOTING/quick-fixes.md).
132 | 
133 | ---
134 | 
135 | ## Need Help?
136 | 
137 | - **Discord**: [Join community](https://discord.gg/37XJPXfz2w)
138 | - **GitHub Issues**: [Report problems](https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/issues)
139 | - **Docs**: See [Full Documentation](../index.md)
140 | 
141 | ---
142 | 
143 | ## Production Deployment
144 | 
145 | Installing for production use? See additional resources:
146 | 
147 | - [Security Hardening](https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/blob/main/docs/deployment/security.md)
148 | - [Reverse Proxy Setup](https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/blob/main/docs/deployment/reverse-proxy.md)
149 | - [Performance Tuning](https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/blob/main/docs/deployment/retry-configuration.md)
150 | 
151 | ---
152 | 
153 | **Ready to install?** Pick a route above! ⬆️
154 |

  1 | """
  2 | Version utilities for Open Notebook.
  3 | Handles version comparison, GitHub version fetching, and package version management.
  4 | """
  5 | 
  6 | from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
  7 | from urllib.parse import urlparse
  8 | 
  9 | import requests  # type: ignore
 10 | import tomli
 11 | from packaging.version import parse as parse_version
 12 | 
 13 | 
 14 | async def get_version_from_github_async(repo_url: str, branch: str = "main") -> str:
 15 |     """
 16 |     Fetch and parse the version from pyproject.toml in a public GitHub repository (async).
 17 |     """
 18 |     from urllib.parse import urlparse
 19 | 
 20 |     import httpx
 21 |     import tomli
 22 | 
 23 |     # Parse the GitHub URL
 24 |     parsed_url = urlparse(repo_url)
 25 |     if "github.com" not in parsed_url.netloc:
 26 |         raise ValueError("Not a GitHub URL")
 27 | 
 28 |     # Extract owner and repo name from path
 29 |     path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip("/").split("/")
 30 |     if len(path_parts) < 2:
 31 |         raise ValueError("Invalid GitHub repository URL")
 32 | 
 33 |     owner, repo = path_parts[0], path_parts[1]
 34 | 
 35 |     # Construct raw content URL for pyproject.toml
 36 |     raw_url = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{repo}/{branch}/pyproject.toml"
 37 | 
 38 |     # Fetch the file with timeout using httpx
 39 |     async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
 40 |         response = await client.get(raw_url)
 41 |         response.raise_for_status()
 42 | 
 43 |     # Parse TOML content
 44 |     pyproject_data = tomli.loads(response.text)
 45 | 
 46 |     # Try to find version
 47 |     try:
 48 |         # Check tool.poetry.version
 49 |         version_str = pyproject_data["tool"]["poetry"]["version"]
 50 |     except KeyError:
 51 |         try:
 52 |             # Check project.version
 53 |             version_str = pyproject_data["project"]["version"]
 54 |         except KeyError:
 55 |             raise KeyError("Version not found in pyproject.toml")
 56 | 
 57 |     return version_str
 58 | 
 59 | def get_version_from_github(repo_url: str, branch: str = "main") -> str:
 60 |     """
 61 |     Fetch and parse the version from pyproject.toml in a public GitHub repository.
 62 | 
 63 |     Args:
 64 |         repo_url (str): URL of the GitHub repository
 65 |         branch (str): Branch name to fetch from (defaults to "main")
 66 | 
 67 |     Returns:
 68 |         str: Version string from pyproject.toml
 69 | 
 70 |     Raises:
 71 |         ValueError: If the URL is not a valid GitHub repository URL
 72 |         requests.RequestException: If there's an error fetching the file
 73 |         KeyError: If version information is not found in pyproject.toml
 74 |     """
 75 |     # Parse the GitHub URL
 76 |     parsed_url = urlparse(repo_url)
 77 |     if "github.com" not in parsed_url.netloc:
 78 |         raise ValueError("Not a GitHub URL")
 79 | 
 80 |     # Extract owner and repo name from path
 81 |     path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip("/").split("/")
 82 |     if len(path_parts) < 2:
 83 |         raise ValueError("Invalid GitHub repository URL")
 84 | 
 85 |     owner, repo = path_parts[0], path_parts[1]
 86 | 
 87 |     # Construct raw content URL for pyproject.toml
 88 |     raw_url = (
 89 |         f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{repo}/{branch}/pyproject.toml"
 90 |     )
 91 | 
 92 |     # Fetch the file with timeout
 93 |     response = requests.get(raw_url, timeout=10)
 94 |     response.raise_for_status()
 95 | 
 96 |     # Parse TOML content
 97 |     pyproject_data = tomli.loads(response.text)
 98 | 
 99 |     # Try to find version in different possible locations
100 |     try:
101 |         # Check project.version first (poetry style)
102 |         version = pyproject_data["tool"]["poetry"]["version"]
103 |     except KeyError:
104 |         try:
105 |             # Check project.version (standard style)
106 |             version = pyproject_data["project"]["version"]
107 |         except KeyError:
108 |             raise KeyError("Version not found in pyproject.toml")
109 | 
110 |     return version
111 | 
112 | 
113 | def get_installed_version(package_name: str) -> str:
114 |     """
115 |     Get the version of an installed package.
116 | 
117 |     Args:
118 |         package_name (str): Name of the installed package
119 | 
120 |     Returns:
121 |         str: Version string of the installed package
122 | 
123 |     Raises:
124 |         PackageNotFoundError: If the package is not installed
125 |     """
126 |     try:
127 |         return version(package_name)
128 |     except PackageNotFoundError:
129 |         raise PackageNotFoundError(f"Package '{package_name}' not found")
130 | 
131 | 
132 | def compare_versions(version1: str, version2: str) -> int:
133 |     """
134 |     Compare two semantic versions.
135 | 
136 |     Args:
137 |         version1 (str): First version string
138 |         version2 (str): Second version string
139 | 
140 |     Returns:
141 |         int: -1 if version1 < version2
142 |               0 if version1 == version2
143 |               1 if version1 > version2
144 |     """
145 |     v1 = parse_version(version1)
146 |     v2 = parse_version(version2)
147 | 
148 |     if v1 < v2:
149 |         return -1
150 |     elif v1 > v2:
151 |         return 1
152 |     else:
153 |         return 0
154 |

/open_notebook/domain/CLAUDE.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # Domain Module
  2 | 
  3 | Core data models for notebooks, sources, notes, and settings with async SurrealDB persistence, auto-embedding, and relationship management.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Purpose
  6 | 
  7 | Two base classes support different persistence patterns: **ObjectModel** (mutable records with auto-increment IDs) and **RecordModel** (singleton configuration with fixed IDs).
  8 | 
  9 | ## Key Components
 10 | 
 11 | ### base.py
 12 | - **ObjectModel**: Base for notebooks, sources, notes
 13 |   - `save()`: Create/update with auto-embedding for searchable content
 14 |   - `delete()`: Remove by ID
 15 |   - `relate(relationship, target_id)`: Create graph relationships (reference, artifact, refers_to)
 16 |   - `get(id)`: Polymorphic fetch; resolves subclass from ID prefix
 17 |   - `get_all(order_by)`: Fetch all records from table
 18 |   - Integrates with ModelManager for automatic embedding
 19 | 
 20 | - **RecordModel**: Singleton configuration (ContentSettings, DefaultPrompts)
 21 |   - Fixed record_id per subclass
 22 |   - `update()`: Upsert to database
 23 |   - Lazy DB loading via `_load_from_db()`
 24 | 
 25 | ### notebook.py
 26 | - **Notebook**: Research project container
 27 |   - `get_sources()`, `get_notes()`, `get_chat_sessions()`: Navigate relationships
 28 |   - `get_delete_preview()`: Returns counts of notes, exclusive sources, and shared sources that would be affected by deletion
 29 |   - `delete(delete_exclusive_sources)`: Cascade deletion - always deletes notes, optionally deletes exclusive sources, always unlinks all sources
 30 | 
 31 | - **Source**: Content item (file/URL)
 32 |   - `vectorize()`: Submit async embedding job (returns command_id, fire-and-forget)
 33 |   - `get_status()`, `get_processing_progress()`: Track job via surreal_commands
 34 |   - `get_context()`: Returns summary for LLM context
 35 |   - `add_insight()`: Submit async insight creation via `create_insight_command` (fire-and-forget, returns command_id)
 36 | 
 37 | - **Note**: Standalone or linked notes
 38 |   - `save()`: Submits `embed_note` command after save (fire-and-forget)
 39 |   - `add_to_notebook()`: Link to notebook
 40 | 
 41 | - **SourceInsight, SourceEmbedding**: Derived content models
 42 | - **ChatSession**: Conversation container with optional model_override
 43 | - **Asset**: File/URL reference helper
 44 | 
 45 | - **Search functions**:
 46 |   - `text_search()`: Full-text keyword search
 47 |   - `vector_search()`: Semantic search via embeddings (default minimum_score=0.2)
 48 | 
 49 | ### content_settings.py
 50 | - **ContentSettings**: Singleton for processing engines, embedding strategy, file deletion, YouTube languages
 51 | 
 52 | ### transformation.py
 53 | - **Transformation**: Reusable prompts for content transformation
 54 | - **DefaultPrompts**: Singleton with transformation instructions
 55 | 
 56 | ## Important Patterns
 57 | 
 58 | - **Async/await**: All DB operations async; always use await
 59 | - **Polymorphic get()**: `ObjectModel.get(id)` determines subclass from ID prefix (table:id format)
 60 | - **Fire-and-forget embedding**: Models submit embed_* commands after save via `submit_command()` (non-blocking)
 61 | - **Nullable fields**: Declare via `nullable_fields` ClassVar to allow None in database
 62 | - **Timestamps**: `created` and `updated` auto-managed as ISO strings
 63 | - **Fire-and-forget jobs**: `source.vectorize()` returns command_id without waiting
 64 | 
 65 | ## Key Dependencies
 66 | 
 67 | - `surrealdb`: RecordID type for relationships
 68 | - `pydantic`: Validation and field_validator decorators
 69 | - `open_notebook.database.repository`: CRUD and relationship functions
 70 | - `open_notebook.ai.models`: ModelManager for embeddings
 71 | - `surreal_commands`: Async job submission (vectorization, insights)
 72 | - `loguru`: Logging
 73 | 
 74 | ## Quirks & Gotchas
 75 | 
 76 | - **Polymorphic resolution**: `ObjectModel.get()` fails if subclass not imported (search subclasses list)
 77 | - **RecordModel singleton**: __new__ returns existing instance; call `clear_instance()` in tests
 78 | - **Source.command field**: Stored as RecordID; auto-parsed from strings via field_validator
 79 | - **Text truncation**: `Note.get_context(short)` hardcodes 100-char limit
 80 | - **Auto-embedding behavior**:
 81 |   - `Note.save()` → auto-submits `embed_note` command
 82 |   - `Source.save()` → does NOT auto-submit (must call `vectorize()` explicitly)
 83 |   - `Source.add_insight()` → submits `create_insight_command` which handles DB insert + `embed_insight` command (all fire-and-forget)
 84 | - **Relationship strings**: Must match SurrealDB schema (reference, artifact, refers_to)
 85 | 
 86 | ## How to Add New Model
 87 | 
 88 | 1. Inherit from ObjectModel with table_name ClassVar
 89 | 2. Define Pydantic fields with validators
 90 | 3. Override `save()` to submit embedding command if searchable (use `submit_command("embed_*", id)`)
 91 | 4. Add custom methods for domain logic (get_X, add_to_Y)
 92 | 5. Implement `_prepare_save_data()` if custom serialization needed
 93 | 
 94 | ## Usage
 95 | 
 96 | ```python
 97 | notebook = Notebook(name="Research", description="My project")
 98 | await notebook.save()
 99 | 
100 | obj = await ObjectModel.get("notebook:123")  # Polymorphic fetch
101 | 
102 | # Search
103 | await text_search("quantum", results=5)
104 | await vector_search("quantum computing", results=10, minimum_score=0.3)
105 | ```
106 |

  6 | from open_notebook.exceptions import InvalidInputError

  8 | 
  9 | router = APIRouter()

 11 | 
 12 | @router.post("/notebooks/{notebook_id}/context", response_model=ContextResponse)
 13 | async def get_notebook_context(notebook_id: str, context_request: ContextRequest):
 14 |     """Get context for a notebook based on configuration."""
 15 |     try:
 16 |         # Verify notebook exists
 17 |         notebook = await Notebook.get(notebook_id)
 18 |         if not notebook:
 19 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Notebook not found")
 20 | 
 21 |         context_data: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = {"note": [], "source": []}
 22 |         total_content = ""
 23 | 
 24 |         # Process context configuration if provided
 25 |         if context_request.context_config:
 26 |             # Process sources
 27 |             for source_id, status in context_request.context_config.sources.items():
 28 |                 if "not in" in status:
 29 |                     continue
 30 | 
 31 |                 try:
 32 |                     # Add table prefix if not present
 33 |                     full_source_id = (
 34 |                         source_id
 35 |                         if source_id.startswith("source:")
 36 |                         else f"source:{source_id}"
 37 |                     )
 38 | 
 39 |                     try:
 40 |                         source = await Source.get(full_source_id)
 41 |                     except Exception:
 42 |                         continue
 43 | 
 44 |                     if "insights" in status:
 45 |                         source_context = await source.get_context(context_size="short")
 46 |                         context_data["source"].append(source_context)
 47 |                         total_content += str(source_context)
 48 |                     elif "full content" in status:
 49 |                         source_context = await source.get_context(context_size="long")
 50 |                         context_data["source"].append(source_context)
 51 |                         total_content += str(source_context)
 52 |                 except Exception as e:
 53 |                     logger.warning(f"Error processing source {source_id}: {str(e)}")
 54 |                     continue
 55 | 
 56 |             # Process notes
 57 |             for note_id, status in context_request.context_config.notes.items():
 58 |                 if "not in" in status:
 59 |                     continue
 60 | 
 61 |                 try:
 62 |                     # Add table prefix if not present
 63 |                     full_note_id = (
 64 |                         note_id if note_id.startswith("note:") else f"note:{note_id}"
 65 |                     )
 66 |                     note = await Note.get(full_note_id)
 67 |                     if not note:
 68 |                         continue
 69 | 
 70 |                     if "full content" in status:
 71 |                         note_context = note.get_context(context_size="long")
 72 |                         context_data["note"].append(note_context)
 73 |                         total_content += str(note_context)
 74 |                 except Exception as e:
 75 |                     logger.warning(f"Error processing note {note_id}: {str(e)}")
 76 |                     continue
 77 |         else:
 78 |             # Default behavior - include all sources and notes with short context
 79 |             sources = await notebook.get_sources()
 80 |             for source in sources:
 81 |                 try:
 82 |                     source_context = await source.get_context(context_size="short")
 83 |                     context_data["source"].append(source_context)
 84 |                     total_content += str(source_context)
 85 |                 except Exception as e:
 86 |                     logger.warning(f"Error processing source {source.id}: {str(e)}")
 87 |                     continue
 88 | 
 89 |             notes = await notebook.get_notes()
 90 |             for note in notes:
 91 |                 try:
 92 |                     note_context = note.get_context(context_size="short")
 93 |                     context_data["note"].append(note_context)
 94 |                     total_content += str(note_context)
 95 |                 except Exception as e:
 96 |                     logger.warning(f"Error processing note {note.id}: {str(e)}")
 97 |                     continue
 98 | 
 99 |         # Calculate estimated token count
100 |         estimated_tokens = token_count(total_content) if total_content else 0
101 | 
102 |         return ContextResponse(
103 |             notebook_id=notebook_id,
104 |             sources=context_data["source"],
105 |             notes=context_data["note"],
106 |             total_tokens=estimated_tokens,
107 |         )
108 | 
109 |     except HTTPException:
110 |         raise
111 |     except InvalidInputError as e:
112 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
113 |     except Exception as e:
114 |         logger.error(f"Error getting context for notebook {notebook_id}: {str(e)}")
115 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Error getting context: {str(e)}")
116 |

 42 |     question: str

 47 | 
 48 | async def call_model_with_messages(state: ThreadState, config: RunnableConfig) -> dict:
 49 |     parser = PydanticOutputParser(pydantic_object=Strategy)
 50 |     system_prompt = Prompter(prompt_template="ask/entry", parser=parser).render(  # type: ignore[arg-type]
 51 |         data=state  # type: ignore[arg-type]
 52 |     )
 53 |     model = await provision_langchain_model(
 54 |         system_prompt,
 55 |         config.get("configurable", {}).get("strategy_model"),
 56 |         "tools",
 57 |         max_tokens=2000,
 58 |         structured=dict(type="json"),
 59 |     )
 60 |     # model = model.bind_tools(tools)
 61 |     # First get the raw response from the model
 62 |     ai_message = await model.ainvoke(system_prompt)
 63 | 
 64 |     # Clean the thinking content from the response
 65 |     message_content = (
 66 |         ai_message.content
 67 |         if isinstance(ai_message.content, str)
 68 |         else str(ai_message.content)
 69 |     )
 70 |     cleaned_content = clean_thinking_content(message_content)
 71 | 
 72 |     # Parse the cleaned JSON content
 73 |     strategy = parser.parse(cleaned_content)
 74 | 
 75 |     return {"strategy": strategy}
 76 |

 79 |     return [

 81 |             "provide_answer",
 82 |             {
 83 |                 "question": state["question"],
 84 |                 "instructions": s.instructions,
 85 |                 "term": s.term,
 86 |                 # "type": s.type,
 87 |             },
 88 |         )
 89 |         for s in state["strategy"].searches
 90 |     ]

 93 | async def provide_answer(state: SubGraphState, config: RunnableConfig) -> dict:
 94 |     payload = state
 95 |     # if state["type"] == "text":
 96 |     #     results = text_search(state["term"], 10, True, True)
 97 |     # else:
 98 |     results = await vector_search(state["term"], 10, True, True)
 99 |     if len(results) == 0:
100 |         return {"answers": []}
101 |     payload["results"] = results
102 |     ids = [r["id"] for r in results]
103 |     payload["ids"] = ids
104 |     system_prompt = Prompter(prompt_template="ask/query_process").render(data=payload)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
105 |     model = await provision_langchain_model(
106 |         system_prompt,
107 |         config.get("configurable", {}).get("answer_model"),
108 |         "tools",
109 |         max_tokens=2000,
110 |     )
111 |     ai_message = await model.ainvoke(system_prompt)
112 |     ai_content = (
113 |         ai_message.content
114 |         if isinstance(ai_message.content, str)
115 |         else str(ai_message.content)
116 |     )
117 |     return {"answers": [clean_thinking_content(ai_content)]}
118 | 
119 | 
120 | async def write_final_answer(state: ThreadState, config: RunnableConfig) -> dict:
121 |     system_prompt = Prompter(prompt_template="ask/final_answer").render(data=state)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
122 |     model = await provision_langchain_model(
123 |         system_prompt,
124 |         config.get("configurable", {}).get("final_answer_model"),
125 |         "tools",
126 |         max_tokens=2000,
127 |     )
128 |     ai_message = await model.ainvoke(system_prompt)
129 |     final_content = (
130 |         ai_message.content
131 |         if isinstance(ai_message.content, str)
132 |         else str(ai_message.content)
133 |     )
134 |     return {"final_answer": clean_thinking_content(final_content)}
135 | 
136 | 
137 | agent_state = StateGraph(ThreadState)
138 | agent_state.add_node("agent", call_model_with_messages)
139 | agent_state.add_node("provide_answer", provide_answer)
140 | agent_state.add_node("write_final_answer", write_final_answer)
141 | agent_state.add_edge(START, "agent")
142 | agent_state.add_conditional_edges("agent", trigger_queries, ["provide_answer"])
143 | agent_state.add_edge("provide_answer", "write_final_answer")
144 | agent_state.add_edge("write_final_answer", END)
145 | 
146 | graph = agent_state.compile()

  1 | # Locales Module (i18n)
  2 | 
  3 | Internationalization system providing multi-language UI support using i18next with type-safe translation access.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Architecture
  6 | 
  7 | ```
  8 | lib/
  9 | ├── i18n.ts              # i18next initialization and configuration
 10 | ├── i18n-events.ts       # Language change event emitters
 11 | ├── hooks/
 12 | │   └── use-translation.ts  # Custom hook with Proxy-based API
 13 | ├── utils/
 14 | │   └── date-locale.ts   # date-fns locale mapping
 15 | └── locales/
 16 |     ├── index.ts         # Locale registry and type exports
 17 |     ├── en-US/index.ts   # English translations
 18 |     ├── pt-BR/index.ts   # Brazilian Portuguese translations
 19 |     ├── zh-CN/index.ts   # Simplified Chinese translations
 20 |     ├── zh-TW/index.ts   # Traditional Chinese translations
 21 |     ├── ja-JP/index.ts   # Japanese translations
 22 |     └── ru-RU/index.ts   # Russian translations
 23 | ```
 24 | 
 25 | ## Key Components
 26 | 
 27 | - **`i18n.ts`**: i18next initialization with language detection (localStorage → browser)
 28 | - **`i18n-events.ts`**: Event emitters for language change start/end (used by loading overlay)
 29 | - **`locales/index.ts`**: Central registry exporting all locales and `LanguageCode` type
 30 | - **`use-translation.ts`**: Custom hook providing `t` object with nested property access
 31 | 
 32 | ## Translation Structure
 33 | 
 34 | Each locale file exports a flat object with nested keys:
 35 | 
 36 | ```typescript
 37 | export const enUS = {
 38 |   common: {
 39 |     save: 'Save',
 40 |     cancel: 'Cancel',
 41 |     delete: 'Delete',
 42 |     // ...
 43 |   },
 44 |   notebooks: {
 45 |     title: 'Notebooks',
 46 |     createNew: 'Create Notebook',
 47 |     // ...
 48 |   },
 49 |   // ... other sections
 50 | }
 51 | ```
 52 | 
 53 | **Sections**:
 54 | - `common`: Shared UI elements (buttons, labels, actions)
 55 | - `notebooks`, `sources`, `notes`: Feature-specific strings
 56 | - `chat`, `search`, `podcasts`: Module-specific strings
 57 | - `models`, `transformations`, `settings`: Configuration UI
 58 | - `advanced`: System administration strings
 59 | - `apiErrors`: Backend error message translations
 60 | 
 61 | ## Usage Pattern
 62 | 
 63 | ```typescript
 64 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 65 | 
 66 | function MyComponent() {
 67 |   const { t, language, setLanguage } = useTranslation()
 68 | 
 69 |   // Nested property access (Proxy-based)
 70 |   return <h1>{t.notebooks.title}</h1>
 71 | 
 72 |   // With interpolation
 73 |   return <p>{t.common.updated.replace('{time}', timeAgo)}</p>
 74 | 
 75 |   // Change language
 76 |   await setLanguage('zh-CN')
 77 | }
 78 | ```
 79 | 
 80 | ## Important Patterns
 81 | 
 82 | - **Proxy-based access**: `t.section.key` instead of `t('section.key')` for better DX
 83 | - **Type safety**: `TranslationKeys` type derived from `enUS` locale
 84 | - **Language persistence**: Saved to localStorage, auto-detected on load
 85 | - **Fallback**: Falls back to `en-US` if key missing in current locale
 86 | - **Date localization**: Use `getDateLocale(language)` from `utils/date-locale.ts`
 87 | 
 88 | ## Key Dependencies
 89 | 
 90 | - `i18next`: Core internationalization framework
 91 | - `react-i18next`: React bindings for i18next
 92 | - `i18next-browser-languagedetector`: Auto-detect browser language
 93 | - `date-fns/locale`: Date formatting locales
 94 | 
 95 | ## How to Add a New Language
 96 | 
 97 | 1. Create locale folder: `locales/pt-BR/index.ts`
 98 | 2. Copy structure from `en-US/index.ts` and translate all strings
 99 | 3. Register in `locales/index.ts`:
100 |    ```typescript
101 |    import { ptBR } from './pt-BR'
102 |    export const resources = {
103 |      // ...existing
104 |      'pt-BR': { translation: ptBR },
105 |    }
106 |    export const languages: Language[] = [
107 |      // ...existing
108 |      { code: 'pt-BR', label: 'Português' },
109 |    ]
110 |    ```
111 | 4. Add to `utils/date-locale.ts`:
112 |    ```typescript
113 |    import { ptBR } from 'date-fns/locale'
114 |    const LOCALE_MAP = { ...existing, 'pt-BR': ptBR }
115 |    ```
116 | 
117 | ## Important Quirks & Gotchas
118 | 
119 | - **Proxy depth limit**: `useTranslation` limits nesting to 4 levels to prevent infinite loops
120 | - **Blocked properties**: React internals (`__proto__`, `$$typeof`, etc.) are blocked from Proxy traversal
121 | - **Loop detection**: Access counts reset every 1s; >1000 accesses triggers error and breaks recursion
122 | - **String methods**: `.replace()`, `.split()` work on translated strings via Proxy magic
123 | - **Language change events**: `emitLanguageChangeStart/End` used by `LanguageLoadingOverlay` for UX
124 | - **No SSR**: `useSuspense: false` disables React Suspense for i18next (avoids hydration issues)
125 | - **All keys required**: Missing keys in non-English locales fall back to English; keep locales in sync
126 | 
127 | ## Testing Patterns
128 | 
129 | ```typescript
130 | // Mock useTranslation in tests (see test/setup.ts)
131 | vi.mock('@/lib/hooks/use-translation', () => ({
132 |   useTranslation: () => ({
133 |     t: enUS,  // Use English locale directly
134 |     language: 'en-US',
135 |     setLanguage: vi.fn(),
136 |   }),
137 | }))
138 | 
139 | // Test locale completeness
140 | import { enUS, zhCN } from '@/lib/locales'
141 | const enKeys = Object.keys(flatten(enUS))
142 | const zhKeys = Object.keys(flatten(zhCN))
143 | expect(zhKeys).toEqual(enKeys)  // All keys present
144 | ```
145 |

  1 | import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
  2 | import { transformationsApi } from '@/lib/api/transformations'
  3 | import { useToast } from '@/lib/hooks/use-toast'
  4 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
  5 | import { getApiErrorKey } from '@/lib/utils/error-handler'
  6 | import {
  7 |   CreateTransformationRequest,
  8 |   UpdateTransformationRequest,
  9 |   ExecuteTransformationRequest
 10 | } from '@/lib/types/transformations'
 11 | 
 12 | // Add to QUERY_KEYS in query-client.ts
 13 | export const TRANSFORMATION_QUERY_KEYS = {
 14 |   transformations: ['transformations'] as const,
 15 |   transformation: (id: string) => ['transformations', id] as const,
 16 |   defaultPrompt: ['transformations', 'default-prompt'] as const,
 17 | }
 18 | 
 19 | export function useTransformations() {
 20 |   return useQuery({
 21 |     queryKey: TRANSFORMATION_QUERY_KEYS.transformations,
 22 |     queryFn: () => transformationsApi.list(),
 23 |   })
 24 | }
 25 | 
 26 | export function useTransformation(id?: string, options?: { enabled?: boolean }) {
 27 |   const transformationId = id ?? ''
 28 |   return useQuery({
 29 |     queryKey: TRANSFORMATION_QUERY_KEYS.transformation(transformationId),
 30 |     queryFn: () => transformationsApi.get(transformationId),
 31 |     enabled: !!transformationId && (options?.enabled ?? true),
 32 |   })
 33 | }
 34 | 
 35 | export function useCreateTransformation() {
 36 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient()
 37 |   const { toast } = useToast()
 38 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 39 | 
 40 |   return useMutation({
 41 |     mutationFn: (data: CreateTransformationRequest) => transformationsApi.create(data),
 42 |     onSuccess: () => {
 43 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: TRANSFORMATION_QUERY_KEYS.transformations })
 44 |       toast({
 45 |         title: t.common.success,
 46 |         description: t.transformations.createSuccess,
 47 |       })
 48 |     },
 49 |     onError: (error: unknown) => {
 50 |       toast({
 51 |         title: t.common.error,
 52 |         description: t(getApiErrorKey(error, t.common.error)),
 53 |         variant: 'destructive',
 54 |       })
 55 |     },
 56 |   })
 57 | }

 75 | DEFINE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS fn::vector_search($query: array<float>, $match_count: int, $sources: bool, $show_notes: bool, $min_similarity: float) {

 77 |         IF $sources {(
 78 |             SELECT

 80 |                 source.title as title,

 83 |                 vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
 84 |             FROM source_embedding 
 85 |             WHERE vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) >= $min_similarity
 86 |             ORDER BY similarity DESC
 87 |             LIMIT $match_count
 88 |         )}
 89 |         ELSE { [] };
 90 | 
 91 |     let $source_insight_search = 
 92 |         IF $sources {(
 93 |             SELECT 
 94 |                 id,
 95 |                 insight_type + ' - ' + (source.title OR '') as title,
 96 |                 content,
 97 |                 source.id as parent_id,
 98 |                 vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
 99 |             FROM source_insight
100 |             WHERE vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) >= $min_similarity
101 |             ORDER BY similarity DESC
102 |             LIMIT $match_count
103 |         )}
104 |         ELSE { [] };
105 | 
106 | 
107 |     let $note_content_search = 
108 |         IF $show_notes {(
109 |             SELECT 
110 |                 id,
111 |                 title,
112 |                 content,
113 |                 id as parent_id,
114 |                 vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) as similarity
115 |             FROM note
116 |             WHERE vector::similarity::cosine(embedding, $query) >= $min_similarity
117 |             ORDER BY similarity DESC
118 |             LIMIT $match_count
119 |         )}
120 |         ELSE { [] };
121 | 
122 | 
123 |     let $all_results = array::union(
124 |         array::union($source_embedding_search, $source_insight_search),
125 |         $note_content_search
126 |     );
127 | 
128 | 
129 |     RETURN (select id, parent_id, title, math::max(similarity) as similarity,
130 |     array::flatten(content) as matches
131 |     from $all_results where id is not None
132 |     group by id, parent_id, title ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT $match_count);
133 | 
134 | };
