 89 | interface SourceTypeStepProps {
 90 |   control: Control<CreateSourceFormData>
 91 |   register: UseFormRegister<CreateSourceFormData>
 92 |   setValue: UseFormSetValue<CreateSourceFormData>
 93 |   errors: FieldErrors<CreateSourceFormData>
 94 |   urlValidationErrors?: { url: string; line: number }[]
 95 |   onClearUrlErrors?: () => void
 96 | }
 97 | 
 98 | const MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 50
 99 | 
100 | export function SourceTypeStep({ control, register, setValue, errors, urlValidationErrors, onClearUrlErrors }: SourceTypeStepProps) {
101 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
102 |   // Watch the selected type and inputs to detect batch mode
103 |   const selectedType = useWatch({ control, name: 'type' })
104 |   const urlInput = useWatch({ control, name: 'url' })
105 |   const fileInput = useWatch({ control, name: 'file' })
106 | 
107 |   // Track if HTML content was pasted
108 |   const [hasHtmlContent, setHasHtmlContent] = useState(false)
109 | 
110 |   // Handle paste event to check for HTML content in clipboard
111 |   const handleTextPaste = (event: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
112 |     const htmlContent = event.clipboardData.getData('text/html')
113 | 
114 |     // If HTML content is available, use it instead of plain text
115 |     if (htmlContent) {
116 |       event.preventDefault()
117 |       // Get current content and cursor position
118 |       const textarea = event.currentTarget
119 |       const start = textarea.selectionStart
120 |       const end = textarea.selectionEnd
121 |       const currentValue = textarea.value
122 | 
123 |       // Insert HTML content at cursor position (replacing selection if any)
124 |       const newValue = currentValue.substring(0, start) + htmlContent + currentValue.substring(end)
125 |       setValue('content', newValue, { shouldValidate: true })
126 |       setHasHtmlContent(true)
127 |     } else {
128 |       // Plain text paste - clear the HTML indicator
129 |       setHasHtmlContent(false)
130 |     }
131 |   }
132 | 
133 |   // Batch mode detection
134 |   const { isBatchMode, itemCount, urlCount, fileCount } = useMemo(() => {
135 |     let urlCount = 0
136 |     let fileCount = 0
137 | 
138 |     if (selectedType === 'link' && urlInput) {
139 |       const urls = parseUrls(urlInput)
140 |       urlCount = urls.length
141 |     }
142 | 
143 |     if (selectedType === 'upload' && fileInput) {
144 |       const fileList = fileInput as FileList
145 |       fileCount = fileList?.length || 0
146 |     }
147 | 
148 |     const isBatchMode = urlCount > 1 || fileCount > 1
149 |     const itemCount = selectedType === 'link' ? urlCount : fileCount
150 | 
151 |     return { isBatchMode, itemCount, urlCount, fileCount }
152 |   }, [selectedType, urlInput, fileInput])
153 | 
154 |   // Check for batch size limit
155 |   const isOverLimit = itemCount > MAX_BATCH_SIZE
156 |   return (
157 |     <div className="space-y-6">
158 |       <FormSection
159 |         title={t.sources.title}
160 |         description={t.sources.processDescription}
161 |       >
162 |         <Controller
163 |           control={control}
164 |           name="type"
165 |           render={({ field }) => (
166 |             <Tabs 
167 |               value={field.value || ''} 
168 |               onValueChange={(value) => field.onChange(value as 'link' | 'upload' | 'text')}
169 |               className="w-full"
170 |             >
171 |               <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
172 |                 {getSourceTypes(t).map((type) => {
173 |                   const Icon = type.icon
174 |                   return (
175 |                     <TabsTrigger key={type.value} value={type.value} className="gap-2">
176 |                       <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
177 |                       {type.label}
178 |                     </TabsTrigger>
179 |                   )
180 |                 })}
181 |               </TabsList>
182 |               
183 |               {getSourceTypes(t).map((type) => (
184 |                 <TabsContent key={type.value} value={type.value} className="mt-4">
185 |                   <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">{type.description}</p>
186 |                   
187 |                   {/* Type-specific fields */}
188 |                   {type.value === 'link' && (
189 |                     <div>
190 |                       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
191 |                         <Label htmlFor="url">{t.sources.urlLabel}</Label>
192 |                         {urlCount > 0 && (
193 |                           <Badge variant={isOverLimit ? "destructive" : "secondary"}>
194 |                             {t.sources.urlsCount.replace('{count}', urlCount.toString())}
195 |                             {isOverLimit && ` (${t.sources.maxItems.replace('{count}', MAX_BATCH_SIZE.toString())})`}
196 |                           </Badge>
197 |                         )}
198 |                       </div>
199 |                       <Textarea
200 |                         id="url"
201 |                         {...register('url', {
202 |                           onChange: () => onClearUrlErrors?.()
203 |                         })}
204 |                         placeholder={t.sources.enterUrlsPlaceholder}
205 |                         rows={urlCount > 1 ? 6 : 2}
206 |                         className="font-mono text-sm"
207 |                       />
208 |                       <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
209 |                         {t.sources.batchUrlHint}
210 |                       </p>
211 |                       {errors.url && (
212 |                         <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.url.message}</p>
213 |                       )}
214 |                       {urlValidationErrors && urlValidationErrors.length > 0 && (
215 |                         <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-destructive/10 rounded-md border border-destructive/20">
216 |                           <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive mb-2">
217 |                             {t.sources.invalidUrlsDetected}
218 |                           </p>
219 |                           <ul className="space-y-1">
220 |                             {urlValidationErrors.map((error, idx) => (
221 |                               <li key={idx} className="text-xs text-destructive flex items-start gap-2">
222 |                                 <span className="font-mono bg-destructive/20 px-1 rounded">
223 |                                   {t.sources.lineLabel.replace('{line}', error.line.toString())}
224 |                                 </span>
225 |                                 <span className="truncate">{error.url}</span>
226 |                               </li>
227 |                             ))}
228 |                           </ul>
229 |                           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
230 |                             {t.sources.fixInvalidUrls}
231 |                           </p>
232 |                         </div>
233 |                       )}
234 |                     </div>
235 |                   )}
236 |                   
237 |                   {type.value === 'upload' && (
238 |                     <div>
239 |                       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
240 |                         <Label htmlFor="file">{t.sources.fileLabel}</Label>
241 |                         {fileCount > 0 && (
242 |                           <Badge variant={isOverLimit ? "destructive" : "secondary"}>
243 |                             {t.sources.filesCount.replace('{count}', fileCount.toString())}
244 |                             {isOverLimit && ` (${t.sources.maxItems.replace('{count}', MAX_BATCH_SIZE.toString())})`}
245 |                           </Badge>
246 |                         )}
247 |                       </div>
248 |                       <Input
249 |                         id="file"
250 |                         type="file"
251 |                         multiple
252 |                         {...register('file')}
253 |                         accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.pptx,.ppt,.xlsx,.xls,.txt,.md,.epub,.mp4,.avi,.mov,.wmv,.mp3,.wav,.m4a,.aac,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.tiff,.zip,.tar,.gz,.html"
254 |                       />
255 |                       <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
256 |                         {t.sources.selectMultipleFilesHint}
257 |                       </p>
258 |                       {fileCount > 1 && fileInput instanceof FileList && (
259 |                         <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-muted rounded-md">
260 |                           <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-2">{t.sources.selectedFiles}</p>
261 |                           <ul className="space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto">
262 |                             {Array.from(fileInput).map((file, idx) => (
263 |                               <li key={idx} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
264 |                                 <FileIcon className="h-3 w-3" />
265 |                                 <span className="truncate">{file.name}</span>
266 |                                 <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">
267 |                                   ({(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)
268 |                                 </span>
269 |                               </li>
270 |                             ))}
271 |                           </ul>
272 |                         </div>
273 |                       )}
274 |                       {errors.file && (
275 |                         <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.file.message}</p>
276 |                       )}
277 |                       {isOverLimit && selectedType === 'upload' && (
278 |                         <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">
279 |                           {t.sources.maxFilesAllowed.replace('{count}', MAX_BATCH_SIZE.toString())}
280 |                         </p>
281 |                       )}
282 |                     </div>
283 |                   )}
284 |                   
285 |                   {type.value === 'text' && (
286 |                     <div>
287 |                       <Label htmlFor="content" className="mb-2 block">{t.sources.textContentLabel}</Label>
288 |                       {hasHtmlContent && (
289 |                         <div className="mb-2 p-2 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-md">
290 |                           <p className="text-sm text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
291 |                             {t.sources.htmlDetected}
292 |                           </p>
293 |                         </div>
294 |                       )}
295 |                       <Textarea
296 |                         id="content"
297 |                         {...register('content')}
298 |                         placeholder={t.sources.textPlaceholder}
299 |                         rows={6}
300 |                         onPaste={handleTextPaste}
301 |                       />
302 |                       {errors.content && (
303 |                         <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.content.message}</p>
304 |                       )}
305 |                     </div>
306 |                   )}
307 |                 </TabsContent>
308 |               ))}
309 |             </Tabs>
310 |           )}
311 |         />
312 |         {errors.type && (
313 |           <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.type.message}</p>
314 |         )}
315 |       </FormSection>
316 | 
317 |       {/* Hide title field in batch mode - titles will be auto-generated */}
318 |       {!isBatchMode && (
319 |         <FormSection
320 |           htmlFor="source-title"
321 |           title={selectedType === 'text' ? `${t.common.title} *` : `${t.common.title} (${t.common.optional})`}
322 |           description={selectedType === 'text'
323 |             ? t.sources.titleRequired
324 |             : t.sources.titleGenerated
325 |           }
326 |         >
327 |           <Input
328 |             id="source-title"
329 |             {...register('title')}
330 |             placeholder={t.sources.titlePlaceholder}
331 |             autoComplete="off"
332 |           />
333 |           {errors.title && (
334 |             <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.title.message}</p>
335 |           )}
336 |         </FormSection>
337 |       )}
338 | 
339 |       {/* Batch mode indicator */}
340 |       {isBatchMode && (
341 |         <div className="p-4 bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 rounded-lg">
342 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
343 |             <Badge variant="default">{t.common.batchMode}</Badge>
344 |             <span className="text-sm font-medium">
345 |               {t.sources.batchCount.replace('{count}', itemCount.toString()).replace('{type}', selectedType === 'link' ? t.sources.addUrl : t.sources.uploadFile)}
346 |             </span>
347 |           </div>
348 |           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
349 |             {t.sources.batchTitlesAuto}
350 |             {t.sources.batchCommonSettings}
351 |           </p>
352 |         </div>
353 |       )}
354 |     </div>
355 |   )
356 | }

 23 | # ============================================================================

 27 | 
 28 | class TestRecordModelSingleton:
 29 |     """Test suite for RecordModel singleton behavior."""
 30 | 
 31 |     def test_recordmodel_singleton_behavior(self):
 32 |         """Test that same instance is returned for same record_id."""
 33 | 
 34 |         class TestRecord(RecordModel):
 35 |             record_id = "test:singleton"
 36 |             value: int = 0
 37 | 
 38 |         # Clear any existing instance
 39 |         TestRecord.clear_instance()
 40 | 
 41 |         # Create first instance
 42 |         instance1 = TestRecord(value=42)
 43 |         assert instance1.value == 42
 44 | 
 45 |         # Create second instance - should return same object
 46 |         instance2 = TestRecord(value=99)
 47 |         assert instance1 is instance2
 48 |         assert instance2.value == 99  # Value was updated
 49 | 
 50 |         # Cleanup
 51 |         TestRecord.clear_instance()

128 |         """Test that deleting a source removes the associated file."""

132 |             tmp_path = Path(tmp_file.name)

144 | 
145 |             # Mock the parent delete method to avoid database operations
146 |             with patch.object(

  1 | """
  2 | Chunking utilities for Open Notebook.
  3 | 
  4 | Provides content-type detection and smart text chunking for embedding operations.
  5 | Supports HTML, Markdown, and plain text with appropriate splitters for each type.
  6 | 
  7 | Key functions:
  8 | - detect_content_type(): Detects content type from file extension or content heuristics
  9 | - chunk_text(): Splits text into chunks using appropriate splitter for content type
 10 | 
 11 | Environment Variables:
 12 |     OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_SIZE: Maximum chunk size in characters (default: 1200)
 13 |     OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_OVERLAP: Overlap between chunks in characters (default: 15% of CHUNK_SIZE)
 14 | """
 15 | 
 16 | import os
 17 | import re
 18 | from enum import Enum
 19 | from pathlib import Path
 20 | from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
 21 | 
 22 | from langchain_text_splitters import (
 23 |     HTMLHeaderTextSplitter,
 24 |     MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter,
 25 |     RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter,
 26 | )
 27 | from loguru import logger
 28 | 
 29 | 
 30 | def _get_chunk_size() -> int:
 31 |     """Get chunk size from environment variable or use default."""
 32 |     chunk_size_str = os.getenv("OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_SIZE")
 33 |     if chunk_size_str:
 34 |         try:
 35 |             chunk_size = int(chunk_size_str)
 36 |             if chunk_size < 100:
 37 |                 logger.warning(
 38 |                     f"OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_SIZE ({chunk_size}) is too small. "
 39 |                     f"Using minimum value of 100."
 40 |                 )
 41 |                 return 100
 42 |             if chunk_size > 8192:
 43 |                 logger.warning(
 44 |                     f"OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_SIZE ({chunk_size}) is very large. "
 45 |                     f"This may cause issues with some embedding models."
 46 |                 )
 47 |             logger.info(f"Using custom chunk size: {chunk_size} characters")
 48 |             return chunk_size
 49 |         except ValueError:
 50 |             logger.warning(
 51 |                 f"Invalid OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_SIZE value: '{chunk_size_str}'. "
 52 |                 f"Using default: 1200"
 53 |             )
 54 |     return 1200
 55 | 
 56 | 
 57 | def _get_chunk_overlap(chunk_size: int) -> int:
 58 |     """Get chunk overlap from environment variable or calculate default (15% of chunk size)."""
 59 |     overlap_str = os.getenv("OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_OVERLAP")
 60 |     if overlap_str:
 61 |         try:
 62 |             overlap = int(overlap_str)
 63 |             if overlap < 0:
 64 |                 logger.warning(
 65 |                     f"OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_OVERLAP ({overlap}) cannot be negative. "
 66 |                     f"Using 0."
 67 |                 )
 68 |                 return 0
 69 |             if overlap >= chunk_size:
 70 |                 logger.warning(
 71 |                     f"OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_OVERLAP ({overlap}) cannot be >= chunk size ({chunk_size}). "
 72 |                     f"Using 15% of chunk size: {int(chunk_size * 0.15)}"
 73 |                 )
 74 |                 return int(chunk_size * 0.15)
 75 |             logger.info(f"Using custom chunk overlap: {overlap} characters")
 76 |             return overlap
 77 |         except ValueError:
 78 |             logger.warning(
 79 |                 f"Invalid OPEN_NOTEBOOK_CHUNK_OVERLAP value: '{overlap_str}'. "
 80 |                 f"Using default: 15% of chunk size"
 81 |             )
 82 |     return int(chunk_size * 0.15)
 83 | 
 84 | 
 85 | # Constants (computed at import time from environment variables)
 86 | CHUNK_SIZE = _get_chunk_size()
 87 | CHUNK_OVERLAP = _get_chunk_overlap(CHUNK_SIZE)
 88 | HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.8  # Threshold for heuristics to override extension
 89 | 
 90 | logger.debug(
 91 |     f"Chunking configuration: CHUNK_SIZE={CHUNK_SIZE}, CHUNK_OVERLAP={CHUNK_OVERLAP}"
 92 | )
 93 | 
 94 | 
 95 | class ContentType(Enum):
 96 |     """Content type for chunking strategy selection."""
 97 | 
 98 |     HTML = "html"
 99 |     MARKDOWN = "markdown"
100 |     PLAIN = "plain"
101 | 
102 | 
103 | # File extension mappings
104 | _EXTENSION_TO_CONTENT_TYPE = {
105 |     # HTML
106 |     ".html": ContentType.HTML,
107 |     ".htm": ContentType.HTML,
108 |     ".xhtml": ContentType.HTML,
109 |     # Markdown
110 |     ".md": ContentType.MARKDOWN,
111 |     ".markdown": ContentType.MARKDOWN,
112 |     ".mdown": ContentType.MARKDOWN,
113 |     ".mkd": ContentType.MARKDOWN,
114 |     # Plain text (explicit)
115 |     ".txt": ContentType.PLAIN,
116 |     ".text": ContentType.PLAIN,
117 |     # Code files (treat as plain)
118 |     ".py": ContentType.PLAIN,
119 |     ".js": ContentType.PLAIN,
120 |     ".ts": ContentType.PLAIN,
121 |     ".java": ContentType.PLAIN,
122 |     ".c": ContentType.PLAIN,
123 |     ".cpp": ContentType.PLAIN,
124 |     ".go": ContentType.PLAIN,
125 |     ".rs": ContentType.PLAIN,
126 |     ".rb": ContentType.PLAIN,
127 |     ".php": ContentType.PLAIN,
128 |     ".sh": ContentType.PLAIN,
129 |     ".bash": ContentType.PLAIN,
130 |     ".zsh": ContentType.PLAIN,
131 |     ".sql": ContentType.PLAIN,
132 |     ".json": ContentType.PLAIN,
133 |     ".yaml": ContentType.PLAIN,
134 |     ".yml": ContentType.PLAIN,
135 |     ".xml": ContentType.PLAIN,
136 |     ".csv": ContentType.PLAIN,
137 |     ".tsv": ContentType.PLAIN,
138 | }
139 | 
140 | 
141 | def detect_content_type_from_extension(
142 |     file_path: Optional[str],
143 | ) -> Optional[ContentType]:
144 |     """
145 |     Detect content type from file extension.
146 | 
147 |     Args:
148 |         file_path: Path to the file (can be full path or just filename)
149 | 
150 |     Returns:
151 |         ContentType if extension is recognized, None otherwise
152 |     """
153 |     if not file_path:
154 |         return None
155 | 
156 |     try:
157 |         extension = Path(file_path).suffix.lower()
158 |         return _EXTENSION_TO_CONTENT_TYPE.get(extension)
159 |     except Exception:
160 |         return None
161 | 
162 | 
163 | def detect_content_type_from_heuristics(text: str) -> Tuple[ContentType, float]:
164 |     """
165 |     Detect content type using content heuristics.
166 | 
167 |     Args:
168 |         text: The text content to analyze
169 | 
170 |     Returns:
171 |         Tuple of (ContentType, confidence_score) where confidence is 0.0-1.0
172 |     """
173 |     if not text or len(text) < 10:
174 |         return ContentType.PLAIN, 0.5
175 | 
176 |     # Sample first 5000 chars for efficiency
177 |     sample = text[:5000]
178 | 
179 |     # Check HTML first (most specific patterns)
180 |     html_score = _calculate_html_score(sample)
181 |     if html_score >= HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
182 |         return ContentType.HTML, html_score
183 | 
184 |     # Check Markdown
185 |     markdown_score = _calculate_markdown_score(sample)
186 |     if markdown_score >= HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
187 |         return ContentType.MARKDOWN, markdown_score
188 | 
189 |     # Return the higher scoring type, or PLAIN if both are low
190 |     if html_score > markdown_score and html_score > 0.3:
191 |         return ContentType.HTML, html_score
192 |     elif markdown_score > 0.3:
193 |         return ContentType.MARKDOWN, markdown_score
194 |     else:
195 |         return ContentType.PLAIN, 0.6
196 | 
197 | 
198 | def _calculate_html_score(text: str) -> float:
199 |     """Calculate confidence score for HTML content."""
200 |     score = 0.0
201 |     indicators = 0
202 | 
203 |     # Strong indicators
204 |     if re.search(r"<!DOCTYPE\s+html", text, re.IGNORECASE):
205 |         score += 0.4
206 |         indicators += 1
207 | 
208 |     if re.search(r"<html[\s>]", text, re.IGNORECASE):
209 |         score += 0.3
210 |         indicators += 1
211 | 
212 |     # Structural tags
213 |     structural_tags = ["<head", "<body", "<div", "<span", "<p>", "<table", "<form"]
214 |     for tag in structural_tags:
215 |         if tag.lower() in text.lower():
216 |             score += 0.1
217 |             indicators += 1
218 |             if indicators >= 5:
219 |                 break
220 | 
221 |     # Header tags
222 |     if re.search(r"<h[1-6][\s>]", text, re.IGNORECASE):
223 |         score += 0.15
224 |         indicators += 1
225 | 
226 |     # Closing tags pattern
227 |     if re.search(r"</\w+>", text):
228 |         score += 0.1
229 |         indicators += 1
230 | 
231 |     return min(score, 1.0)
232 | 
233 | 
234 | def _calculate_markdown_score(text: str) -> float:
235 |     """Calculate confidence score for Markdown content."""
236 |     score = 0.0
237 |     indicators = 0
238 | 
239 |     # Headers (# ## ###) - strong indicator
240 |     header_matches = len(re.findall(r"^#{1,6}\s+.+", text, re.MULTILINE))
241 |     if header_matches >= 3:
242 |         score += 0.35
243 |         indicators += 1
244 |     elif header_matches >= 1:
245 |         score += 0.2
246 |         indicators += 1
247 | 
248 |     # Links [text](url) - strong indicator
249 |     link_matches = len(re.findall(r"\[.+?\]\(.+?\)", text))
250 |     if link_matches >= 2:
251 |         score += 0.25
252 |         indicators += 1
253 |     elif link_matches >= 1:
254 |         score += 0.15
255 |         indicators += 1
256 | 
257 |     # Code blocks ``` - strong indicator
258 |     if re.search(r"^```", text, re.MULTILINE):
259 |         score += 0.2
260 |         indicators += 1
261 | 
262 |     # Inline code `code`
263 |     if re.search(r"`[^`]+`", text):
264 |         score += 0.1
265 |         indicators += 1
266 | 
267 |     # Lists (-, *, +, or numbered)
268 |     list_matches = len(re.findall(r"^[\*\-\+]\s+", text, re.MULTILINE))
269 |     list_matches += len(re.findall(r"^\d+\.\s+", text, re.MULTILINE))
270 |     if list_matches >= 3:
271 |         score += 0.15
272 |         indicators += 1
273 |     elif list_matches >= 1:
274 |         score += 0.08
275 |         indicators += 1
276 | 
277 |     # Bold/italic
278 |     if re.search(r"\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__", text):
279 |         score += 0.1
280 |         indicators += 1
281 | 
282 |     # Blockquotes
283 |     if re.search(r"^>\s+", text, re.MULTILINE):
284 |         score += 0.1
285 |         indicators += 1
286 | 
287 |     return min(score, 1.0)
288 | 
289 | 
290 | def detect_content_type(text: str, file_path: Optional[str] = None) -> ContentType:
291 |     """
292 |     Detect content type using file extension (primary) and heuristics (fallback).
293 | 
294 |     Strategy:
295 |     1. If file extension is available and recognized, use it as primary
296 |     2. If no extension or generic extension (.txt), use heuristics
297 |     3. Heuristics can override extension only with very high confidence
298 | 
299 |     Args:
300 |         text: The text content
301 |         file_path: Optional file path for extension-based detection
302 | 
303 |     Returns:
304 |         Detected ContentType
305 |     """
306 |     # Try extension-based detection first
307 |     extension_type = detect_content_type_from_extension(file_path)
308 | 
309 |     # Get heuristic-based detection
310 |     heuristic_type, confidence = detect_content_type_from_heuristics(text)
311 | 
312 |     # If no extension or generic extension, use heuristics
313 |     if extension_type is None:
314 |         logger.debug(
315 |             f"No file extension, using heuristics: {heuristic_type.value} "
316 |             f"(confidence: {confidence:.2f})"
317 |         )
318 |         return heuristic_type
319 | 
320 |     # If extension suggests plain text but heuristics are very confident, override
321 |     if extension_type == ContentType.PLAIN and confidence >= HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
322 |         logger.debug(
323 |             f"Extension suggests plain, but heuristics override with "
324 |             f"{heuristic_type.value} (confidence: {confidence:.2f})"
325 |         )
326 |         return heuristic_type
327 | 
328 |     # Otherwise trust the extension
329 |     logger.debug(f"Using extension-based content type: {extension_type.value}")
330 |     return extension_type
331 | 
332 | 
333 | def _get_html_splitter() -> HTMLHeaderTextSplitter:
334 |     """Get HTML header splitter configured for h1, h2, h3."""
335 |     headers_to_split_on = [
336 |         ("h1", "Header 1"),
337 |         ("h2", "Header 2"),
338 |         ("h3", "Header 3"),
339 |     ]
340 |     return HTMLHeaderTextSplitter(headers_to_split_on=headers_to_split_on)
341 | 
342 | 
343 | def _get_markdown_splitter() -> MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter:
344 |     """Get Markdown header splitter configured for #, ##, ###."""
345 |     headers_to_split_on = [
346 |         ("#", "Header 1"),
347 |         ("##", "Header 2"),
348 |         ("###", "Header 3"),
349 |     ]
350 |     return MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter(
351 |         headers_to_split_on=headers_to_split_on,
352 |         strip_headers=False,
353 |     )
354 | 
355 | 
356 | def _get_plain_splitter() -> RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter:
357 |     """Get plain text splitter using CHUNK_SIZE and CHUNK_OVERLAP constants."""
358 |     return RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
359 |         chunk_size=CHUNK_SIZE,
360 |         chunk_overlap=CHUNK_OVERLAP,
361 |         length_function=len,
362 |         separators=["\n\n", "\n", ". ", ", ", " ", ""],
363 |     )
364 | 
365 | 
366 | def _apply_secondary_chunking(chunks: List[str]) -> List[str]:
367 |     """
368 |     Apply secondary chunking to ensure no chunk exceeds CHUNK_SIZE.
369 | 
370 |     Used when primary splitters (HTML/Markdown) produce oversized chunks.
371 |     """
372 |     result = []
373 |     secondary_splitter = _get_plain_splitter()
374 | 
375 |     for chunk in chunks:
376 |         if len(chunk) > CHUNK_SIZE:
377 |             # Split oversized chunk
378 |             sub_chunks = secondary_splitter.split_text(chunk)
379 |             result.extend(sub_chunks)
380 |         else:
381 |             result.append(chunk)
382 | 
383 |     return result
384 | 
385 | 
386 | def chunk_text(
387 |     text: str,
388 |     content_type: Optional[ContentType] = None,
389 |     file_path: Optional[str] = None,
390 | ) -> List[str]:
391 |     """
392 |     Split text into chunks using appropriate splitter for content type.
393 | 
394 |     Args:
395 |         text: The text to chunk
396 |         content_type: Optional explicit content type (auto-detected if not provided)
397 |         file_path: Optional file path for content type detection
398 | 
399 |     Returns:
400 |         List of text chunks, each <= CHUNK_SIZE characters
401 |     """
402 |     if not text or not text.strip():
403 |         return []
404 | 
405 |     # Short text doesn't need chunking
406 |     if len(text) <= CHUNK_SIZE:
407 |         return [text]
408 | 
409 |     # Detect content type if not provided
410 |     if content_type is None:
411 |         content_type = detect_content_type(text, file_path)
412 | 
413 |     logger.debug(f"Chunking text with content type: {content_type.value}")
414 | 
415 |     # Select appropriate splitter
416 |     if content_type == ContentType.HTML:
417 |         splitter = _get_html_splitter()
418 |         # HTML splitter returns Document objects
419 |         docs = splitter.split_text(text)
420 |         chunks = [
421 |             doc.page_content if hasattr(doc, "page_content") else str(doc)
422 |             for doc in docs
423 |         ]
424 |     elif content_type == ContentType.MARKDOWN:
425 |         splitter = _get_markdown_splitter()
426 |         # Markdown splitter returns Document objects
427 |         docs = splitter.split_text(text)
428 |         chunks = [
429 |             doc.page_content if hasattr(doc, "page_content") else str(doc)
430 |             for doc in docs
431 |         ]
432 |     else:
433 |         # Plain text - use recursive splitter directly
434 |         splitter = _get_plain_splitter()
435 |         chunks = splitter.split_text(text)
436 | 
437 |     # Apply secondary chunking if needed (for HTML/Markdown that may produce large chunks)
438 |     if content_type in (ContentType.HTML, ContentType.MARKDOWN):
439 |         chunks = _apply_secondary_chunking(chunks)
440 | 
441 |     # Filter out empty chunks
442 |     chunks = [c.strip() for c in chunks if c and c.strip()]
443 | 
444 |     logger.debug(f"Created {len(chunks)} chunks from {len(text)} characters")
445 |     return chunks
446 |

/docs/3-USER-GUIDE/chat-effectively.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # Chat Effectively - Conversations with Your Research
  2 | 
  3 | Chat is your main tool for exploratory questions and back-and-forth dialogue. This guide covers how to use it effectively.
  4 | 
  5 | ---
  6 | 
  7 | ## Quick-Start: Your First Chat
  8 | 
  9 | ```
 10 | 1. Go to your notebook
 11 | 2. Click "Chat"
 12 | 3. Select which sources to include (context)
 13 | 4. Type your question
 14 | 5. Click "Send"
 15 | 6. Read the response
 16 | 7. Ask a follow-up (context stays same)
 17 | 8. Repeat until satisfied
 18 | ```
 19 | 
 20 | That's it! But doing it *well* requires understanding how context works.
 21 | 
 22 | ---
 23 | 
 24 | ## Context Management: The Key to Good Chat
 25 | 
 26 | Context controls **what the AI is allowed to see**. This is your most important control.
 27 | 
 28 | ### The Three Levels Explained
 29 | 
 30 | **FULL CONTENT**
 31 | - AI sees: Complete source text
 32 | - Cost: 100 tokens per 1K tokens of source
 33 | - Best for: Detailed analysis, precise citations
 34 | - Example: "Analyze this research paper closely"
 35 | 
 36 | ```
 37 | You set: Paper A → Full Content
 38 | AI sees: Every word of Paper A
 39 | AI can: Cite specific sentences, notice nuances
 40 | Result: Precise, detailed answers (higher cost)
 41 | ```
 42 | 
 43 | **SUMMARY ONLY**
 44 | - AI sees: AI-generated 200-word summary (not full text)
 45 | - Cost: ~10-20% of full content cost
 46 | - Best for: Background material, reference context
 47 | - Example: "Use this for background, focus on the main paper"
 48 | 
 49 | ```
 50 | You set: Paper B → Summary Only
 51 | AI sees: Condensed summary, key points
 52 | AI can: Reference main ideas but not details
 53 | Result: Faster, cheaper answers (loses precision)
 54 | ```
 55 | 
 56 | **NOT IN CONTEXT**
 57 | - AI sees: Nothing
 58 | - Cost: 0 tokens
 59 | - Best for: Confidential, irrelevant, archived content
 60 | - Example: "Keep this in notebook but don't use now"
 61 | 
 62 | ```
 63 | You set: Paper C → Not in Context
 64 | AI sees: Nothing (completely excluded)
 65 | AI can: Never reference it
 66 | Result: No cost, no privacy risk for that source
 67 | ```
 68 | 
 69 | ### Setting Context (Step by Step)
 70 | 
 71 | ```
 72 | 1. Click "Select Sources"
 73 |    (Shows list of all sources in notebook)
 74 | 
 75 | 2. For each source:
 76 |    □ Checkbox: Include or exclude
 77 | 
 78 |    Level dropdown:
 79 |    ├─ Full Content
 80 |    ├─ Summary Only
 81 |    └─ Excluded
 82 | 
 83 | 3. Check your selections
 84 |    Example:
 85 |    ✓ Paper A (Full Content) - "Main focus"
 86 |    ✓ Paper B (Summary Only) - "Background"
 87 |    ✓ Paper C (Excluded) - "Keep private"
 88 |    □ Paper D (Not included) - "Not relevant"
 89 | 
 90 | 4. Click "Save Context"
 91 | 
 92 | 5. Now chat uses these settings
 93 | ```
 94 | 
 95 | ### Context Strategies
 96 | 
 97 | **Strategy 1: Minimalist**
 98 | - Main source: Full Content
 99 | - Everything else: Excluded
100 | - Result: Focused, cheap, precise
101 | 
102 | ```
103 | Use when:
104 |   - Analyzing one source deeply
105 |   - Budget-conscious
106 |   - Want focused answers
107 | ```
108 | 
109 | **Strategy 2: Comprehensive**
110 | - All sources: Full Content
111 | - Result: All context considered, expensive
112 | 
113 | ```
114 | Use when:
115 |   - Comprehensive analysis
116 |   - Unlimited budget
117 |   - Want AI to see everything
118 | ```
119 | 
120 | **Strategy 3: Tiered**
121 | - Primary sources: Full Content
122 | - Secondary sources: Summary Only
123 | - Background/reference: Excluded
124 | - Result: Balanced cost/quality
125 | 
126 | ```
127 | Use when:
128 |   - Mix of important and reference material
129 |   - Want thorough but not expensive
130 |   - Most common strategy
131 | ```
132 | 
133 | **Strategy 4: Privacy-First**
134 | - Sensitive docs: Excluded
135 | - Public research: Full Content
136 | - Result: Never send confidential data
137 | 
138 | ```
139 | Use when:
140 |   - Company confidential materials
141 |   - Personal sensitive data
142 |   - Complying with data protection
143 | ```
144 | 
145 | ---
146 | 
147 | ## Asking Effective Questions
148 | 
149 | ### Good Questions vs. Poor Questions
150 | 
151 | **Poor Question**
152 | ```
153 | "What do you think?"
154 | 
155 | Problems:
156 | - Too vague (about what?)
157 | - No context (what am I analyzing?)
158 | - Can't verify answer (citing what?)
159 | 
160 | Result: Generic, shallow answer
161 | ```
162 | 
163 | **Good Question**
164 | ```
165 | "Based on the paper's methodology section,
166 | what are the three main limitations the authors acknowledge?
167 | Please cite which pages mention each one."
168 | 
169 | Strengths:
170 | - Specific about what you want
171 | - Clear scope (methodology section)
172 | - Asks for citations
173 | - Requires deep reading
174 | 
175 | Result: Precise, verifiable, useful answer
176 | ```
177 | 
178 | ### Question Patterns That Work
179 | 
180 | **Factual Questions**
181 | ```
182 | "What does the paper say about X?"
183 | "Who are the authors?"
184 | "What year was this published?"
185 | 
186 | Result: Simple, factual answers with citations
187 | ```
188 | 
189 | **Analysis Questions**
190 | ```
191 | "How does this approach differ from the traditional method?"
192 | "What are the main assumptions underlying this argument?"
193 | "Why do you think the author chose this methodology?"
194 | 
195 | Result: Deeper thinking, comparison, critique
196 | ```
197 | 
198 | **Synthesis Questions**
199 | ```
200 | "How do these two sources approach the problem differently?"
201 | "What's the common theme across all three papers?"
202 | "If we combine these approaches, what would we get?"
203 | 
204 | Result: Cross-source insights, connections
205 | ```
206 | 
207 | **Actionable Questions**
208 | ```
209 | "What are the practical implications of this research?"
210 | "How could we apply these findings to our situation?"
211 | "What's the next logical research direction?"
212 | 
213 | Result: Practical, forward-looking answers
214 | ```
215 | 
216 | ### The SPECIFIC Formula
217 | 
218 | Good questions have:
219 | 
220 | 1. **SCOPE** - What are you analyzing?
221 |    "In this research paper..."
222 |    "Looking at these three articles..."
223 |    "Based on your experience..."
224 | 
225 | 2. **SPECIFICITY** - Exactly what do you want?
226 |    "...the methodology..."
227 |    "...main findings..."
228 |    "...recommended next steps..."
229 | 
230 | 3. **CONSTRAINT** - Any limits?
231 |    "...in 3 bullet points..."
232 |    "...with citations to page numbers..."
233 |    "...comparing these two approaches..."
234 | 
235 | 4. **VERIFICATION** - How can you check it?
236 |    "...with specific quotes..."
237 |    "...cite your sources..."
238 |    "...link to the relevant section..."
239 | 
240 | **Example:**
241 | ```
242 | Poor: "What about transformers?"
243 | Good: "In this research paper on machine learning,
244 |       explain the transformer architecture in 2-3 sentences,
245 |       then cite which page describes the attention mechanism."
246 | ```
247 | 
248 | ---
249 | 
250 | ## Follow-Up Questions (The Real Power of Chat)
251 | 
252 | Chat's strength is dialogue. You ask, get an answer, ask more.
253 | 
254 | ### Building on Responses
255 | 
256 | ```
257 | First question:
258 | "What's the main finding?"
259 | 
260 | AI: "The study shows X [citation]"
261 | 
262 | Follow-up question:
263 | "How does that compare to Y research?"
264 | 
265 | AI: "The key difference is Z [citation]"
266 | 
267 | Next question:
268 | "Why do you think that difference matters?"
269 | 
270 | AI: "Because it affects A, B, C [explained]"
271 | ```
272 | 
273 | ### Iterating Toward Understanding
274 | 
275 | ```
276 | Round 1: Get overview
277 | "What's this source about?"
278 | 
279 | Round 2: Get details
280 | "What's the most important part?"
281 | 
282 | Round 3: Compare
283 | "How does it relate to my notes on X?"
284 | 
285 | Round 4: Apply
286 | "What should I do with this information?"
287 | ```
288 | 
289 | ### Changing Direction
290 | 
291 | ```
292 | Context stays same, but you ask new questions:
293 | 
294 | Question 1: "What's the methodology?"
295 | Question 2: "What are the limitations?"
296 | Question 3: "What about the ethical implications?"
297 | Question 4: "Who else has done similar work?"
298 | 
299 | All in one conversation, reusing context.
300 | ```
301 | 
302 | ### Adjusting Context Between Rounds
303 | 
304 | ```
305 | After question 3, you realize:
306 | "I need more context from another source"
307 | 
308 | 1. Click "Adjust Context"
309 | 2. Add new source or change context level
310 | 3. Your conversation history stays
311 | 4. Continue asking with new context
312 | ```
313 | 
314 | ---
315 | 
316 | ## Citations and Verification
317 | 
318 | Citations are how you verify that the AI's answer is accurate.
319 | 
320 | ### Understanding Citations
321 | 
322 | ```
323 | AI Response with Citation:
324 | "The paper reports a 95% accuracy rate [see page 12]"
325 | 
326 | What this means:
327 | ✓ The claim "95% accuracy rate" is from page 12
328 | ✓ You can verify by reading page 12
329 | ✓ If page 12 doesn't say that, the AI hallucinated
330 | ```
331 | 
332 | ### Requesting Better Citations
333 | 
334 | ```
335 | If you get a response without citations:
336 | 
337 | Ask: "Please cite the page number for that claim"
338 | or: "Show me where you found that information"
339 | 
340 | AI will:
341 | - Find the citation
342 | - Provide page numbers
343 | - Show you the source
344 | ```
345 | 
346 | ### Verification Workflow
347 | 
348 | ```
349 | 1. Get answer from Chat
350 | 2. Check citation (which source? which page?)
351 | 3. Click citation link (if available)
352 | 4. See the actual text in source
353 | 5. Does it really say what AI claimed?
354 | 
355 | If YES: Great, you can use this answer
356 | If NO: The AI hallucinated, ask for correction
357 | ```
358 | 
359 | ---
360 | 
361 | ## Common Chat Patterns
362 | 
363 | ### Pattern 1: Deep Dive into One Source
364 | 
365 | ```
366 | 1. Set context: One source (Full Content)
367 | 2. Question 1: Overview
368 | 3. Question 2: Main argument
369 | 4. Question 3: Evidence for argument
370 | 5. Question 4: Limitations
371 | 6. Question 5: Next steps
372 | 
373 | Result: Complete understanding of one source
374 | ```
375 | 
376 | ### Pattern 2: Comparative Analysis
377 | 
378 | ```
379 | 1. Set context: 2-3 sources (all Full Content)
380 | 2. Question 1: What does each source say about X?
381 | 3. Question 2: How do they agree?
382 | 4. Question 3: How do they disagree?
383 | 5. Question 4: Which approach is stronger?
384 | 
385 | Result: Understanding differences and trade-offs
386 | ```
387 | 
388 | ### Pattern 3: Research Exploration
389 | 
390 | ```
391 | 1. Set context: Many sources (mix of Full/Summary)
392 | 2. Question 1: What are the main perspectives?
393 | 3. Question 2: What's missing from these views?
394 | 4. Question 3: What questions does this raise?
395 | 5. Question 4: What should I research next?
396 | 
397 | Result: Understanding landscape and gaps
398 | ```
399 | 
400 | ### Pattern 4: Problem Solving
401 | 
402 | ```
403 | 1. Set context: Relevant sources (Full Content)
404 | 2. Question 1: What's the problem?
405 | 3. Question 2: What approaches exist?
406 | 4. Question 3: Pros and cons of each?
407 | 5. Question 4: Which would work best for [my situation]?
408 | 
409 | Result: Decision-making informed by research
410 | ```
411 | 
412 | ---
413 | 
414 | ## Optimizing for Cost
415 | 
416 | Chat uses tokens for every response. Here's how to use efficiently:
417 | 
418 | ### Reduce Token Usage
419 | 
420 | **Minimize context**
421 | ```
422 | Option A: All sources, Full Content
423 |   Cost per response: 5,000 tokens
424 | 
425 | Option B: Only relevant sources, Summary Only
426 |   Cost per response: 1,000 tokens
427 | 
428 | Savings: 80% cheaper, same conversation
429 | ```
430 | 
431 | **Shorter questions**
432 | ```
433 | Verbose: "Could you please analyze the methodology
434 |          section of this paper and explain in detail
435 |          what the authors did?"
436 | 
437 | Concise: "Summarize the methodology in 2-3 points."
438 | 
439 | Savings: 20-30% per response
440 | ```
441 | 
442 | **Use cheaper models**
443 | ```
444 | GPT-4o: $0.15 per 1M input tokens
445 | GPT-4o-mini: $0.03 per 1M input tokens
446 | Claude Sonnet: $0.90 per 1M input tokens
447 | 
448 | For chat: Mini/Haiku models are usually fine
449 | For deep analysis: Sonnet/Opus worth the cost
450 | ```
451 | 
452 | ### Budget Strategies
453 | 
454 | **Exploration budget**
455 | - Use cheap model
456 | - Broad context (understand landscape)
457 | - Short questions
458 | - Result: Low cost, good overview
459 | 
460 | **Analysis budget**
461 | - Use powerful model
462 | - Focused context (main source only)
463 | - Detailed questions
464 | - Result: Higher cost, deep insights
465 | 
466 | **Synthesis budget**
467 | - Use powerful model for final synthesis
468 | - Multiple sources (Full Content)
469 | - Complex comparative questions
470 | - Result: Expensive but valuable output
471 | 
472 | ---
473 | 
474 | ## Troubleshooting Chat Issues
475 | 
476 | ### Poor Responses
477 | 
478 | | Problem | Cause | Solution |
479 | |---------|-------|----------|
480 | | Generic answers | Vague question | Be specific (see question patterns) |
481 | | Missing context | Not enough in context | Add sources or change to Full Content |
482 | | Incorrect info | Source not in context | Add the relevant source |
483 | | Hallucinating | Model confused | Ask for citations, verify claims |
484 | | Shallow analysis | Wrong model | Switch to more powerful model |
485 | 
486 | ### High Costs
487 | 
488 | | Problem | Cause | Solution |
489 | |---------|-------|----------|
490 | | Expensive per response | Too much context | Use Summary Only or exclude sources |
491 | | Many follow-ups | Exploratory chat | Use Ask instead for single comprehensive answer |
492 | | Long conversations | Keeping history | Archive old chats, start fresh |
493 | | Large sources | Full text in context | Use Summary Only for large documents |
494 | 
495 | ---
496 | 
497 | ## Best Practices
498 | 
499 | ### Before You Chat
500 | 
501 | - [ ] Add sources you'll need
502 | - [ ] Decide context strategy (Tiered is usually best)
503 | - [ ] Choose model (cheaper for exploration, powerful for analysis)
504 | - [ ] Have a question in mind
505 | 
506 | ### During Chat
507 | 
508 | - [ ] Ask specific questions (use SPECIFIC formula)
509 | - [ ] Check citations for factual claims
510 | - [ ] Follow up on unclear points
511 | - [ ] Adjust context if you need different sources
512 | 
513 | ### After Chat
514 | 
515 | - [ ] Save good responses as notes
516 | - [ ] Archive conversation if you're done
517 | - [ ] Organize notes for future reference
518 | - [ ] Use insights in other features (Ask, Transformations, Podcasts)
519 | 
520 | ---
521 | 
522 | ## When to Use Chat vs. Ask
523 | 
524 | **Use CHAT when:**
525 | - You want a dialogue
526 | - You're exploring a topic
527 | - You'll ask multiple related questions
528 | - You want to adjust context during conversation
529 | - You're not sure exactly what you need
530 | 
531 | **Use ASK when:**
532 | - You have one specific question
533 | - You want a comprehensive answer
534 | - You want the system to auto-search
535 | - You want one response, not dialogue
536 | - You want maximum tokens spent on search
537 | 
538 | ---
539 | 
540 | ## Summary: Chat as Conversation
541 | 
542 | Chat is fundamentally different from asking ChatGPT directly:
543 | 
544 | | Aspect | ChatGPT | Open Notebook Chat |
545 | |--------|---------|-------------------|
546 | | **Source control** | None (uses training) | You control which sources are visible |
547 | | **Cost control** | Per token | Per token, but context is your choice |
548 | | **Iteration** | Works | Works, with your sources changing dynamically |
549 | | **Citations** | Made up often | Tied to your sources (verifiable) |
550 | | **Privacy** | Your data to OpenAI | Your data stays local (unless you choose) |
551 | 
552 | The key insight: **Chat is retrieval-augmented generation.** AI sees only what you put in context. You control the conversation and the information flow.
553 | 
554 | That's why Chat is powerful for research. You're not just talking to an AI; you're having a conversation with your research itself.
555 |

  1 | 'use client'
  2 | 
  3 | import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react'
  4 | import { Controller, useFieldArray, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
  5 | import type { FieldErrorsImpl } from 'react-hook-form'
  6 | import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
  7 | import { z } from 'zod'
  8 | import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
  9 | 
 10 | import { SpeakerProfile } from '@/lib/types/podcasts'
 11 | import {
 12 |   useCreateSpeakerProfile,
 13 |   useUpdateSpeakerProfile,
 14 | } from '@/lib/hooks/use-podcasts'
 15 | import {
 16 |   Dialog,
 17 |   DialogContent,
 18 |   DialogDescription,
 19 |   DialogHeader,
 20 |   DialogTitle,
 21 | } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
 22 | import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert'
 23 | import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
 24 | import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
 25 | import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
 26 | import {
 27 |   Select,
 28 |   SelectContent,
 29 |   SelectItem,
 30 |   SelectTrigger,
 31 |   SelectValue,
 32 | } from '@/components/ui/select'
 33 | import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea'
 34 | import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator'
 35 | 
 36 | import { TranslationKeys } from '@/lib/locales'
 37 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 38 | 
 39 | const speakerConfigSchema = (t: TranslationKeys) => z.object({
 40 |   name: z.string().min(1, t.common.nameRequired || 'Name is required'),
 41 |   voice_id: z.string().min(1, t.podcasts.voiceIdRequired || 'Voice ID is required'),
 42 |   backstory: z.string().min(1, t.podcasts.backstoryRequired || 'Backstory is required'),
 43 |   personality: z.string().min(1, t.podcasts.personalityRequired || 'Personality is required'),
 44 | })
 45 | 
 46 | const speakerProfileSchema = (t: TranslationKeys) => z.object({
 47 |   name: z.string().min(1, t.common.nameRequired || 'Name is required'),
 48 |   description: z.string().optional(),
 49 |   tts_provider: z.string().min(1, t.models.providerRequired || 'Provider is required'),
 50 |   tts_model: z.string().min(1, t.models.modelRequired || 'Model is required'),
 51 |   speakers: z
 52 |     .array(speakerConfigSchema(t))
 53 |     .min(1, t.podcasts.speakerCountMin || 'At least one speaker is required')
 54 |     .max(4, t.podcasts.speakerCountMax || 'You can configure up to 4 speakers'),
 55 | })
 56 | 
 57 | export type SpeakerProfileFormValues = z.infer<ReturnType<typeof speakerProfileSchema>>
 58 | 
 59 | interface SpeakerProfileFormDialogProps {
 60 |   mode: 'create' | 'edit'
 61 |   open: boolean
 62 |   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
 63 |   modelOptions: Record<string, string[]>
 64 |   initialData?: SpeakerProfile
 65 | }
 66 | 
 67 | const EMPTY_SPEAKER = {
 68 |   name: '',
 69 |   voice_id: '',
 70 |   backstory: '',
 71 |   personality: '',
 72 | }
 73 | 
 74 | export function SpeakerProfileFormDialog({
 75 |   mode,
 76 |   open,
 77 |   onOpenChange,
 78 |   modelOptions,
 79 |   initialData,
 80 | }: SpeakerProfileFormDialogProps) {
 81 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 82 |   const createProfile = useCreateSpeakerProfile()
 83 |   const updateProfile = useUpdateSpeakerProfile()
 84 | 
 85 |   const providers = useMemo(() => Object.keys(modelOptions), [modelOptions])
 86 | 
 87 |   const getDefaults = useCallback((): SpeakerProfileFormValues => {
 88 |     const firstProvider = providers[0] ?? ''
 89 |     const firstModel = firstProvider ? modelOptions[firstProvider]?.[0] ?? '' : ''
 90 | 
 91 |     if (initialData) {
 92 |       return {
 93 |         name: initialData.name,
 94 |         description: initialData.description ?? '',
 95 |         tts_provider: initialData.tts_provider,
 96 |         tts_model: initialData.tts_model,
 97 |         speakers: initialData.speakers?.map((speaker) => ({ ...speaker })) ?? [{ ...EMPTY_SPEAKER }],
 98 |       }
 99 |     }
100 | 
101 |     return {
102 |       name: '',
103 |       description: '',
104 |       tts_provider: firstProvider,
105 |       tts_model: firstModel,
106 |       speakers: [{ ...EMPTY_SPEAKER }],
107 |     }
108 |   }, [initialData, modelOptions, providers])
109 | 
110 |   const {
111 |     control,
112 |     register,
113 |     handleSubmit,
114 |     reset,
115 |     setValue,
116 |     watch,
117 |     formState: { errors },
118 |   } = useForm<SpeakerProfileFormValues>({
119 |     resolver: zodResolver(speakerProfileSchema(t)),
120 |     defaultValues: getDefaults(),
121 |   })
122 | 
123 |   const {
124 |     fields,
125 |     append,
126 |     remove,
127 |   } = useFieldArray({
128 |     control,
129 |     name: 'speakers',
130 |   })
131 | 
132 |   const provider = watch('tts_provider')
133 |   const currentModel = watch('tts_model')
134 |   const availableModels = useMemo(
135 |     () => modelOptions[provider] ?? [],
136 |     [modelOptions, provider]
137 |   )
138 | 
139 |   const speakersArrayError = (
140 |     errors.speakers as FieldErrorsImpl<{ root?: { message?: string } }> | undefined
141 |   )?.root?.message
142 | 
143 |   useEffect(() => {
144 |     if (!open) {
145 |       return
146 |     }
147 |     reset(getDefaults())
148 |   }, [open, reset, getDefaults])
149 | 
150 |   useEffect(() => {
151 |     if (!provider) {
152 |       return
153 |     }
154 |     const models = modelOptions[provider] ?? []
155 |     if (models.length === 0) {
156 |       setValue('tts_model', '')
157 |       return
158 |     }
159 |     if (!models.includes(currentModel)) {
160 |       setValue('tts_model', models[0])
161 |     }
162 |   }, [provider, currentModel, modelOptions, setValue])
163 | 
164 |   const onSubmit = async (values: SpeakerProfileFormValues) => {
165 |     const payload = {
166 |       ...values,
167 |       description: values.description ?? '',
168 |     }
169 | 
170 |     if (mode === 'create') {
171 |       await createProfile.mutateAsync(payload)
172 |     } else if (initialData) {
173 |       await updateProfile.mutateAsync({
174 |         profileId: initialData.id,
175 |         payload,
176 |       })
177 |     }
178 | 
179 |     onOpenChange(false)
180 |   }
181 | 
182 |   const isSubmitting = createProfile.isPending || updateProfile.isPending
183 |   const disableSubmit = isSubmitting || providers.length === 0
184 |   const isEdit = mode === 'edit'
185 | 
186 |   return (
187 |     <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
188 |       <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-2xl">
189 |         <DialogHeader>
190 |           <DialogTitle>
191 |             {isEdit ? t.podcasts.editSpeakerProfile : t.podcasts.createSpeakerProfile}
192 |           </DialogTitle>
193 |           <DialogDescription>
194 |             {t.podcasts.speakerProfileFormDesc}
195 |           </DialogDescription>
196 |         </DialogHeader>
197 | 
198 |         {providers.length === 0 ? (
199 |           <Alert className="bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-200">
200 |             <AlertTitle>{t.podcasts.noTtsModelsAvailable}</AlertTitle>
201 |             <AlertDescription>
202 |               {t.podcasts.noTtsModelsDesc}
203 |             </AlertDescription>
204 |           </Alert>
205 |         ) : null}
206 | 
207 |         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-6 pt-2">
208 |           <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
209 |             <div className="space-y-2">
210 |               <Label htmlFor="name">{t.podcasts.profileName} *</Label>
211 |               <Input id="name" placeholder={t.podcasts.profileNamePlaceholder} {...register('name')} />
212 |               {errors.name ? (
213 |                 <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{errors.name.message}</p>
214 |               ) : null}
215 |             </div>

218 |               <Label htmlFor="tts_provider">{t.models.provider} *</Label>
219 |               <Controller

221 |                 name="tts_provider"
222 |                 render={({ field }) => (
223 |                   <Select value={field.value} onValueChange={field.onChange}>
224 |                     <SelectTrigger id="tts_provider">
225 |                       <SelectValue placeholder={t.models.selectProviderPlaceholder} />
226 |                     </SelectTrigger>
227 |                     <SelectContent title={t.models.provider}>
228 |                       {providers.map((option) => (
229 |                         <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>
230 |                           <span className="capitalize">{option}</span>
231 |                         </SelectItem>
232 |                       ))}
233 |                     </SelectContent>
234 |                   </Select>
235 |                 )}
236 |               />
237 |               {errors.tts_provider ? (
238 |                 <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{errors.tts_provider.message}</p>
239 |               ) : null}
240 |             </div>
241 | 
242 |             <div className="space-y-2">
243 |               <Label htmlFor="tts_model">{t.common.model} *</Label>
244 |               <Controller
245 |                 control={control}
246 |                 name="tts_model"
247 |                 render={({ field }) => (

251 |                     </SelectTrigger>

255 |                           {model}

257 |                       ))}
258 |                     </SelectContent>
259 |                   </Select>
260 |                 )}
261 |               />
262 |               {errors.tts_model ? (

264 |               ) : null}
265 |             </div>
266 | 
267 |             <div className="space-y-2">
268 |               <Label htmlFor="description">{t.common.description}</Label>
269 |               <Textarea
270 |                 id="description"
271 |                 rows={3}
272 |                 placeholder={t.podcasts.descriptionPlaceholder}
273 |                 {...register('description')}
274 |               />
275 |             </div>
276 |           </div>
277 | 
278 |           <div className="space-y-4">
279 |             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
280 |               <div>
281 |                 <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
282 |                   {t.podcasts.speakers}
283 |                 </h3>
284 |                 <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
285 |                   {t.podcasts.speakersDesc}
286 |                 </p>
287 |               </div>
288 |               <Button
289 |                 type="button"
290 |                 variant="outline"
291 |                 size="sm"
292 |                 onClick={() => append({ ...EMPTY_SPEAKER })}
293 |                 disabled={fields.length >= 4}
294 |               >
295 |                 <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t.podcasts.addSpeaker}
296 |               </Button>
297 |             </div>
298 |             <Separator />
299 | 
300 |             {fields.map((field, index) => (
301 |               <div key={field.id} className="rounded-lg border p-4 space-y-4">
302 |                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
303 |                   <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
304 |                     {t.podcasts.speakerNumber.replace('{number}', (index + 1).toString())}
305 |                   </p>
306 |                   <Button
307 |                     type="button"
308 |                     variant="ghost"
309 |                     size="sm"
310 |                     onClick={() => remove(index)}
311 |                     disabled={fields.length <= 1}
312 |                     className="text-destructive"
313 |                   >
314 |                     <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t.common.remove}
315 |                   </Button>
316 |                 </div>
317 |                 <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
318 |                   <div className="space-y-2">
319 |                     <Label htmlFor={`speaker-name-${index}`}>{t.common.name} *</Label>
320 |                     <Input

322 |                       {...register(`speakers.${index}.name` as const)}
323 |                       placeholder={t.podcasts.hostPlaceholder.replace('{number}', (index + 1).toString())}
324 |                       autoComplete="off"
325 |                     />
326 |                     {errors.speakers?.[index]?.name ? (
327 |                       <p className="text-xs text-red-600">
328 |                         {errors.speakers[index]?.name?.message}
329 |                       </p>
330 |                     ) : null}
331 |                   </div>
332 |                   <div className="space-y-2">
333 |                     <Label htmlFor={`speaker-voice-${index}`}>{t.podcasts.voiceId} *</Label>
334 |                     <Input
335 |                       id={`speaker-voice-${index}`}
336 |                       {...register(`speakers.${index}.voice_id` as const)}
337 |                       placeholder="voice_123"
338 |                       autoComplete="off"
339 |                     />
340 |                     {errors.speakers?.[index]?.voice_id ? (
341 |                       <p className="text-xs text-red-600">
342 |                         {errors.speakers[index]?.voice_id?.message}
343 |                       </p>
344 |                     ) : null}
345 |                   </div>
346 |                 </div>
347 |                 <div className="space-y-2">
348 |                   <Label htmlFor={`speaker-backstory-${index}`}>{t.podcasts.backstory} *</Label>
349 |                   <Textarea
350 |                     id={`speaker-backstory-${index}`}
351 |                     rows={3}
352 |                     placeholder={t.podcasts.backstoryPlaceholder}
353 |                     {...register(`speakers.${index}.backstory` as const)}
354 |                     autoComplete="off"
355 |                   />
356 |                   {errors.speakers?.[index]?.backstory ? (
357 |                     <p className="text-xs text-red-600">
358 |                       {errors.speakers[index]?.backstory?.message}
359 |                     </p>
360 |                   ) : null}
361 |                 </div>
362 |                 <div className="space-y-2">
363 |                   <Label htmlFor={`speaker-personality-${index}`}>{t.podcasts.personality} *</Label>
364 |                   <Textarea
365 |                     id={`speaker-personality-${index}`}
366 |                     rows={3}
367 |                     placeholder={t.podcasts.personalityPlaceholder}
368 |                     {...register(`speakers.${index}.personality` as const)}
369 |                     autoComplete="off"
370 |                   />
371 |                   {errors.speakers?.[index]?.personality ? (
372 |                     <p className="text-xs text-red-600">
373 |                       {errors.speakers[index]?.personality?.message}
374 |                     </p>
375 |                   ) : null}
376 |                 </div>
377 |               </div>
378 |             ))}
379 | 
380 |             {speakersArrayError ? (
381 |               <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{speakersArrayError}</p>
382 |             ) : null}
383 |           </div>
384 | 
385 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
386 |             <Button
387 |               type="button"
388 |               variant="outline"
389 |               onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
390 |             >
391 |               {t.common.cancel}
392 |             </Button>
393 |             <Button type="submit" disabled={disableSubmit}>
394 |               {isSubmitting
395 |                 ? t.common.saving
396 |                 : isEdit
397 |                   ? t.common.saveChanges
398 |                   : t.podcasts.createProfile}
399 |             </Button>
400 |           </div>
401 |         </form>
402 |       </DialogContent>
403 |     </Dialog>
404 |   )
405 | }

 25 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 26 | 
 27 | interface NotebookContextStats {
 28 |   sourcesInsights: number
 29 |   sourcesFull: number
 30 |   notesCount: number
 31 |   tokenCount?: number
 32 |   charCount?: number
 33 | }
 34 | 
 35 | interface ChatPanelProps {
 36 |   messages: SourceChatMessage[]
 37 |   isStreaming: boolean
 38 |   contextIndicators: SourceChatContextIndicator | null
 39 |   onSendMessage: (message: string, modelOverride?: string) => void
 40 |   modelOverride?: string
 41 |   onModelChange?: (model?: string) => void
 42 |   // Session management props
 43 |   sessions?: BaseChatSession[]
 44 |   currentSessionId?: string | null
 45 |   onCreateSession?: (title: string) => void
 46 |   onSelectSession?: (sessionId: string) => void
 47 |   onDeleteSession?: (sessionId: string) => void
 48 |   onUpdateSession?: (sessionId: string, title: string) => void
 49 |   loadingSessions?: boolean
 50 |   // Generic props for reusability
 51 |   title?: string
 52 |   contextType?: 'source' | 'notebook'
 53 |   // Notebook context stats (for notebook chat)
 54 |   notebookContextStats?: NotebookContextStats
 55 |   // Notebook ID for saving notes
 56 |   notebookId?: string
 57 | }
 58 | 
 59 | export function ChatPanel({
 60 |   messages,
 61 |   isStreaming,
 62 |   contextIndicators,
 63 |   onSendMessage,
 64 |   modelOverride,
 65 |   onModelChange,
 66 |   sessions = [],
 67 |   currentSessionId,
 68 |   onCreateSession,
 69 |   onSelectSession,
 70 |   onDeleteSession,
 71 |   onUpdateSession,
 72 |   loadingSessions = false,
 73 |   title,
 74 |   contextType = 'source',
 75 |   notebookContextStats,
 76 |   notebookId
 77 | }: ChatPanelProps) {
 78 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 79 |   const chatInputId = useId()
 80 |   const [input, setInput] = useState('')
 81 |   const [sessionManagerOpen, setSessionManagerOpen] = useState(false)
 82 |   const scrollAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
 83 |   const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
 84 |   const { openModal } = useModalManager()
 85 | 
 86 |   const handleReferenceClick = (type: string, id: string) => {
 87 |     const modalType = type === 'source_insight' ? 'insight' : type as 'source' | 'note' | 'insight'
 88 | 
 89 |     try {
 90 |       openModal(modalType, id)
 91 |       // Note: The modal system uses URL parameters and doesn't throw errors for missing items.
 92 |       // The modal component itself will handle displaying "not found" states.
 93 |       // This try-catch is here for future enhancements or unexpected errors.
 94 |     } catch {
 95 |       toast.error(t.common.noResults)
 96 |     }
 97 |   }
 98 | 
 99 |   // Auto-scroll to bottom when new messages arrive
100 |   useEffect(() => {
101 |     messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })
102 |   }, [messages])
103 | 
104 |   const handleSend = () => {
105 |     if (input.trim() && !isStreaming) {
106 |       onSendMessage(input.trim(), modelOverride)
107 |       setInput('')
108 |     }
109 |   }
110 | 
111 |   const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
112 |     // Detect platform for correct modifier key
113 |     const isMac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.userAgent.toUpperCase().indexOf('MAC') >= 0
114 |     const isModifierPressed = isMac ? e.metaKey : e.ctrlKey
115 | 
116 |     if (e.key === 'Enter' && isModifierPressed) {
117 |       e.preventDefault()
118 |       handleSend()
119 |     }
120 |   }
121 | 
122 |   // Detect platform for placeholder text
123 |   const isMac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.userAgent.toUpperCase().indexOf('MAC') >= 0
124 |   const keyHint = isMac ? '⌘+Enter' : 'Ctrl+Enter'
125 | 
126 |   return (
127 |     <>
128 |     <Card className="flex flex-col h-full flex-1 overflow-hidden">
129 |       <CardHeader className="pb-3 flex-shrink-0">
130 |         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
131 |           <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
132 |             <Bot className="h-5 w-5" />
133 |             {title || (contextType === 'source' ? t.chat.chatWith.replace('{name}', t.navigation.sources) : t.chat.chatWith.replace('{name}', t.common.notebook))}
134 |           </CardTitle>
135 |           {onSelectSession && onCreateSession && onDeleteSession && (
136 |             <Dialog open={sessionManagerOpen} onOpenChange={setSessionManagerOpen}>
137 |               <Button
138 |                 variant="ghost"
139 |                 size="sm"
140 |                 className="gap-2"
141 |                 onClick={() => setSessionManagerOpen(true)}
142 |                 disabled={loadingSessions}
143 |               >
144 |                 <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
145 |                 <span className="text-xs">{t.chat.sessions}</span>
146 |               </Button>
147 |               <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px] p-0 overflow-hidden">
148 |                 <DialogTitle className="sr-only">{t.chat.sessionsTitle}</DialogTitle>
149 |                 <SessionManager
150 |                   sessions={sessions}
151 |                   currentSessionId={currentSessionId ?? null}
152 |                   onCreateSession={(title) => onCreateSession?.(title)}
153 |                   onSelectSession={(sessionId) => {
154 |                     onSelectSession(sessionId)
155 |                     setSessionManagerOpen(false)
156 |                   }}
157 |                   onUpdateSession={(sessionId, title) => onUpdateSession?.(sessionId, title)}
158 |                   onDeleteSession={(sessionId) => onDeleteSession?.(sessionId)}
159 |                   loadingSessions={loadingSessions}
160 |                 />
161 |               </DialogContent>
162 |             </Dialog>
163 |           )}
164 |         </div>
165 |       </CardHeader>
166 |       <CardContent className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 p-0">
167 |         <ScrollArea className="flex-1 min-h-0 px-4" ref={scrollAreaRef}>
168 |           <div className="space-y-4 py-4">
169 |             {messages.length === 0 ? (
170 |               <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
171 |                 <Bot className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
172 |                 <p className="text-sm">
173 |                   {t.chat.startConversation.replace('{type}', contextType === 'source' ? t.navigation.sources : t.common.notebook)}
174 |                 </p>
175 |                 <p className="text-xs mt-2">{t.chat.askQuestions}</p>
176 |               </div>
177 |             ) : (
178 |               messages.map((message) => (
179 |                 <div
180 |                   key={message.id}
181 |                   className={`flex gap-3 ${
182 |                     message.type === 'human' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'
183 |                   }`}
184 |                 >
185 |                   {message.type === 'ai' && (
186 |                     <div className="flex-shrink-0">
187 |                       <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
188 |                         <Bot className="h-4 w-4" />
189 |                       </div>
190 |                     </div>
191 |                   )}
192 |                   <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-[80%]">
193 |                     <div
194 |                       className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-2 ${
195 |                         message.type === 'human'
196 |                           ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
197 |                           : 'bg-muted'
198 |                       }`}
199 |                     >
200 |                       {message.type === 'ai' ? (
201 |                         <AIMessageContent
202 |                           content={message.content}
203 |                           onReferenceClick={handleReferenceClick}
204 |                         />
205 |                       ) : (
206 |                         <p className="text-sm break-words overflow-wrap-anywhere">{message.content}</p>
207 |                       )}
208 |                     </div>
209 |                     {message.type === 'ai' && (
210 |                       <MessageActions
211 |                         content={message.content}
212 |                         notebookId={notebookId}
213 |                       />
214 |                     )}
215 |                   </div>
216 |                   {message.type === 'human' && (
217 |                     <div className="flex-shrink-0">
218 |                       <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
219 |                         <User className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-foreground" />
220 |                       </div>
221 |                     </div>
222 |                   )}
223 |                 </div>
224 |               ))
225 |             )}
226 |             {isStreaming && (
227 |               <div className="flex gap-3 justify-start">
228 |                 <div className="flex-shrink-0">
229 |                   <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
230 |                     <Bot className="h-4 w-4" />
231 |                   </div>
232 |                 </div>
233 |                 <div className="rounded-lg px-4 py-2 bg-muted">
234 |                   <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
235 |                 </div>
236 |               </div>
237 |             )}
238 |             <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
239 |           </div>
240 |         </ScrollArea>
241 | 
242 |         {/* Context Indicators */}
243 |         {contextIndicators && (
244 |           <div className="border-t px-4 py-2">
245 |             <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
246 |               {contextIndicators.sources?.length > 0 && (
247 |                 <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
248 |                   <FileText className="h-3 w-3" />
249 |                   {contextIndicators.sources.length} {t.navigation.sources}
250 |                 </Badge>
251 |               )}
252 |               {contextIndicators.insights?.length > 0 && (
253 |                 <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
254 |                   <Lightbulb className="h-3 w-3" />
255 |                   {contextIndicators.insights.length} {contextIndicators.insights.length === 1 ? t.common.insight : t.common.insights}
256 |                 </Badge>
257 |               )}
258 |               {contextIndicators.notes?.length > 0 && (
259 |                 <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
260 |                   <StickyNote className="h-3 w-3" />
261 |                   {contextIndicators.notes.length} {contextIndicators.notes.length === 1 ? t.common.note : t.common.notes}
262 |                 </Badge>
263 |               )}
264 |             </div>
265 |           </div>
266 |         )}
267 | 
268 |         {/* Notebook Context Indicator */}
269 |         {notebookContextStats && (
270 |           <ContextIndicator
271 |             sourcesInsights={notebookContextStats.sourcesInsights}
272 |             sourcesFull={notebookContextStats.sourcesFull}
273 |             notesCount={notebookContextStats.notesCount}
274 |             tokenCount={notebookContextStats.tokenCount}
275 |             charCount={notebookContextStats.charCount}
276 |           />
277 |         )}
278 | 
279 |         {/* Input Area */}
280 |         <div className="flex-shrink-0 p-4 space-y-3 border-t">
281 |           {/* Model selector */}
282 |           {onModelChange && (
283 |             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
284 |               <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.chat.model}</span>
285 |               <ModelSelector
286 |                 currentModel={modelOverride}
287 |                 onModelChange={onModelChange}
288 |                 disabled={isStreaming}
289 |               />
290 |             </div>
291 |           )}
292 | 
293 |           <div className="flex gap-2 items-end">
294 |             <Textarea
295 |               id={chatInputId}
296 |               name="chat-message"
297 |               autoComplete="off"
298 |               value={input}
299 |               onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
300 |               onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
301 |               placeholder={`${t.chat.sendPlaceholder} (${t.chat.pressToSend.replace('{key}', keyHint)})`}
302 |               disabled={isStreaming}
303 |               className="flex-1 min-h-[40px] max-h-[100px] resize-none py-2 px-3"
304 |               rows={1}
305 |             />
306 |             <Button
307 |               onClick={handleSend}
308 |               disabled={!input.trim() || isStreaming}
309 |               size="icon"
310 |               className="h-[40px] w-[40px] flex-shrink-0"
311 |             >
312 |               {isStreaming ? (
313 |                 <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
314 |               ) : (
315 |                 <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
316 |               )}
317 |             </Button>
318 |           </div>
319 |         </div>
320 |       </CardContent>
321 |     </Card>
322 | 
323 |     </>
324 |   )
325 | }
326 | 
327 | // Helper component to render AI messages with clickable references
328 | function AIMessageContent({
329 |   content,
330 |   onReferenceClick
331 | }: {
332 |   content: string
333 |   onReferenceClick: (type: string, id: string) => void
334 | }) {
335 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
336 |   // Convert references to compact markdown with numbered citations
337 |   const markdownWithCompactRefs = convertReferencesToCompactMarkdown(content, t.common.references)
338 | 
339 |   // Create custom link component for compact references
340 |   const LinkComponent = createCompactReferenceLinkComponent(onReferenceClick)
341 | 
342 |   return (
343 |     <div className="prose prose-sm prose-neutral dark:prose-invert max-w-none break-words prose-headings:font-semibold prose-a:text-blue-600 prose-a:break-all prose-code:bg-muted prose-code:px-1 prose-code:py-0.5 prose-code:rounded prose-p:mb-4 prose-p:leading-7 prose-li:mb-2">
344 |       <ReactMarkdown
345 |         remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
346 |         components={{
347 |           a: LinkComponent,
348 |           p: ({ children }) => <p className="mb-4">{children}</p>,
349 |           h1: ({ children }) => <h1 className="mb-4 mt-6">{children}</h1>,
350 |           h2: ({ children }) => <h2 className="mb-3 mt-5">{children}</h2>,
351 |           h3: ({ children }) => <h3 className="mb-3 mt-4">{children}</h3>,
352 |           h4: ({ children }) => <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4">{children}</h4>,
353 |           h5: ({ children }) => <h5 className="mb-2 mt-3">{children}</h5>,
354 |           h6: ({ children }) => <h6 className="mb-2 mt-3">{children}</h6>,
355 |           li: ({ children }) => <li className="mb-1">{children}</li>,
356 |           ul: ({ children }) => <ul className="mb-4 space-y-1">{children}</ul>,
357 |           ol: ({ children }) => <ol className="mb-4 space-y-1">{children}</ol>,
358 |           table: ({ children }) => (
359 |             <div className="my-4 overflow-x-auto">
360 |               <table className="min-w-full border-collapse border border-border">{children}</table>
361 |             </div>
362 |           ),
363 |           thead: ({ children }) => <thead className="bg-muted">{children}</thead>,
364 |           tbody: ({ children }) => <tbody>{children}</tbody>,
365 |           tr: ({ children }) => <tr className="border-b border-border">{children}</tr>,
366 |           th: ({ children }) => <th className="border border-border px-3 py-2 text-left font-semibold">{children}</th>,
367 |           td: ({ children }) => <td className="border border-border px-3 py-2">{children}</td>,
368 |         }}
369 |       >
370 |         {markdownWithCompactRefs}
371 |       </ReactMarkdown>
372 |     </div>
373 |   )
374 | }
