  1 | """
  2 | API client for Open Notebook API.
  3 | This module provides a client interface to interact with the Open Notebook API.
  4 | """
  5 | 
  6 | import os
  7 | from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union
  8 | 
  9 | import httpx
 10 | from loguru import logger
 11 | 
 12 | 
 13 | class APIClient:
 14 |     """Client for Open Notebook API."""
 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self, base_url: Optional[str] = None):
 17 |         self.base_url = base_url or os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:5055")
 18 |         # Timeout increased to 5 minutes (300s) to accommodate slow LLM operations
 19 |         # (transformations, insights) on slower hardware (Ollama, LM Studio, remote APIs)
 20 |         # Configurable via API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT environment variable (in seconds)
 21 |         timeout_str = os.getenv("API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT", "300.0")
 22 |         try:
 23 |             timeout_value = float(timeout_str)
 24 |             # Validate timeout is within reasonable bounds (30s - 3600s / 1 hour)
 25 |             if timeout_value < 30:
 26 |                 logger.warning(
 27 |                     f"API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT={timeout_value}s is too low, using minimum of 30s"
 28 |                 )
 29 |                 timeout_value = 30.0
 30 |             elif timeout_value > 3600:
 31 |                 logger.warning(
 32 |                     f"API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT={timeout_value}s is too high, using maximum of 3600s"
 33 |                 )
 34 |                 timeout_value = 3600.0
 35 |             self.timeout = timeout_value
 36 |         except ValueError:
 37 |             logger.error(
 38 |                 f"Invalid API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT value '{timeout_str}', using default 300s"
 39 |             )
 40 |             self.timeout = 300.0
 41 | 
 42 |         # Add authentication header if password is set
 43 |         self.headers = {}
 44 |         password = os.getenv("OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD")
 45 |         if password:
 46 |             self.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {password}"
 47 | 
 48 |     def _make_request(
 49 |         self, method: str, endpoint: str, timeout: Optional[float] = None, **kwargs
 50 |     ) -> Union[Dict[Any, Any], List[Dict[Any, Any]]]:
 51 |         """Make HTTP request to the API."""
 52 |         url = f"{self.base_url}{endpoint}"
 53 |         request_timeout = timeout if timeout is not None else self.timeout
 54 | 
 55 |         # Merge headers
 56 |         headers = kwargs.get("headers", {})
 57 |         headers.update(self.headers)
 58 |         kwargs["headers"] = headers
 59 | 
 60 |         try:
 61 |             with httpx.Client(timeout=request_timeout) as client:
 62 |                 response = client.request(method, url, **kwargs)
 63 |                 response.raise_for_status()
 64 |                 return response.json()
 65 |         except httpx.RequestError as e:
 66 |             logger.error(f"Request error for {method} {url}: {str(e)}")
 67 |             raise ConnectionError(f"Failed to connect to API: {str(e)}")
 68 |         except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
 69 |             logger.error(
 70 |                 f"HTTP error {e.response.status_code} for {method} {url}: {e.response.text}"
 71 |             )
 72 |             raise RuntimeError(
 73 |                 f"API request failed: {e.response.status_code} - {e.response.text}"
 74 |             )
 75 |         except Exception as e:
 76 |             logger.error(f"Unexpected error for {method} {url}: {str(e)}")
 77 |             raise

488 |         self,
489 |         name: str,
490 |         description: str = "",
491 |         speaker_config: str = "",
492 |         outline_provider: str = "",
493 |         outline_model: str = "",
494 |         transcript_provider: str = "",
495 |         transcript_model: str = "",
496 |         default_briefing: str = "",
497 |         num_segments: int = 5,
498 |     ) -> Union[Dict[Any, Any], List[Dict[Any, Any]]]:
499 |         """Create a new episode profile."""
500 |         data = {
501 |             "name": name,
502 |             "description": description,
503 |             "speaker_config": speaker_config,
504 |             "outline_provider": outline_provider,
505 |             "outline_model": outline_model,
506 |             "transcript_provider": transcript_provider,
507 |             "transcript_model": transcript_model,
508 |             "default_briefing": default_briefing,
509 |             "num_segments": num_segments,
510 |         }
511 |         return self._make_request("POST", "/api/episode-profiles", json=data)
512 | 
513 |     def update_episode_profile(
514 |         self, profile_id: str, **updates
515 |     ) -> Union[Dict[Any, Any], List[Dict[Any, Any]]]:
516 |         """Update an episode profile."""
517 |         return self._make_request(
518 |             "PUT", f"/api/episode-profiles/{profile_id}", json=updates
519 |         )
520 | 
521 |     def delete_episode_profile(
522 |         self, profile_id: str
523 |     ) -> Union[Dict[Any, Any], List[Dict[Any, Any]]]:
524 |         """Delete an episode profile."""
525 |         return self._make_request("DELETE", f"/api/episode-profiles/{profile_id}")
526 | 
527 | 
528 | # Global client instance
529 | api_client = APIClient()
530 |

/docs/5-CONFIGURATION/ollama.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # Ollama Setup Guide
  2 | 
  3 | Ollama provides free, local AI models that run on your own hardware. This guide covers everything you need to know about setting up Ollama with Open Notebook, including different deployment scenarios and network configurations.
  4 | 
  5 | ## Why Choose Ollama?
  6 | 
  7 | - **🆓 Completely Free**: No API costs after initial setup
  8 | - **🔒 Full Privacy**: Your data never leaves your local network
  9 | - **📱 Offline Capable**: Works without internet connection
 10 | - **🚀 Fast**: Local inference with no network latency
 11 | - **🧠 Reasoning Models**: Support for advanced reasoning models like DeepSeek-R1
 12 | - **💾 Model Variety**: Access to hundreds of open-source models
 13 | 
 14 | ## Quick Start
 15 | 
 16 | ### 1. Install Ollama
 17 | 
 18 | **Linux/macOS:**
 19 | ```bash
 20 | curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh
 21 | ```
 22 | 
 23 | **Windows:**
 24 | Download and install from [ollama.ai](https://ollama.ai/download)
 25 | 
 26 | ### 2. Pull Required Models
 27 | 
 28 | ```bash
 29 | # Language models (choose one or more)
 30 | ollama pull qwen3              # Excellent general purpose, 7B parameters
 31 | ollama pull gemma3            # Google's model, good performance
 32 | ollama pull deepseek-r1       # Advanced reasoning model
 33 | ollama pull phi4              # Microsoft's efficient model
 34 | 
 35 | # Embedding model (required for search)
 36 | ollama pull mxbai-embed-large  # Best embedding model for Ollama
 37 | ```
 38 | 
 39 | ### 3. Configure Open Notebook
 40 | 
 41 | **For local installation:**
 42 | ```bash
 43 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:11434
 44 | ```
 45 | 
 46 | **For Docker installation:**
 47 | ```bash
 48 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://host.docker.internal:11434
 49 | ```
 50 | 
 51 | ## Network Configuration Guide
 52 | 
 53 | The `OLLAMA_API_BASE` environment variable tells Open Notebook where to find your Ollama server. The correct value depends on your deployment scenario:
 54 | 
 55 | ### Scenario 1: Local Installation (Same Machine)
 56 | 
 57 | When both Open Notebook and Ollama run directly on your machine:
 58 | 
 59 | ```bash
 60 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:11434
 61 | # or
 62 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:11434
 63 | ```
 64 | 
 65 | **Use `localhost` vs `127.0.0.1`:**
 66 | - **localhost**: Recommended, works with most configurations
 67 | - **127.0.0.1**: Use if you have DNS resolution issues with localhost
 68 | 
 69 | ### Scenario 2: Open Notebook in Docker, Ollama on Host
 70 | 
 71 | When Open Notebook runs in Docker but Ollama runs on your host machine:
 72 | 
 73 | ```bash
 74 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://host.docker.internal:11434
 75 | ```
 76 | 
 77 | **⚠️ CRITICAL: Ollama must accept external connections:**
 78 | ```bash
 79 | # Start Ollama with external access enabled
 80 | export OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434
 81 | ollama serve
 82 | ```
 83 | 
 84 | **⚠️ LINUX USERS: Extra configuration required!**
 85 | 
 86 | On Linux, `host.docker.internal` doesn't resolve automatically like it does on macOS/Windows. You must add `extra_hosts` to your docker-compose.yml:
 87 | 
 88 | ```yaml
 89 | services:
 90 |   open_notebook:
 91 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
 92 |     # ... other settings ...
 93 |     extra_hosts:
 94 |       - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
 95 |     environment:
 96 |       - OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://host.docker.internal:11434
 97 | ```
 98 | 
 99 | Without this, you'll get connection errors like:
100 | ```
101 | httpcore.ConnectError: [Errno -2] Name or service not known
102 | ```
103 | 
104 | **Why `host.docker.internal`?**
105 | - Docker containers can't reach `localhost` on the host
106 | - `host.docker.internal` is Docker's special hostname for the host machine
107 | - Available on Docker Desktop for Mac/Windows; **requires `extra_hosts` on Linux**
108 | 
109 | **Why `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434`?**
110 | - By default, Ollama only binds to localhost and rejects external connections
111 | - Docker containers are considered "external" even when running on the same machine
112 | - Setting `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434` allows connections from Docker containers
113 | 
114 | ### Scenario 3: Both in Docker (Same Compose)
115 | 
116 | When both Open Notebook and Ollama run in the same Docker Compose stack:
117 | 
118 | ```bash
119 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://ollama:11434
120 | ```
121 | 
122 | **Docker Compose Example:**
123 | 
124 | ```yaml
125 | version: '3.8'
126 | services:
127 |   open-notebook:
128 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
129 |     pull_policy: always
130 |     ports:
131 |       - "8502:8502"
132 |       - "5055:5055"
133 |     environment:
134 |       - OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://ollama:11434
135 |     volumes:
136 |       - ./notebook_data:/app/data
137 |       - ./surreal_data:/mydata
138 |     depends_on:
139 |       - ollama
140 | 
141 |   ollama:
142 |     image: ollama/ollama:v1-latest
143 |     ports:
144 |       - "11434:11434"
145 |     volumes:
146 |       - ollama_data:/root/.ollama
147 |     # Optional: GPU support
148 |     deploy:
149 |       resources:
150 |         reservations:
151 |           devices:
152 |             - driver: nvidia
153 |               count: 1
154 |               capabilities: [gpu]
155 | 
156 | volumes:
157 |   ollama_data:
158 | ```
159 | 
160 | ### Scenario 4: Remote Ollama Server
161 | 
162 | When Ollama runs on a different machine in your network:
163 | 
164 | ```bash
165 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://192.168.1.100:11434
166 | # Replace 192.168.1.100 with your Ollama server's IP address
167 | ```
168 | 
169 | **Security Note:** Only use this in trusted networks. Ollama doesn't have built-in authentication.
170 | 
171 | ### Scenario 5: Ollama with Custom Port
172 | 
173 | If you've configured Ollama to use a different port:
174 | 
175 | ```bash
176 | # Start Ollama on custom port
177 | OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:8080 ollama serve
178 | 
179 | # Configure Open Notebook
180 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:8080
181 | ```
182 | 
183 | ## Model Recommendations
184 | 
185 | ### Language Models
186 | 
187 | | Model | Size | Best For | Quality | Speed |
188 | |-------|------|----------|---------|-------|
189 | | **qwen3** | 7B | General purpose, coding | Excellent | Fast |
190 | | **deepseek-r1** | 7B | Reasoning, problem-solving | Exceptional | Medium |
191 | | **gemma3** | 7B | Balanced performance | Very Good | Fast |
192 | | **phi4** | 14B | Efficiency on small hardware | Good | Very Fast |
193 | | **llama3** | 8B | General purpose | Very Good | Medium |
194 | 
195 | ### Embedding Models
196 | 
197 | | Model | Best For | Performance |
198 | |-------|----------|-------------|
199 | | **mxbai-embed-large** | General search | Excellent |
200 | | **nomic-embed-text** | Document similarity | Good |
201 | | **all-minilm** | Lightweight option | Fair |
202 | 
203 | ### Installation Commands
204 | 
205 | ```bash
206 | # Essential models
207 | ollama pull qwen3                 # Primary language model
208 | ollama pull mxbai-embed-large     # Search embeddings
209 | 
210 | # Optional reasoning model
211 | ollama pull deepseek-r1           # Advanced reasoning
212 | 
213 | # Alternative language models
214 | ollama pull gemma3                # Google's model
215 | ollama pull phi4                  # Microsoft's efficient model
216 | ```
217 | 
218 | ## Hardware Requirements
219 | 
220 | ### Minimum Requirements
221 | - **RAM**: 8GB (for 7B models)
222 | - **Storage**: 10GB free space per model
223 | - **CPU**: Modern multi-core processor
224 | 
225 | ### Recommended Setup
226 | - **RAM**: 16GB+ (for multiple models)
227 | - **Storage**: SSD with 50GB+ free space
228 | - **GPU**: NVIDIA GPU with 8GB+ VRAM (optional but faster)
229 | 
230 | ### GPU Acceleration
231 | 
232 | **NVIDIA GPU (CUDA):**
233 | ```bash
234 | # Install NVIDIA Container Toolkit for Docker
235 | # Then use the Docker Compose example above with GPU support
236 | 
237 | # For local installation, Ollama auto-detects CUDA
238 | ollama pull qwen3
239 | ```
240 | 
241 | **Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3):**
242 | ```bash
243 | # Ollama automatically uses Metal acceleration
244 | # No additional setup required
245 | ollama pull qwen3
246 | ```
247 | 
248 | **AMD GPUs:**
249 | ```bash
250 | # ROCm support varies by model and system
251 | # Check Ollama documentation for latest compatibility
252 | ```
253 | 
254 | ## Troubleshooting
255 | 
256 | ### Model Name Configuration (Critical)
257 | 
258 | **⚠️ IMPORTANT: Model names must exactly match the output of `ollama list`**
259 | 
260 | This is the most common cause of "Failed to send message" errors. Open Notebook requires the **exact model name** as it appears in Ollama.
261 | 
262 | **Step 1: Get the exact model name**
263 | ```bash
264 | ollama list
265 | ```
266 | 
267 | Example output:
268 | ```
269 | NAME                        ID              SIZE      MODIFIED
270 | mxbai-embed-large:latest    468836162de7    669 MB    7 minutes ago
271 | gemma3:12b                  f4031aab637d    8.1 GB    2 months ago
272 | qwen3:32b                   030ee887880f    20 GB     9 days ago
273 | ```
274 | 
275 | **Step 2: Use the exact name when adding the model in Open Notebook**
276 | 
277 | | ✅ Correct | ❌ Wrong |
278 | |-----------|----------|
279 | | `gemma3:12b` | `gemma3` (missing tag) |
280 | | `qwen3:32b` | `qwen3-32b` (wrong format) |
281 | | `mxbai-embed-large:latest` | `mxbai-embed-large` (missing tag) |
282 | 
283 | **Note:** Some models use `:latest` as the default tag. If `ollama list` shows `model:latest`, you must use `model:latest` in Open Notebook, not just `model`.
284 | 
285 | **Step 3: Configure in Open Notebook**
286 | 
287 | 1. Go to **Settings → Models**
288 | 2. Click **Add Model**
289 | 3. Enter the **exact name** from `ollama list`
290 | 4. Select provider: `ollama`
291 | 5. Select type: `language` (for chat) or `embedding` (for search)
292 | 6. Save the model
293 | 7. Set it as the default for the appropriate task (chat, transformation, etc.)
294 | 
295 | ### Common Issues
296 | 
297 | **1. "Ollama unavailable" in Open Notebook**
298 | 
299 | **Check Ollama is running:**
300 | ```bash
301 | curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags
302 | ```
303 | 
304 | **Verify environment variable:**
305 | ```bash
306 | echo $OLLAMA_API_BASE
307 | ```
308 | 
309 | **⚠️ IMPORTANT: Enable external connections (most common fix):**
310 | ```bash
311 | # If Open Notebook runs in Docker or on a different machine,
312 | # Ollama must bind to all interfaces, not just localhost
313 | export OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434
314 | ollama serve
315 | ```
316 | > **Why this is needed:** By default, Ollama only accepts connections from `localhost` (127.0.0.1). When Open Notebook runs in Docker or on a different machine, it can't reach Ollama unless you configure `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434` to accept external connections.
317 | 
318 | **Restart Ollama:**
319 | ```bash
320 | # Linux/macOS
321 | sudo systemctl restart ollama
322 | # or
323 | ollama serve
324 | 
325 | # Windows
326 | # Restart from system tray or Services
327 | ```
328 | 
329 | **2. Docker networking issues**
330 | 
331 | **From inside Open Notebook container, test Ollama:**
332 | ```bash
333 | # Get into container
334 | docker exec -it open-notebook bash
335 | 
336 | # Test connection
337 | curl http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/tags
338 | ```
339 | 
340 | **If this fails on Linux** with "Name or service not known", you need to add `extra_hosts` to your docker-compose.yml. See the [Docker-Specific Troubleshooting](#docker-specific-troubleshooting) section below.
341 | 
342 | **3. Models not downloading**
343 | 
344 | **Check disk space:**
345 | ```bash
346 | df -h
347 | ```
348 | 
349 | **Manual model pull:**
350 | ```bash
351 | ollama pull qwen3 --verbose
352 | ```
353 | 
354 | **Clear failed downloads:**
355 | ```bash
356 | ollama rm qwen3
357 | ollama pull qwen3
358 | ```
359 | 
360 | **4. Slow performance**
361 | 
362 | **Check model size vs available RAM:**
363 | ```bash
364 | ollama ps  # Show running models
365 | free -h    # Check available memory
366 | ```
367 | 
368 | **Use smaller models:**
369 | ```bash
370 | ollama pull phi4         # Instead of larger models
371 | ollama pull gemma3:2b   # 2B parameter variant
372 | ```
373 | 
374 | **5. Port conflicts**
375 | 
376 | **Check what's using port 11434:**
377 | ```bash
378 | lsof -i :11434
379 | netstat -tulpn | grep 11434
380 | ```
381 | 
382 | **Use custom port:**
383 | ```bash
384 | OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:8080 ollama serve
385 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:8080
386 | ```
387 | 
388 | **6. "Failed to send message" in Chat**
389 | 
390 | **Symptom:** Chat shows "Failed to send message" toast notification. Logs may show:
391 | ```
392 | Error executing chat: Model is not a LanguageModel: None
393 | ```
394 | 
395 | **Causes (in order of likelihood):**
396 | 
397 | 1. **Model name mismatch**: The model name in Open Notebook doesn't exactly match `ollama list`
398 | 2. **No default model configured**: You haven't set a default chat model in Settings → Models
399 | 3. **Model was deleted**: You removed the model from Ollama but didn't update Open Notebook's defaults
400 | 4. **Model record deleted**: The model was removed from Open Notebook but is still set as default
401 | 
402 | **Solutions:**
403 | 
404 | **Check 1: Verify model names match exactly**
405 | ```bash
406 | # Get exact model names from Ollama
407 | ollama list
408 | 
409 | # Compare with what's configured in Open Notebook
410 | # Go to Settings → Models and verify the names match EXACTLY
411 | ```
412 | 
413 | **Check 2: Verify default models are set**
414 | 1. Go to **Settings → Models**
415 | 2. Scroll to **Default Models** section
416 | 3. Ensure **Default Chat Model** has a value selected
417 | 4. If empty, select an available language model
418 | 
419 | **Check 3: Refresh after changes**
420 | If you've added/removed models in Ollama:
421 | 1. Refresh the Open Notebook page
422 | 2. Go to Settings → Models
423 | 3. Re-add any missing models with exact names from `ollama list`
424 | 4. Re-select default models if needed
425 | 
426 | **Check 4: Test the model directly**
427 | ```bash
428 | # Verify Ollama can use the model
429 | ollama run gemma3:12b "Hello, world"
430 | ```
431 | 
432 | ### Docker-Specific Troubleshooting
433 | 
434 | **1. Linux: `host.docker.internal` not resolving (Most Common)**
435 | 
436 | If you see `Name or service not known` errors on Linux, add `extra_hosts` to your docker-compose.yml:
437 | 
438 | ```yaml
439 | services:
440 |   open_notebook:
441 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
442 |     extra_hosts:
443 |       - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
444 |     environment:
445 |       - OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://host.docker.internal:11434
446 |     # ... rest of your config
447 | ```
448 | 
449 | This maps `host.docker.internal` to your host machine's IP. macOS/Windows Docker Desktop does this automatically, but Linux requires explicit configuration.
450 | 
451 | **2. Host networking on Linux (alternative):**
452 | ```bash
453 | # Use host networking if host.docker.internal doesn't work
454 | docker run --network host lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
455 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:11434
456 | ```
457 | 
458 | **3. Custom bridge network:**
459 | ```yaml
460 | version: '3.8'
461 | networks:
462 |   ollama_network:
463 |     driver: bridge
464 | 
465 | services:
466 |   open-notebook:
467 |     networks:
468 |       - ollama_network
469 |     environment:
470 |       - OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://ollama:11434
471 | 
472 |   ollama:
473 |     networks:
474 |       - ollama_network
475 | ```
476 | 
477 | **3. Firewall issues:**
478 | ```bash
479 | # Allow Ollama port through firewall
480 | sudo ufw allow 11434
481 | # or
482 | sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=11434/tcp --permanent
483 | ```
484 | 
485 | ## Performance Optimization
486 | 
487 | ### Model Management
488 | 
489 | **List installed models:**
490 | ```bash
491 | ollama list
492 | ```
493 | 
494 | **Remove unused models:**
495 | ```bash
496 | ollama rm model_name
497 | ```
498 | 
499 | **Show running models:**
500 | ```bash
501 | ollama ps
502 | ```
503 | 
504 | **Preload models for faster startup:**
505 | ```bash
506 | # Keep model in memory
507 | curl http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d '{
508 |   "model": "qwen3",
509 |   "prompt": "test",
510 |   "keep_alive": -1
511 | }'
512 | ```
513 | 
514 | ### System Optimization
515 | 
516 | **Linux: Increase file limits:**
517 | ```bash
518 | echo "* soft nofile 65536" >> /etc/security/limits.conf
519 | echo "* hard nofile 65536" >> /etc/security/limits.conf
520 | ```
521 | 
522 | **macOS: Increase memory limits:**
523 | ```bash
524 | # Add to ~/.zshrc or ~/.bash_profile
525 | export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=2
526 | export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4
527 | ```
528 | 
529 | **Docker: Resource allocation:**
530 | ```yaml
531 | services:
532 |   ollama:
533 |     deploy:
534 |       resources:
535 |         limits:
536 |           memory: 8G
537 |           cpus: '4'
538 | ```
539 | 
540 | ## Advanced Configuration
541 | 
542 | ### Environment Variables
543 | 
544 | ```bash
545 | # Ollama server configuration
546 | export OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434      # Bind to all interfaces
547 | export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=5m            # Keep models in memory
548 | export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=3      # Max concurrent models
549 | export OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE=512            # Request queue size
550 | export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4           # Parallel request handling
551 | export OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1        # Enable flash attention (if supported)
552 | 
553 | # Open Notebook configuration
554 | export OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:11434
555 | ```
556 | 
557 | ### SSL Configuration (Self-Signed Certificates)
558 | 
559 | If you're running Ollama behind a reverse proxy with self-signed SSL certificates (e.g., Caddy, nginx with custom certs), you may encounter SSL verification errors:
560 | 
561 | ```
562 | [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate
563 | ```
564 | 
565 | **Solutions:**
566 | 
567 | **Option 1: Use a custom CA bundle (recommended)**
568 | ```bash
569 | # Point to your CA certificate file
570 | export ESPERANTO_SSL_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/your/ca-bundle.pem
571 | ```
572 | 
573 | **Option 2: Disable SSL verification (development only)**
574 | ```bash
575 | # WARNING: Only use in trusted development environments
576 | export ESPERANTO_SSL_VERIFY=false
577 | ```
578 | 
579 | **Docker Compose example with SSL configuration:**
580 | ```yaml
581 | services:
582 |   open-notebook:
583 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
584 |     pull_policy: always
585 |     environment:
586 |       - OLLAMA_API_BASE=https://ollama.local:11434
587 |       # Option 1: Custom CA bundle
588 |       - ESPERANTO_SSL_CA_BUNDLE=/certs/ca-bundle.pem
589 |       # Option 2: Disable verification (dev only)
590 |       # - ESPERANTO_SSL_VERIFY=false
591 |     volumes:
592 |       - /path/to/your/ca-bundle.pem:/certs/ca-bundle.pem:ro
593 | ```
594 | 
595 | > **Security Note:** Disabling SSL verification exposes you to man-in-the-middle attacks. Always prefer using a custom CA bundle in production environments.
596 | 
597 | ### Custom Model Imports
598 | 
599 | **Import custom models:**
600 | ```bash
601 | # Create Modelfile
602 | cat > Modelfile << EOF
603 | FROM qwen3
604 | PARAMETER temperature 0.7
605 | PARAMETER top_p 0.9
606 | SYSTEM "You are a helpful research assistant."
607 | EOF
608 | 
609 | # Create custom model
610 | ollama create my-research-model -f Modelfile
611 | ```
612 | 
613 | **Use in Open Notebook:**
614 | 1. Go to Models
615 | 2. Add new model: `my-research-model`
616 | 3. Set as default for specific tasks
617 | 
618 | ### Monitoring and Logging
619 | 
620 | **Monitor Ollama logs:**
621 | ```bash
622 | # Linux (systemd)
623 | journalctl -u ollama -f
624 | 
625 | # Docker
626 | docker logs -f ollama
627 | 
628 | # Manual run with verbose logging
629 | OLLAMA_DEBUG=1 ollama serve
630 | ```
631 | 
632 | **Resource monitoring:**
633 | ```bash
634 | # CPU and memory usage
635 | htop
636 | 
637 | # GPU usage (NVIDIA)
638 | nvidia-smi -l 1
639 | 
640 | # Model-specific metrics
641 | ollama ps
642 | ```
643 | 
644 | ## Integration Examples
645 | 
646 | ### Python Script Integration
647 | 
648 | ```python
649 | import requests
650 | import os
651 | 
652 | # Test Ollama connection
653 | ollama_base = os.environ.get('OLLAMA_API_BASE', 'http://localhost:11434')
654 | response = requests.get(f'{ollama_base}/api/tags')
655 | print(f"Available models: {response.json()}")
656 | 
657 | # Generate text
658 | payload = {
659 |     "model": "qwen3",
660 |     "prompt": "Explain quantum computing",
661 |     "stream": False
662 | }
663 | response = requests.post(f'{ollama_base}/api/generate', json=payload)
664 | print(response.json()['response'])
665 | ```
666 | 
667 | ### Health Check Script
668 | 
669 | ```bash
670 | #!/bin/bash
671 | # ollama-health-check.sh
672 | 
673 | OLLAMA_API_BASE=${OLLAMA_API_BASE:-"http://localhost:11434"}
674 | 
675 | echo "Checking Ollama health..."
676 | if curl -s "${OLLAMA_API_BASE}/api/tags" > /dev/null; then
677 |     echo "✅ Ollama is running"
678 |     echo "Available models:"
679 |     curl -s "${OLLAMA_API_BASE}/api/tags" | jq -r '.models[].name'
680 | else
681 |     echo "❌ Ollama is not accessible at ${OLLAMA_API_BASE}"
682 |     exit 1
683 | fi
684 | ```
685 | 
686 | ## Migration from Other Providers
687 | 
688 | ### Coming from OpenAI
689 | 
690 | **Similar performance models:**
691 | - GPT-4 → `qwen3` or `deepseek-r1`
692 | - GPT-3.5 → `gemma3` or `phi4`
693 | - text-embedding-ada-002 → `mxbai-embed-large`
694 | 
695 | **Cost comparison:**
696 | - OpenAI: $0.01-0.06 per 1K tokens
697 | - Ollama: $0 after hardware investment
698 | 
699 | ### Coming from Anthropic
700 | 
701 | **Claude replacement suggestions:**
702 | - Claude 3.5 Sonnet → `deepseek-r1` (reasoning)
703 | - Claude 3 Haiku → `phi4` (speed)
704 | 
705 | ## Best Practices
706 | 
707 | ### Security
708 | 
709 | 1. **Network Security:**
710 |    - Run Ollama only on trusted networks
711 |    - Use firewall rules to limit access
712 |    - Consider VPN for remote access
713 | 
714 | 2. **Model Verification:**
715 |    - Only pull models from trusted sources
716 |    - Verify model checksums when possible
717 | 
718 | 3. **Resource Limits:**
719 |    - Set memory and CPU limits in production
720 |    - Monitor resource usage regularly
721 | 
722 | ### Performance
723 | 
724 | 1. **Model Selection:**
725 |    - Use appropriate model size for your hardware
726 |    - Smaller models for simple tasks
727 |    - Reasoning models only when needed
728 | 
729 | 2. **Resource Management:**
730 |    - Preload frequently used models
731 |    - Remove unused models regularly
732 |    - Monitor system resources
733 | 
734 | 3. **Network Optimization:**
735 |    - Use local networks for better latency
736 |    - Consider SSD storage for faster model loading
737 | 
738 | ## Getting Help
739 | 
740 | **Community Resources:**
741 | - [Ollama GitHub](https://github.com/jmorganca/ollama) - Official repository
742 | - [Ollama Discord](https://discord.gg/ollama) - Community support
743 | - [Open Notebook Discord](https://discord.gg/37XJPXfz2w) - Integration help
744 | 
745 | **Debugging Resources:**
746 | - Check Ollama logs for error messages
747 | - Test connection with curl commands
748 | - Verify environment variables
749 | - Monitor system resources
750 | 
751 | This comprehensive guide should help you successfully deploy and optimize Ollama with Open Notebook. Start with the Quick Start section and refer to specific scenarios as needed.

413 | async def stream_source_chat_response(
414 |     session_id: str, source_id: str, message: str, model_override: Optional[str] = None
415 | ) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
416 |     """Stream the source chat response as Server-Sent Events."""
417 |     try:
418 |         # Get current state
419 |         current_state = await source_chat_graph.aget_state(
420 |             config=RunnableConfig(configurable={"thread_id": session_id})
421 |         )
422 | 
423 |         # Prepare state for execution
424 |         state_values = current_state.values if current_state else {}
425 |         state_values["messages"] = state_values.get("messages", [])
426 |         state_values["source_id"] = source_id
427 |         state_values["model_override"] = model_override
428 | 
429 |         # Add user message to state
430 |         user_message = HumanMessage(content=message)
431 |         state_values["messages"].append(user_message)
432 | 
433 |         # Send user message event
434 |         user_event = {"type": "user_message", "content": message, "timestamp": None}
435 |         yield f"data: {json.dumps(user_event)}\n\n"
436 | 
437 |         # Execute source chat graph synchronously (like notebook chat does)
438 |         result = source_chat_graph.invoke(
439 |             input=state_values,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
440 |             config=RunnableConfig(
441 |                 configurable={"thread_id": session_id, "model_id": model_override}
442 |             ),
443 |         )
444 | 
445 |         # Stream the complete AI response
446 |         if "messages" in result:
447 |             for msg in result["messages"]:
448 |                 if hasattr(msg, "type") and msg.type == "ai":
449 |                     ai_event = {
450 |                         "type": "ai_message",
451 |                         "content": msg.content if hasattr(msg, "content") else str(msg),
452 |                         "timestamp": None,
453 |                     }
454 |                     yield f"data: {json.dumps(ai_event)}\n\n"
455 | 
456 |         # Stream context indicators
457 |         if "context_indicators" in result:
458 |             context_event = {
459 |                 "type": "context_indicators",
460 |                 "data": result["context_indicators"],
461 |             }
462 |             yield f"data: {json.dumps(context_event)}\n\n"
463 | 
464 |         # Send completion signal
465 |         completion_event = {"type": "complete"}
466 |         yield f"data: {json.dumps(completion_event)}\n\n"
467 | 
468 |     except Exception as e:
469 |         logger.error(f"Error in source chat streaming: {str(e)}")
470 |         error_event = {"type": "error", "message": str(e)}
471 |         yield f"data: {json.dumps(error_event)}\n\n"
472 |

475 | async def send_message_to_source_chat(
476 |     request: SendMessageRequest,
477 |     source_id: str = Path(..., description="Source ID"),
478 |     session_id: str = Path(..., description="Session ID"),
479 | ):
480 |     """Send a message to source chat session with SSE streaming response."""
481 |     try:
482 |         # Verify source exists
483 |         full_source_id = (
484 |             source_id if source_id.startswith("source:") else f"source:{source_id}"
485 |         )
486 |         source = await Source.get(full_source_id)
487 |         if not source:
488 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Source not found")
489 | 
490 |         # Verify session exists and is related to source
491 |         full_session_id = (
492 |             session_id
493 |             if session_id.startswith("chat_session:")
494 |             else f"chat_session:{session_id}"
495 |         )
496 |         session = await ChatSession.get(full_session_id)
497 |         if not session:
498 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
499 | 
500 |         # Verify session is related to this source
501 |         relation_query = await repo_query(
502 |             "SELECT * FROM refers_to WHERE in = $session_id AND out = $source_id",
503 |             {
504 |                 "session_id": ensure_record_id(full_session_id),
505 |                 "source_id": ensure_record_id(full_source_id),
506 |             },
507 |         )
508 | 
509 |         if not relation_query:
510 |             raise HTTPException(
511 |                 status_code=404, detail="Session not found for this source"
512 |             )
513 | 
514 |         if not request.message:
515 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Message content is required")
516 | 
517 |         # Determine model override (request override takes precedence over session override)
518 |         model_override = request.model_override or getattr(
519 |             session, "model_override", None
520 |         )
521 | 
522 |         # Update session timestamp
523 |         await session.save()
524 | 
525 |         # Return streaming response
526 |         return StreamingResponse(
527 |             stream_source_chat_response(
528 |                 session_id=full_session_id,
529 |                 source_id=full_source_id,
530 |                 message=request.message,
531 |                 model_override=model_override,
532 |             ),
533 |             media_type="text/plain",
534 |             headers={
535 |                 "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
536 |                 "Connection": "keep-alive",
537 |                 "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
538 |             },
539 |         )
540 | 
541 |     except HTTPException:
542 |         raise
543 |     except Exception as e:
544 |         logger.error(f"Error sending message to source chat: {str(e)}")
545 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Error sending message: {str(e)}")

 18 | import { SourceTypeStep, parseAndValidateUrls } from './steps/SourceTypeStep'
 19 | import { NotebooksStep } from './steps/NotebooksStep'
 20 | import { ProcessingStep } from './steps/ProcessingStep'
 21 | import { useNotebooks } from '@/lib/hooks/use-notebooks'
 22 | import { useTransformations } from '@/lib/hooks/use-transformations'
 23 | import { useCreateSource } from '@/lib/hooks/use-sources'
 24 | import { useSettings } from '@/lib/hooks/use-settings'
 25 | import { CreateSourceRequest } from '@/lib/types/api'
 26 | import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/hooks/use-translation'
 27 | 
 28 | const MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 50
 29 | 
 30 | const createSourceSchema = z.object({
 31 |   type: z.enum(['link', 'upload', 'text']),
 32 |   title: z.string().optional(),
 33 |   url: z.string().optional(),
 34 |   content: z.string().optional(),
 35 |   file: z.any().optional(),
 36 |   notebooks: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 37 |   transformations: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 38 |   embed: z.boolean(),
 39 |   async_processing: z.boolean(),
 40 | }).refine((data) => {
 41 |   if (data.type === 'link') {
 42 |     return !!data.url && data.url.trim() !== ''
 43 |   }
 44 |   if (data.type === 'text') {
 45 |     return !!data.content && data.content.trim() !== ''
 46 |   }
 47 |   if (data.type === 'upload') {
 48 |     if (data.file instanceof FileList) {
 49 |       return data.file.length > 0
 50 |     }
 51 |     return !!data.file
 52 |   }
 53 |   return true
 54 | }, {
 55 |   message: 'Please provide the required content for the selected source type',
 56 |   path: ['type'],
 57 | }).refine((data) => {
 58 |   // Make title mandatory for text sources
 59 |   if (data.type === 'text') {
 60 |     return !!data.title && data.title.trim() !== ''
 61 |   }
 62 |   return true
 63 | }, {
 64 |   message: 'Title is required for text sources',
 65 |   path: ['title'],
 66 | })
 67 | 
 68 | type CreateSourceFormData = z.infer<typeof createSourceSchema>
 69 | 
 70 | interface AddSourceDialogProps {
 71 |   open: boolean
 72 |   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
 73 |   defaultNotebookId?: string
 74 | }
 75 | 
 76 | interface ProcessingState {
 77 |   message: string
 78 |   progress?: number
 79 | }
 80 | 
 81 | interface BatchProgress {
 82 |   total: number
 83 |   completed: number
 84 |   failed: number
 85 |   currentItem?: string
 86 | }
 87 | 
 88 | export function AddSourceDialog({ 
 89 |   open, 
 90 |   onOpenChange, 
 91 |   defaultNotebookId 
 92 | }: AddSourceDialogProps) {
 93 |   const { t } = useTranslation()
 94 | 
 95 |   const WIZARD_STEPS: readonly WizardStep[] = [
 96 |     { number: 1, title: t.sources.addSource, description: t.sources.processDescription },
 97 |     { number: 2, title: t.navigation.notebooks, description: t.notebooks.searchPlaceholder },
 98 |     { number: 3, title: t.navigation.process, description: t.sources.processDescription },
 99 |   ]
100 | 
101 |   // Simplified state management
102 |   const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1)
103 |   const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false)
104 |   const [processingStatus, setProcessingStatus] = useState<ProcessingState | null>(null)
105 |   const [selectedNotebooks, setSelectedNotebooks] = useState<string[]>(
106 |     defaultNotebookId ? [defaultNotebookId] : []
107 |   )
108 |   const [selectedTransformations, setSelectedTransformations] = useState<string[]>([])
109 | 
110 |   // Batch-specific state
111 |   const [urlValidationErrors, setUrlValidationErrors] = useState<{ url: string; line: number }[]>([])
112 |   const [batchProgress, setBatchProgress] = useState<BatchProgress | null>(null)
113 | 
114 |   // Cleanup timeouts to prevent memory leaks
115 |   const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null)
116 | 
117 |   // API hooks
118 |   const createSource = useCreateSource()
119 |   const { data: notebooks = [], isLoading: notebooksLoading } = useNotebooks()
120 |   const { data: transformations = [], isLoading: transformationsLoading } = useTransformations()
121 |   const { data: settings } = useSettings()
122 | 
123 |   // Form setup
124 |   const {
125 |     register,
126 |     handleSubmit,
127 |     control,
128 |     watch,
129 |     setValue,
130 |     formState: { errors },
131 |     reset,
132 |   } = useForm<CreateSourceFormData>({
133 |     resolver: zodResolver(createSourceSchema),
134 |     defaultValues: {
135 |       notebooks: defaultNotebookId ? [defaultNotebookId] : [],
136 |       embed: settings?.default_embedding_option === 'always' || settings?.default_embedding_option === 'ask',
137 |       async_processing: true,
138 |       transformations: [],
139 |     },
140 |   })
141 | 
142 |   // Initialize form values when settings and transformations are loaded
143 |   useEffect(() => {
144 |     if (settings && transformations.length > 0) {
145 |       const defaultTransformations = transformations
146 |         .filter(t => t.apply_default)
147 |         .map(t => t.id)
148 | 
149 |       setSelectedTransformations(defaultTransformations)
150 | 
151 |       // Reset form with proper embed value based on settings
152 |       const embedValue = settings.default_embedding_option === 'always' ||
153 |                          (settings.default_embedding_option === 'ask')
154 | 
155 |       reset({
156 |         notebooks: defaultNotebookId ? [defaultNotebookId] : [],
157 |         embed: embedValue,
158 |         async_processing: true,
159 |         transformations: [],
160 |       })
161 |     }
162 |   }, [settings, transformations, defaultNotebookId, reset])
163 | 
164 |   // Cleanup effect
165 |   useEffect(() => {
166 |     return () => {
167 |       if (timeoutRef.current) {
168 |         clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)
169 |       }
170 |     }
171 |   }, [])
172 | 
173 |   const selectedType = watch('type')
174 |   const watchedUrl = watch('url')
175 |   const watchedContent = watch('content')
176 |   const watchedFile = watch('file')
177 |   const watchedTitle = watch('title')
178 | 
179 |   // Batch mode detection
180 |   const { isBatchMode, itemCount, parsedUrls, parsedFiles } = useMemo(() => {
181 |     let urlCount = 0
182 |     let fileCount = 0
183 |     let parsedUrls: string[] = []
184 |     let parsedFiles: File[] = []
185 | 
186 |     if (selectedType === 'link' && watchedUrl) {
187 |       const { valid } = parseAndValidateUrls(watchedUrl)
188 |       parsedUrls = valid
189 |       urlCount = valid.length
190 |     }
191 | 
192 |     if (selectedType === 'upload' && watchedFile) {
193 |       const fileList = watchedFile as FileList
194 |       if (fileList?.length) {
195 |         parsedFiles = Array.from(fileList)
196 |         fileCount = parsedFiles.length
197 |       }
198 |     }
199 | 
200 |     const isBatchMode = urlCount > 1 || fileCount > 1
201 |     const itemCount = selectedType === 'link' ? urlCount : fileCount
202 | 
203 |     return { isBatchMode, itemCount, parsedUrls, parsedFiles }
204 |   }, [selectedType, watchedUrl, watchedFile])
205 | 
206 |   // Check for batch size limit
207 |   const isOverLimit = itemCount > MAX_BATCH_SIZE
208 | 
209 |   // Step validation - now reactive with watched values
210 |   const isStepValid = (step: number): boolean => {
211 |     switch (step) {
212 |       case 1:
213 |         if (!selectedType) return false
214 |         // Check batch size limit
215 |         if (isOverLimit) return false
216 |         // Check for URL validation errors
217 |         if (urlValidationErrors.length > 0) return false
218 | 
219 |         if (selectedType === 'link') {
220 |           // In batch mode, check that we have at least one valid URL
221 |           if (isBatchMode) {
222 |             return parsedUrls.length > 0
223 |           }
224 |           return !!watchedUrl && watchedUrl.trim() !== ''
225 |         }
226 |         if (selectedType === 'text') {
227 |           return !!watchedContent && watchedContent.trim() !== '' &&
228 |                  !!watchedTitle && watchedTitle.trim() !== ''
229 |         }
230 |         if (selectedType === 'upload') {
231 |           if (watchedFile instanceof FileList) {
232 |             return watchedFile.length > 0 && watchedFile.length <= MAX_BATCH_SIZE
233 |           }
234 |           return !!watchedFile
235 |         }
236 |         return true
237 |       case 2:
238 |       case 3:
239 |         return true
240 |       default:
241 |         return false
242 |     }
243 |   }
244 | 
245 |   // Navigation
246 |   const handleNextStep = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
247 |     e?.preventDefault()
248 |     e?.stopPropagation()
249 | 
250 |     // Validate URLs when leaving step 1 in link mode
251 |     if (currentStep === 1 && selectedType === 'link' && watchedUrl) {
252 |       const { invalid } = parseAndValidateUrls(watchedUrl)
253 |       if (invalid.length > 0) {
254 |         setUrlValidationErrors(invalid)
255 |         return
256 |       }
257 |       setUrlValidationErrors([])
258 |     }
259 | 
260 |     if (currentStep < 3 && isStepValid(currentStep)) {
261 |       setCurrentStep(currentStep + 1)
262 |     }
263 |   }
264 | 
265 |   // Clear URL validation errors when user edits
266 |   const handleClearUrlErrors = () => {
267 |     setUrlValidationErrors([])
268 |   }
269 | 
270 |   const handlePrevStep = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
271 |     e?.preventDefault()
272 |     e?.stopPropagation()
273 |     if (currentStep > 1) {
274 |       setCurrentStep(currentStep - 1)
275 |     }
276 |   }
277 | 
278 |   const handleStepClick = (step: number) => {
279 |     if (step <= currentStep || (step === currentStep + 1 && isStepValid(currentStep))) {
280 |       setCurrentStep(step)
281 |     }
282 |   }
283 | 
284 |   // Selection handlers
285 |   const handleNotebookToggle = (notebookId: string) => {
286 |     const updated = selectedNotebooks.includes(notebookId)
287 |       ? selectedNotebooks.filter(id => id !== notebookId)
288 |       : [...selectedNotebooks, notebookId]
289 |     setSelectedNotebooks(updated)
290 |   }
291 | 
292 |   const handleTransformationToggle = (transformationId: string) => {
293 |     const updated = selectedTransformations.includes(transformationId)
294 |       ? selectedTransformations.filter(id => id !== transformationId)
295 |       : [...selectedTransformations, transformationId]
296 |     setSelectedTransformations(updated)
297 |   }
298 | 
299 |   // Single source submission
300 |   const submitSingleSource = async (data: CreateSourceFormData): Promise<void> => {
301 |     const createRequest: CreateSourceRequest = {
302 |       type: data.type,
303 |       notebooks: selectedNotebooks,
304 |       url: data.type === 'link' ? data.url : undefined,
305 |       content: data.type === 'text' ? data.content : undefined,
306 |       title: data.title,
307 |       transformations: selectedTransformations,
308 |       embed: data.embed,
309 |       delete_source: false,
310 |       async_processing: true,
311 |     }
312 | 
313 |     if (data.type === 'upload' && data.file) {
314 |       const file = data.file instanceof FileList ? data.file[0] : data.file
315 |       const requestWithFile = createRequest as CreateSourceRequest & { file?: File }
316 |       requestWithFile.file = file
317 |     }
318 | 
319 |     await createSource.mutateAsync(createRequest)
320 |   }
321 | 
322 |   // Batch submission
323 |   const submitBatch = async (data: CreateSourceFormData): Promise<{ success: number; failed: number }> => {
324 |     const results = { success: 0, failed: 0 }
325 |     const items: { type: 'url' | 'file'; value: string | File }[] = []
326 | 
327 |     // Collect items to process
328 |     if (data.type === 'link' && parsedUrls.length > 0) {
329 |       parsedUrls.forEach(url => items.push({ type: 'url', value: url }))
330 |     } else if (data.type === 'upload' && parsedFiles.length > 0) {
331 |       parsedFiles.forEach(file => items.push({ type: 'file', value: file }))
332 |     }
333 | 
334 |     setBatchProgress({
335 |       total: items.length,
336 |       completed: 0,
337 |       failed: 0,
338 |     })
339 | 
340 |     // Process each item sequentially
341 |     for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
342 |       const item = items[i]
343 |       const itemLabel = item.type === 'url'
344 |         ? (item.value as string).substring(0, 50) + '...'
345 |         : (item.value as File).name
346 | 
347 |       setBatchProgress(prev => prev ? {
348 |         ...prev,
349 |         currentItem: itemLabel,
350 |       } : null)
351 | 
352 |       try {
353 |         const createRequest: CreateSourceRequest = {
354 |           type: item.type === 'url' ? 'link' : 'upload',
355 |           notebooks: selectedNotebooks,
356 |           url: item.type === 'url' ? item.value as string : undefined,
357 |           transformations: selectedTransformations,
358 |           embed: data.embed,
359 |           delete_source: false,
360 |           async_processing: true,
361 |         }
362 | 
363 |         if (item.type === 'file') {
364 |           const requestWithFile = createRequest as CreateSourceRequest & { file?: File }
365 |           requestWithFile.file = item.value as File
366 |         }
367 | 
368 |         await createSource.mutateAsync(createRequest)
369 |         results.success++
370 |       } catch (error) {
371 |         console.error(`Error creating source for ${itemLabel}:`, error)
372 |         results.failed++
373 |       }
374 | 
375 |       setBatchProgress(prev => prev ? {
376 |         ...prev,
377 |         completed: results.success,
378 |         failed: results.failed,
379 |       } : null)
380 |     }
381 | 
382 |     return results
383 |   }
384 | 
385 |   // Form submission
386 |   const onSubmit = async (data: CreateSourceFormData) => {
387 |     try {
388 |       setProcessing(true)
389 | 
390 |       if (isBatchMode) {
391 |         // Batch submission
392 |         setProcessingStatus({ message: t.sources.processingFiles })
393 |         const results = await submitBatch(data)
394 | 
395 |         // Show summary toast
396 |         if (results.failed === 0) {
397 |           toast.success(t.sources.batchSuccess.replace('{count}', results.success.toString()))
398 |         } else if (results.success === 0) {
399 |           toast.error(t.sources.batchFailed.replace('{count}', results.failed.toString()))
400 |         } else {
401 |           toast.warning(t.sources.batchPartial.replace('{success}', results.success.toString()).replace('{failed}', results.failed.toString()))
402 |         }
403 | 
404 |         handleClose()
405 |       } else {
406 |         // Single source submission
407 |         setProcessingStatus({ message: t.sources.submittingSource })
408 |         await submitSingleSource(data)
409 |         handleClose()
410 |       }
411 |     } catch (error) {
412 |       console.error('Error creating source:', error)
413 |       setProcessingStatus({
414 |         message: t.common.error,
415 |       })
416 |       timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
417 |         setProcessing(false)
418 |         setProcessingStatus(null)
419 |         setBatchProgress(null)
420 |       }, 3000)
421 |     }
422 |   }
423 | 
424 |   // Dialog management
425 |   const handleClose = () => {
426 |     // Clear any pending timeouts
427 |     if (timeoutRef.current) {
428 |       clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)
429 |       timeoutRef.current = null
430 |     }
431 | 
432 |     reset()
433 |     setCurrentStep(1)
434 |     setProcessing(false)
435 |     setProcessingStatus(null)
436 |     setSelectedNotebooks(defaultNotebookId ? [defaultNotebookId] : [])
437 |     setUrlValidationErrors([])
438 |     setBatchProgress(null)
439 | 
440 |     // Reset to default transformations
441 |     if (transformations.length > 0) {
442 |       const defaultTransformations = transformations
443 |         .filter(t => t.apply_default)
444 |         .map(t => t.id)
445 |       setSelectedTransformations(defaultTransformations)
446 |     } else {
447 |       setSelectedTransformations([])
448 |     }
449 | 
450 |     onOpenChange(false)
451 |   }
452 | 
453 |   // Processing view
454 |   if (processing) {
455 |     const progressPercent = batchProgress
456 |       ? Math.round(((batchProgress.completed + batchProgress.failed) / batchProgress.total) * 100)
457 |       : undefined
458 | 
459 |     return (
460 |       <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleClose}>
461 |         <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]" showCloseButton={true}>
462 |           <DialogHeader>
463 |             <DialogTitle>
464 |               {batchProgress ? t.sources.processingFiles : t.sources.statusProcessing}
465 |             </DialogTitle>
466 |             <DialogDescription>
467 |               {batchProgress
468 |                 ? t.sources.processingBatchSources.replace('{count}', batchProgress.total.toString())
469 |                 : t.sources.processingSource
470 |               }
471 |             </DialogDescription>
472 |           </DialogHeader>
473 | 
474 |           <div className="space-y-4 py-4">
475 |             <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
476 |               <LoaderIcon className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-primary" />
477 |               <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
478 |                 {processingStatus?.message || t.common.processing}
479 |               </span>
480 |             </div>
481 | 
482 |             {/* Batch progress */}
483 |             {batchProgress && (
484 |               <>
485 |                 <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
486 |                   <div
487 |                     className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
488 |                     style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
489 |                   />
490 |                 </div>
491 | 
492 |                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
493 |                   <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
494 |                     <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-green-600">
495 |                       <CheckCircleIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
496 |                       {batchProgress.completed} {t.common.completed}
497 |                     </span>
498 |                     {batchProgress.failed > 0 && (
499 |                       <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-destructive">
500 |                         <XCircleIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
501 |                         {batchProgress.failed} {t.common.failed}
502 |                       </span>
503 |                     )}
504 |                   </div>
505 |                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
506 |                     {batchProgress.completed + batchProgress.failed} / {batchProgress.total}
507 |                   </span>
508 |                 </div>
509 | 
510 |                 {batchProgress.currentItem && (
511 |                   <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
512 |                     {t.common.current}: {batchProgress.currentItem}
513 |                   </p>
514 |                 )}
515 |               </>
516 |             )}
517 | 
518 |             {/* Single source progress */}
519 |             {!batchProgress && processingStatus?.progress && (
520 |               <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
521 |                 <div
522 |                   className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
523 |                   style={{ width: `${processingStatus.progress}%` }}
524 |                 />
525 |               </div>
526 |             )}
527 |           </div>
528 |         </DialogContent>
529 |       </Dialog>
530 |     )
531 |   }
532 | 
533 |   const currentStepValid = isStepValid(currentStep)
534 | 
535 |   return (
536 |     <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleClose}>
537 |       <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[700px] p-0">
538 |         <DialogHeader className="px-6 pt-6 pb-0">
539 |           <DialogTitle>{t.sources.addNew}</DialogTitle>
540 |           <DialogDescription>
541 |             {t.sources.processDescription}
542 |           </DialogDescription>
543 |         </DialogHeader>
544 | 
545 |         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
546 |           <WizardContainer
547 |             currentStep={currentStep}
548 |             steps={WIZARD_STEPS}
549 |             onStepClick={handleStepClick}
550 |             className="border-0"
551 |           >
552 |             {currentStep === 1 && (
553 |               <SourceTypeStep
554 |                 // @ts-expect-error - Type inference issue with zod schema
555 |                 control={control}
556 |                 register={register}
557 |                 setValue={setValue}
558 |                 // @ts-expect-error - Type inference issue with zod schema
559 |                 errors={errors}
560 |                 urlValidationErrors={urlValidationErrors}
561 |                 onClearUrlErrors={handleClearUrlErrors}
562 |               />
563 |             )}
564 |             
565 |             {currentStep === 2 && (
566 |               <NotebooksStep
567 |                 notebooks={notebooks}
568 |                 selectedNotebooks={selectedNotebooks}
569 |                 onToggleNotebook={handleNotebookToggle}
570 |                 loading={notebooksLoading}
571 |               />
572 |             )}
573 |             
574 |             {currentStep === 3 && (
575 |               <ProcessingStep
576 |                 // @ts-expect-error - Type inference issue with zod schema
577 |                 control={control}
578 |                 transformations={transformations}
579 |                 selectedTransformations={selectedTransformations}
580 |                 onToggleTransformation={handleTransformationToggle}
581 |                 loading={transformationsLoading}
582 |                 settings={settings}
583 |               />
584 |             )}
585 |           </WizardContainer>
586 | 
587 |           {/* Navigation */}
588 |           <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 border-t border-border bg-muted">
589 |             <Button 
590 |               type="button" 
591 |               variant="outline" 
592 |               onClick={handleClose}
593 |             >
594 |               {t.common.cancel}
595 |             </Button>
596 | 
597 |             <div className="flex gap-2">
598 |               {currentStep > 1 && (
599 |                 <Button
600 |                   type="button"
601 |                   variant="outline"
602 |                   onClick={handlePrevStep}
603 |                 >
604 |                   {t.common.back}
605 |                 </Button>
606 |               )}
607 | 
608 |               {/* Show Next button on steps 1 and 2, styled as outline/secondary */}
609 |               {currentStep < 3 && (
610 |                 <Button
611 |                   type="button"
612 |                   variant="outline"
613 |                   onClick={(e) => handleNextStep(e)}
614 |                   disabled={!currentStepValid}
615 |                 >
616 |                   {t.common.next}
617 |                 </Button>
618 |               )}
619 | 
620 |               {/* Show Done button on all steps, styled as primary */}
621 |               <Button
622 |                 type="submit"
623 |                 disabled={!currentStepValid || createSource.isPending}
624 |                 className="min-w-[120px]"
625 |               >
626 |                 {createSource.isPending ? t.common.adding : t.common.done}
627 |               </Button>
628 |             </div>
629 |           </div>
630 |         </form>
631 |       </DialogContent>
632 |     </Dialog>
633 |   )
634 | }
635 |

 27 | export default function SearchPage() {
 28 |   const { t } = useTranslation()

 32 |   const rawMode = searchParams?.get('mode')
 33 |   const urlMode = rawMode === 'search' ? 'search' : 'ask'
 34 | 
 35 |   // Tab state (controlled)
 36 |   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'ask' | 'search'>(
 37 |     urlMode === 'search' ? 'search' : 'ask'
 38 |   )
 39 | 
 40 |   // Search state
 41 |   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(urlMode === 'search' ? urlQuery : '')
 42 |   const [searchType, setSearchType] = useState<'text' | 'vector'>('text')
 43 |   const [searchSources, setSearchSources] = useState(true)

 16 | class Notebook(ObjectModel):
 17 |     table_name: ClassVar[str] = "notebook"
 18 |     name: str
 19 |     description: str
 20 |     archived: Optional[bool] = False
 21 | 
 22 |     @field_validator("name")
 23 |     @classmethod
 24 |     def name_must_not_be_empty(cls, v):
 25 |         if not v.strip():
 26 |             raise InvalidInputError("Notebook name cannot be empty")
 27 |         return v
 28 | 
 29 |     async def get_sources(self) -> List["Source"]:
 30 |         try:
 31 |             srcs = await repo_query(
 32 |                 """
 33 |                 select * omit source.full_text from (
 34 |                 select in as source from reference where out=$id
 35 |                 fetch source
 36 |             ) order by source.updated desc
 37 |             """,
 38 |                 {"id": ensure_record_id(self.id)},
 39 |             )
 40 |             return [Source(**src["source"]) for src in srcs] if srcs else []
 41 |         except Exception as e:
 42 |             logger.error(f"Error fetching sources for notebook {self.id}: {str(e)}")
 43 |             logger.exception(e)
 44 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
 45 | 
 46 |     async def get_notes(self) -> List["Note"]:
 47 |         try:
 48 |             srcs = await repo_query(
 49 |                 """
 50 |             select * omit note.content, note.embedding from (
 51 |                 select in as note from artifact where out=$id
 52 |                 fetch note
 53 |             ) order by note.updated desc
 54 |             """,
 55 |                 {"id": ensure_record_id(self.id)},
 56 |             )
 57 |             return [Note(**src["note"]) for src in srcs] if srcs else []
 58 |         except Exception as e:
 59 |             logger.error(f"Error fetching notes for notebook {self.id}: {str(e)}")
 60 |             logger.exception(e)
 61 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
 62 | 
 63 |     async def get_chat_sessions(self) -> List["ChatSession"]:
 64 |         try:
 65 |             srcs = await repo_query(
 66 |                 """
 67 |                 select * from (
 68 |                     select
 69 |                     <- chat_session as chat_session
 70 |                     from refers_to
 71 |                     where out=$id
 72 |                     fetch chat_session
 73 |                 )
 74 |                 order by chat_session.updated desc
 75 |             """,
 76 |                 {"id": ensure_record_id(self.id)},
 77 |             )
 78 |             return (
 79 |                 [ChatSession(**src["chat_session"][0]) for src in srcs] if srcs else []
 80 |             )
 81 |         except Exception as e:
 82 |             logger.error(
 83 |                 f"Error fetching chat sessions for notebook {self.id}: {str(e)}"
 84 |             )
 85 |             logger.exception(e)
 86 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
 87 | 
 88 |     async def get_delete_preview(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 89 |         """
 90 |         Get counts of items that would be affected by deleting this notebook.
 91 | 
 92 |         Returns a dict with:
 93 |         - note_count: Number of notes that will be deleted
 94 |         - exclusive_source_count: Sources only in this notebook (can be deleted)
 95 |         - shared_source_count: Sources in other notebooks (will be unlinked only)
 96 |         """
 97 |         try:
 98 |             notebook_id = ensure_record_id(self.id)
 99 | 
100 |             # Count notes
101 |             note_result = await repo_query(
102 |                 "SELECT count() as count FROM artifact WHERE out = $notebook_id GROUP ALL",
103 |                 {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
104 |             )
105 |             note_count = note_result[0]["count"] if note_result else 0
106 | 
107 |             # Get sources with count of references to OTHER notebooks
108 |             # If assigned_others = 0, source is exclusive to this notebook
109 |             # If assigned_others > 0, source is shared with other notebooks
110 |             source_counts = await repo_query(
111 |                 """
112 |                 SELECT
113 |                     id,
114 |                     count(->reference[WHERE out != $notebook_id].out) as assigned_others
115 |                 FROM (SELECT VALUE <-reference.in AS sources FROM $notebook_id)[0]
116 |                 """,
117 |                 {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
118 |             )
119 | 
120 |             exclusive_count = 0
121 |             shared_count = 0
122 |             for src in source_counts:
123 |                 if src.get("assigned_others", 0) == 0:
124 |                     exclusive_count += 1
125 |                 else:
126 |                     shared_count += 1
127 | 
128 |             return {
129 |                 "note_count": note_count,
130 |                 "exclusive_source_count": exclusive_count,
131 |                 "shared_source_count": shared_count,
132 |             }
133 |         except Exception as e:
134 |             logger.error(f"Error getting delete preview for notebook {self.id}: {e}")
135 |             logger.exception(e)
136 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
137 | 
138 |     async def delete(self, delete_exclusive_sources: bool = False) -> Dict[str, int]:
139 |         """
140 |         Delete notebook with cascade deletion of notes and optional source deletion.
141 | 
142 |         Args:
143 |             delete_exclusive_sources: If True, also delete sources that belong
144 |                                      only to this notebook. Default is False.
145 | 
146 |         Returns:
147 |             Dict with counts: deleted_notes, deleted_sources, unlinked_sources
148 |         """
149 |         if self.id is None:
150 |             raise InvalidInputError("Cannot delete notebook without an ID")
151 | 
152 |         try:
153 |             notebook_id = ensure_record_id(self.id)
154 |             deleted_notes = 0
155 |             deleted_sources = 0
156 |             unlinked_sources = 0
157 | 
158 |             # 1. Get and delete all notes linked to this notebook
159 |             notes = await self.get_notes()
160 |             for note in notes:
161 |                 await note.delete()
162 |                 deleted_notes += 1
163 |             logger.info(f"Deleted {deleted_notes} notes for notebook {self.id}")
164 | 
165 |             # Delete artifact relationships
166 |             await repo_query(
167 |                 "DELETE artifact WHERE out = $notebook_id",
168 |                 {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
169 |             )
170 | 
171 |             # 2. Handle sources
172 |             if delete_exclusive_sources:
173 |                 # Find sources with count of references to OTHER notebooks
174 |                 # If assigned_others = 0, source is exclusive to this notebook
175 |                 source_counts = await repo_query(
176 |                     """
177 |                     SELECT
178 |                         id,
179 |                         count(->reference[WHERE out != $notebook_id].out) as assigned_others
180 |                     FROM (SELECT VALUE <-reference.in AS sources FROM $notebook_id)[0]
181 |                     """,
182 |                     {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
183 |                 )
184 | 
185 |                 for src in source_counts:
186 |                     source_id = src.get("id")
187 |                     if source_id and src.get("assigned_others", 0) == 0:
188 |                         # Exclusive source - delete it
189 |                         try:
190 |                             source = await Source.get(str(source_id))
191 |                             await source.delete()
192 |                             deleted_sources += 1
193 |                         except Exception as e:
194 |                             logger.warning(
195 |                                 f"Failed to delete exclusive source {source_id}: {e}"
196 |                             )
197 |                     else:
198 |                         unlinked_sources += 1
199 |             else:
200 |                 # Just count sources that will be unlinked
201 |                 source_result = await repo_query(
202 |                     "SELECT count() as count FROM reference WHERE out = $notebook_id GROUP ALL",
203 |                     {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
204 |                 )
205 |                 unlinked_sources = source_result[0]["count"] if source_result else 0
206 | 
207 |             # Delete reference relationships (unlink all sources)
208 |             await repo_query(
209 |                 "DELETE reference WHERE out = $notebook_id",
210 |                 {"notebook_id": notebook_id},
211 |             )
212 |             logger.info(
213 |                 f"Unlinked {unlinked_sources} sources, deleted {deleted_sources} "
214 |                 f"exclusive sources for notebook {self.id}"
215 |             )
216 | 
217 |             # 3. Delete the notebook record itself
218 |             await super().delete()
219 |             logger.info(f"Deleted notebook {self.id}")
220 | 
221 |             return {
222 |                 "deleted_notes": deleted_notes,
223 |                 "deleted_sources": deleted_sources,
224 |                 "unlinked_sources": unlinked_sources,
225 |             }
226 | 
227 |         except Exception as e:
228 |             logger.error(f"Error deleting notebook {self.id}: {e}")
229 |             logger.exception(e)
230 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(f"Failed to delete notebook: {e}")
231 |
