288 | class Source(ObjectModel):
289 |     model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)
290 | 
291 |     table_name: ClassVar[str] = "source"
292 |     asset: Optional[Asset] = None
293 |     title: Optional[str] = None
294 |     topics: Optional[List[str]] = Field(default_factory=list)
295 |     full_text: Optional[str] = None
296 |     command: Optional[Union[str, RecordID]] = Field(
297 |         default=None, description="Link to surreal-commands processing job"
298 |     )
299 | 
300 |     @field_validator("command", mode="before")
301 |     @classmethod
302 |     def parse_command(cls, value):
303 |         """Parse command field to ensure RecordID format"""
304 |         if isinstance(value, str) and value:
305 |             return ensure_record_id(value)
306 |         return value
307 | 
308 |     @field_validator("id", mode="before")
309 |     @classmethod
310 |     def parse_id(cls, value):
311 |         """Parse id field to handle both string and RecordID inputs"""
312 |         if value is None:
313 |             return None
314 |         if isinstance(value, RecordID):
315 |             return str(value)
316 |         return str(value) if value else None
317 | 
318 |     async def get_status(self) -> Optional[str]:
319 |         """Get the processing status of the associated command"""
320 |         if not self.command:
321 |             return None
322 | 
323 |         try:
324 |             from surreal_commands import get_command_status
325 | 
326 |             status = await get_command_status(str(self.command))
327 |             return status.status if status else "unknown"
328 |         except Exception as e:
329 |             logger.warning(f"Failed to get command status for {self.command}: {e}")
330 |             return "unknown"
331 | 
332 |     async def get_processing_progress(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
333 |         """Get detailed processing information for the associated command"""
334 |         if not self.command:
335 |             return None
336 | 
337 |         try:
338 |             from surreal_commands import get_command_status
339 | 
340 |             status_result = await get_command_status(str(self.command))
341 |             if not status_result:
342 |                 return None
343 | 
344 |             # Extract execution metadata if available
345 |             result = getattr(status_result, "result", None)
346 |             execution_metadata = (
347 |                 result.get("execution_metadata", {}) if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
348 |             )
349 | 
350 |             return {
351 |                 "status": status_result.status,
352 |                 "started_at": execution_metadata.get("started_at"),
353 |                 "completed_at": execution_metadata.get("completed_at"),
354 |                 "error": getattr(status_result, "error_message", None),
355 |                 "result": result,
356 |             }
357 |         except Exception as e:
358 |             logger.warning(f"Failed to get command progress for {self.command}: {e}")
359 |             return None
360 | 
361 |     async def get_context(
362 |         self, context_size: Literal["short", "long"] = "short"
363 |     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
364 |         insights_list = await self.get_insights()
365 |         insights = [insight.model_dump() for insight in insights_list]
366 |         if context_size == "long":
367 |             return dict(
368 |                 id=self.id,
369 |                 title=self.title,
370 |                 insights=insights,
371 |                 full_text=self.full_text,
372 |             )
373 |         else:
374 |             return dict(id=self.id, title=self.title, insights=insights)
375 | 
376 |     async def get_embedded_chunks(self) -> int:
377 |         try:
378 |             result = await repo_query(
379 |                 """
380 |                 select count() as chunks from source_embedding where source=$id GROUP ALL
381 |                 """,
382 |                 {"id": ensure_record_id(self.id)},
383 |             )
384 |             if len(result) == 0:
385 |                 return 0
386 |             return result[0]["chunks"]
387 |         except Exception as e:
388 |             logger.error(f"Error fetching chunks count for source {self.id}: {str(e)}")
389 |             logger.exception(e)
390 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(f"Failed to count chunks for source: {str(e)}")
391 | 
392 |     async def get_insights(self) -> List[SourceInsight]:
393 |         try:
394 |             result = await repo_query(
395 |                 """
396 |                 SELECT * FROM source_insight WHERE source=$id
397 |                 """,
398 |                 {"id": ensure_record_id(self.id)},
399 |             )
400 |             return [SourceInsight(**insight) for insight in result]
401 |         except Exception as e:
402 |             logger.error(f"Error fetching insights for source {self.id}: {str(e)}")
403 |             logger.exception(e)
404 |             raise DatabaseOperationError("Failed to fetch insights for source")
405 | 
406 |     async def add_to_notebook(self, notebook_id: str) -> Any:
407 |         if not notebook_id:
408 |             raise InvalidInputError("Notebook ID must be provided")
409 |         return await self.relate("reference", notebook_id)
410 | 
411 |     async def vectorize(self) -> str:
412 |         """
413 |         Submit vectorization as a background job using the embed_source command.
414 | 
415 |         This method leverages the job-based architecture to prevent HTTP connection
416 |         pool exhaustion when processing large documents. The embed_source command:
417 |         1. Detects content type from file path
418 |         2. Chunks text using content-type aware splitter
419 |         3. Generates all embeddings in a single API call
420 |         4. Bulk inserts source_embedding records
421 | 
422 |         Returns:
423 |             str: The command/job ID that can be used to track progress via the commands API
424 | 
425 |         Raises:
426 |             ValueError: If source has no text to vectorize
427 |             DatabaseOperationError: If job submission fails
428 |         """
429 |         logger.info(f"Submitting embed_source job for source {self.id}")
430 | 
431 |         try:
432 |             if not self.full_text:
433 |                 raise ValueError(f"Source {self.id} has no text to vectorize")
434 | 
435 |             # Submit the embed_source command
436 |             command_id = submit_command(
437 |                 "open_notebook",
438 |                 "embed_source",
439 |                 {"source_id": str(self.id)},
440 |             )
441 | 
442 |             command_id_str = str(command_id)
443 |             logger.info(
444 |                 f"Embed source job submitted for source {self.id}: "
445 |                 f"command_id={command_id_str}"
446 |             )
447 | 
448 |             return command_id_str
449 | 
450 |         except Exception as e:
451 |             logger.error(
452 |                 f"Failed to submit embed_source job for source {self.id}: {e}"
453 |             )
454 |             logger.exception(e)
455 |             raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
456 | 
457 |     async def add_insight(self, insight_type: str, content: str) -> Optional[str]:
458 |         """
459 |         Submit insight creation as an async command (fire-and-forget).
460 | 
461 |         Submits a create_insight command that handles database operations with
462 |         automatic retry logic for transaction conflicts. The command also submits
463 |         an embed_insight command for async embedding.
464 | 
465 |         This method returns immediately after submitting the command - it does NOT
466 |         wait for the insight to be created. Use this for batch operations where
467 |         throughput is more important than immediate confirmation.
468 | 
469 |         Args:
470 |             insight_type: Type/category of the insight
471 |             content: The insight content text
472 | 
473 |         Returns:
474 |             command_id for optional tracking, or None if submission failed
475 | 
476 |         Raises:
477 |             InvalidInputError: If insight_type or content is empty
478 |         """
479 |         if not insight_type or not content:
480 |             raise InvalidInputError("Insight type and content must be provided")
481 | 
482 |         try:
483 |             # Submit create_insight command (fire-and-forget)
484 |             # Command handles retries internally for transaction conflicts
485 |             command_id = submit_command(
486 |                 "open_notebook",
487 |                 "create_insight",
488 |                 {
489 |                     "source_id": str(self.id),
490 |                     "insight_type": insight_type,
491 |                     "content": content,
492 |                 },
493 |             )
494 |             logger.info(
495 |                 f"Submitted create_insight command {command_id} for source {self.id} "
496 |                 f"(type={insight_type})"
497 |             )
498 |             return str(command_id)
499 | 
500 |         except Exception as e:
501 |             logger.error(f"Error submitting create_insight for source {self.id}: {e}")
502 |             return None
503 | 
504 |     def _prepare_save_data(self) -> dict:
505 |         """Override to ensure command field is always RecordID format for database"""
506 |         data = super()._prepare_save_data()
507 | 
508 |         # Ensure command field is RecordID format if not None
509 |         if data.get("command") is not None:
510 |             data["command"] = ensure_record_id(data["command"])
511 | 
512 |         return data
513 | 
514 |     async def delete(self) -> bool:
515 |         """Delete source and clean up associated file, embeddings, and insights."""
516 |         # Clean up uploaded file if it exists
517 |         if self.asset and self.asset.file_path:
518 |             file_path = Path(self.asset.file_path)
519 |             if file_path.exists():
520 |                 try:
521 |                     os.unlink(file_path)
522 |                     logger.info(f"Deleted file for source {self.id}: {file_path}")
523 |                 except Exception as e:
524 |                     logger.warning(
525 |                         f"Failed to delete file {file_path} for source {self.id}: {e}. "
526 |                         "Continuing with database deletion."
527 |                     )
528 |             else:
529 |                 logger.debug(
530 |                     f"File {file_path} not found for source {self.id}, skipping cleanup"
531 |                 )
532 | 
533 |         # Delete associated embeddings and insights to prevent orphaned records
534 |         try:
535 |             source_id = ensure_record_id(self.id)
536 |             await repo_query(
537 |                 "DELETE source_embedding WHERE source = $source_id",
538 |                 {"source_id": source_id},
539 |             )
540 |             await repo_query(
541 |                 "DELETE source_insight WHERE source = $source_id",
542 |                 {"source_id": source_id},
543 |             )
544 |             logger.debug(f"Deleted embeddings and insights for source {self.id}")
545 |         except Exception as e:
546 |             logger.warning(
547 |                 f"Failed to delete embeddings/insights for source {self.id}: {e}. "
548 |                 "Continuing with source deletion."
549 |             )
550 | 
551 |         # Call parent delete to remove database record
552 |         return await super().delete()
553 |

555 | class Note(ObjectModel):
556 |     table_name: ClassVar[str] = "note"
557 |     title: Optional[str] = None
558 |     note_type: Optional[Literal["human", "ai"]] = None
559 |     content: Optional[str] = None

561 |     @field_validator("content")
562 |     @classmethod
563 |     def content_must_not_be_empty(cls, v):
564 |         if v is not None and not v.strip():
565 |             raise InvalidInputError("Note content cannot be empty")
566 |         return v
567 | 
568 |     async def save(self) -> Optional[str]:
569 |         """
570 |         Save the note and submit embedding command.
571 | 
572 |         Overrides ObjectModel.save() to submit an async embed_note command
573 |         after saving, instead of inline embedding.
574 | 
575 |         Returns:
576 |             Optional[str]: The command_id if embedding was submitted, None otherwise
577 |         """
578 |         # Call parent save (without embedding)
579 |         await super().save()
580 | 
581 |         # Submit embedding command (fire-and-forget) if note has content
582 |         if self.id and self.content and self.content.strip():
583 |             command_id = submit_command(
584 |                 "open_notebook",
585 |                 "embed_note",
586 |                 {"note_id": str(self.id)},
587 |             )
588 |             logger.debug(f"Submitted embed_note command {command_id} for {self.id}")
589 |             return command_id
590 | 
591 |         return None
592 | 
593 |     async def add_to_notebook(self, notebook_id: str) -> Any:
594 |         if not notebook_id:
595 |             raise InvalidInputError("Notebook ID must be provided")
596 |         return await self.relate("artifact", notebook_id)

598 |     def get_context(
599 |         self, context_size: Literal["short", "long"] = "short"
600 |     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
601 |         if context_size == "long":
602 |             return dict(id=self.id, title=self.title, content=self.content)
603 |         else:
604 |             return dict(

628 | async def text_search(
629 |     keyword: str, results: int, source: bool = True, note: bool = True
630 | ):
631 |     if not keyword:
632 |         raise InvalidInputError("Search keyword cannot be empty")
633 |     try:
634 |         search_results = await repo_query(
635 |             """
636 |             select *
637 |             from fn::text_search($keyword, $results, $source, $note)
638 |             """,
639 |             {"keyword": keyword, "results": results, "source": source, "note": note},
640 |         )
641 |         return search_results
642 |     except Exception as e:
643 |         logger.error(f"Error performing text search: {str(e)}")
644 |         logger.exception(e)
645 |         raise DatabaseOperationError(e)
646 | 
647 | 
648 | async def vector_search(
649 |     keyword: str,
650 |     results: int,
651 |     source: bool = True,
652 |     note: bool = True,
653 |     minimum_score=0.2,
654 | ):
655 |     if not keyword:
656 |         raise InvalidInputError("Search keyword cannot be empty")
657 |     try:
658 |         from open_notebook.utils.embedding import generate_embedding
659 | 
660 |         # Use unified embedding function (handles chunking if query is very long)
661 |         embed = await generate_embedding(keyword)
662 |         search_results = await repo_query(
663 |             """
664 |             SELECT * FROM fn::vector_search($embed, $results, $source, $note, $minimum_score);
665 |             """,
666 |             {
667 |                 "embed": embed,
668 |                 "results": results,
669 |                 "source": source,
670 |                 "note": note,
671 |                 "minimum_score": minimum_score,
672 |             },
673 |         )
674 |         return search_results
675 |     except Exception as e:
676 |         logger.error(f"Error performing vector search: {str(e)}")
677 |         logger.exception(e)
678 |         raise DatabaseOperationError(e)

/docs/5-CONFIGURATION/reverse-proxy.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # Reverse Proxy Configuration
  2 | 
  3 | Deploy Open Notebook behind nginx, Caddy, Traefik, or other reverse proxies with custom domains and HTTPS.
  4 | 
  5 | ---
  6 | 
  7 | ## Simplified Setup (v1.1+)
  8 | 
  9 | Starting with v1.1, Open Notebook uses Next.js rewrites to simplify configuration. **You only need to proxy to one port** - Next.js handles internal API routing automatically.
 10 | 
 11 | ### How It Works
 12 | 
 13 | ```
 14 | Browser → Reverse Proxy → Port 8502 (Next.js)
 15 |                              ↓ (internal proxy)
 16 |                           Port 5055 (FastAPI)
 17 | ```
 18 | 
 19 | Next.js automatically forwards `/api/*` requests to the FastAPI backend, so your reverse proxy only needs one port!
 20 | 
 21 | ---
 22 | 
 23 | ## Quick Configuration Examples
 24 | 
 25 | ### Nginx (Recommended)
 26 | 
 27 | ```nginx
 28 | server {
 29 |     listen 443 ssl http2;
 30 |     server_name notebook.example.com;
 31 | 
 32 |     ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem;
 33 |     ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/privkey.pem;
 34 | 
 35 |     # Allow file uploads up to 100MB
 36 |     client_max_body_size 100M;
 37 | 
 38 |     # Single location block - that's it!
 39 |     location / {
 40 |         proxy_pass http://open-notebook:8502;
 41 |         proxy_http_version 1.1;
 42 |         proxy_set_header Host $host;
 43 |         proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
 44 |         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
 45 |         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
 46 |         proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
 47 |         proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
 48 |         proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
 49 |     }
 50 | }
 51 | 
 52 | # HTTP to HTTPS redirect
 53 | server {
 54 |     listen 80;
 55 |     server_name notebook.example.com;
 56 |     return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
 57 | }
 58 | ```
 59 | 
 60 | ### Caddy
 61 | 
 62 | ```caddy
 63 | notebook.example.com {
 64 |     reverse_proxy open-notebook:8502 {
 65 |         transport http {
 66 |             read_timeout 600s
 67 |             write_timeout 600s
 68 |         }
 69 |     }
 70 | }
 71 | ```
 72 | 
 73 | Caddy handles HTTPS automatically. The timeout settings ensure long-running operations (transformations, podcast generation) don't fail.
 74 | 
 75 | ### Traefik
 76 | 
 77 | ```yaml
 78 | services:
 79 |   open-notebook:
 80 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
 81 |     pull_policy: always
 82 |     environment:
 83 |       - API_URL=https://notebook.example.com
 84 |     labels:
 85 |       - "traefik.enable=true"
 86 |       - "traefik.http.routers.notebook.rule=Host(`notebook.example.com`)"
 87 |       - "traefik.http.routers.notebook.entrypoints=websecure"
 88 |       - "traefik.http.routers.notebook.tls.certresolver=myresolver"
 89 |       - "traefik.http.services.notebook.loadbalancer.server.port=8502"
 90 |       # Timeout for long-running operations (transformations, podcasts)
 91 |       - "traefik.http.services.notebook.loadbalancer.responseforwarding.flushinterval=100ms"
 92 |     networks:
 93 |       - traefik-network
 94 | ```
 95 | 
 96 | **Note**: For Traefik v2+, you may also need to configure `serversTransport` timeouts in your static configuration:
 97 | 
 98 | ```yaml
 99 | # traefik.yml (static configuration)
100 | serversTransport:
101 |   forwardingTimeouts:
102 |     dialTimeout: 30s
103 |     responseHeaderTimeout: 600s
104 |     idleConnTimeout: 90s
105 | ```
106 | 
107 | ### Coolify
108 | 
109 | 1. Create new service with `lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single`
110 | 2. Set port to **8502**
111 | 3. Add environment: `API_URL=https://your-domain.com`
112 | 4. Enable HTTPS in Coolify
113 | 5. Done!
114 | 
115 | ---
116 | 
117 | ## Environment Variables
118 | 
119 | ```bash
120 | # Required for reverse proxy setups
121 | API_URL=https://your-domain.com
122 | 
123 | # Optional: For multi-container deployments
124 | # INTERNAL_API_URL=http://api-service:5055
125 | ```
126 | 
127 | **Important**: Set `API_URL` to your public URL (with https://).
128 | 
129 | **Note on HOSTNAME**: The Docker images set `HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0` by default, which ensures Next.js binds to all interfaces and is accessible from reverse proxies. You typically don't need to set this manually.
130 | 
131 | ---
132 | 
133 | ## Understanding API_URL
134 | 
135 | The frontend uses a three-tier priority system to determine the API URL:
136 | 
137 | 1. **Runtime Configuration** (Highest Priority): `API_URL` environment variable set at container runtime
138 | 2. **Build-time Configuration**: `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` baked into the Docker image
139 | 3. **Auto-detection** (Fallback): Infers from the incoming HTTP request headers
140 | 
141 | ### Auto-Detection Details
142 | 
143 | When `API_URL` is not set, the Next.js frontend:
144 | - Analyzes the incoming HTTP request
145 | - Extracts the hostname from the `host` header
146 | - Respects the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header (for HTTPS behind reverse proxies)
147 | - Constructs the API URL as `{protocol}://{hostname}:5055`
148 | - Example: Request to `http://10.20.30.20:8502` → API URL becomes `http://10.20.30.20:5055`
149 | 
150 | **Why set API_URL explicitly?**
151 | - **Reliability**: Auto-detection can fail with complex proxy setups
152 | - **HTTPS**: Ensures frontend uses `https://` when behind SSL-terminating proxy
153 | - **Custom domains**: Works correctly with domain names instead of IP addresses
154 | - **Port mapping**: Avoids exposing port 5055 in the URL when using reverse proxy
155 | 
156 | **Important**: Don't include `/api` at the end - the system adds this automatically!
157 | 
158 | ---
159 | 
160 | ## Complete Docker Compose Example
161 | 
162 | ```yaml
163 | services:
164 |   open-notebook:
165 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
166 |     pull_policy: always
167 |     container_name: open-notebook
168 |     environment:
169 |       - API_URL=https://notebook.example.com
170 |       - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
171 |       - OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD=${OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD}
172 |     volumes:
173 |       - ./notebook_data:/app/data
174 |       - ./surreal_data:/mydata
175 |     # Only expose to localhost (nginx handles public access)
176 |     ports:
177 |       - "127.0.0.1:8502:8502"
178 |     restart: unless-stopped
179 | 
180 |   nginx:
181 |     image: nginx:alpine
182 |     container_name: nginx-proxy
183 |     ports:
184 |       - "80:80"
185 |       - "443:443"
186 |     volumes:
187 |       - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
188 |       - ./ssl:/etc/nginx/ssl:ro
189 |     depends_on:
190 |       - open-notebook
191 |     restart: unless-stopped
192 | ```
193 | 
194 | ---
195 | 
196 | ## Full Nginx Configuration
197 | 
198 | ```nginx
199 | events {
200 |     worker_connections 1024;
201 | }
202 | 
203 | http {
204 |     upstream notebook {
205 |         server open-notebook:8502;
206 |     }
207 | 
208 |     # HTTP redirect
209 |     server {
210 |         listen 80;
211 |         server_name notebook.example.com;
212 |         return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
213 |     }
214 | 
215 |     # HTTPS server
216 |     server {
217 |         listen 443 ssl http2;
218 |         server_name notebook.example.com;
219 | 
220 |         ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem;
221 |         ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/privkey.pem;
222 |         ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
223 |         ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
224 | 
225 |         # Allow file uploads up to 100MB
226 |         client_max_body_size 100M;
227 | 
228 |         # Security headers
229 |         add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
230 |         add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
231 |         add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block";
232 |         add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains";
233 | 
234 |         # Proxy settings
235 |         location / {
236 |             proxy_pass http://notebook;
237 |             proxy_http_version 1.1;
238 |             proxy_set_header Host $host;
239 |             proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
240 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
241 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
242 |             proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
243 |             proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
244 |             proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
245 | 
246 |             # Timeouts for long-running operations (transformations, podcasts, etc.)
247 |             # 600s matches the frontend timeout for slow LLM operations
248 |             proxy_read_timeout 600s;
249 |             proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
250 |             proxy_send_timeout 600s;
251 |         }
252 |     }
253 | }
254 | ```
255 |

257 | 
258 | ## Direct API Access (Optional)
259 | 
260 | If external scripts or integrations need direct API access, route `/api/*` directly:
261 | 
262 | ```nginx
263 | # Direct API access (for external integrations)
264 | location /api/ {
265 |     proxy_pass http://open-notebook:5055/api/;
266 |     proxy_http_version 1.1;
267 |     proxy_set_header Host $host;
268 |     proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
269 |     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
270 |     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
271 | }
272 | 
273 | # Frontend (handles all other traffic)
274 | location / {
275 |     proxy_pass http://open-notebook:8502;
276 |     # ... same headers as above
277 | }
278 | ```
279 | 
280 | **Note**: This is only needed for external API integrations. Browser traffic works fine with single-port setup.

284 | ## Advanced Scenarios
285 | 
286 | ### Remote Server Access (LAN/VPS)
287 | 
288 | Accessing Open Notebook from a different machine on your network:
289 | 
290 | **Step 1: Get your server IP**
291 | ```bash
292 | # On the server running Open Notebook:
293 | hostname -I
294 | # or
295 | ifconfig | grep "inet "
296 | # Note the IP (e.g., 192.168.1.100)
297 | ```
298 | 
299 | **Step 2: Configure API_URL**
300 | ```bash
301 | # In docker-compose.yml or .env:
302 | API_URL=http://192.168.1.100:5055
303 | ```
304 | 
305 | **Step 3: Expose ports**
306 | ```yaml
307 | services:
308 |   open-notebook:
309 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook:v1-latest-single
310 |     pull_policy: always
311 |     environment:
312 |       - API_URL=http://192.168.1.100:5055
313 |     ports:
314 |       - "8502:8502"
315 |       - "5055:5055"
316 | ```
317 | 
318 | **Step 4: Access from client machine**
319 | ```bash
320 | # In browser on other machine:
321 | http://192.168.1.100:8502
322 | ```
323 | 
324 | **Troubleshooting**:
325 | - Check firewall: `sudo ufw allow 8502 && sudo ufw allow 5055`
326 | - Verify connectivity: `ping 192.168.1.100` from client machine
327 | - Test port: `telnet 192.168.1.100 8502` from client machine
328 |

393 | ### Multi-Container Deployment (Advanced)
394 | 
395 | For complex deployments with separate frontend and API containers:
396 | 
397 | **docker-compose.yml:**
398 | ```yaml
399 | services:
400 |   frontend:
401 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook_frontend:v1-latest
402 |     pull_policy: always
403 |     environment:
404 |       - API_URL=https://notebook.example.com
405 |     ports:
406 |       - "8502:8502"
407 | 
408 |   api:
409 |     image: lfnovo/open_notebook_api:v1-latest
410 |     pull_policy: always
411 |     environment:
412 |       - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
413 |     ports:
414 |       - "5055:5055"
415 |     depends_on:
416 |       - surrealdb
417 | 
418 |   surrealdb:
419 |     image: surrealdb/surrealdb:latest
420 |     command: start --log trace --user root --pass root file:/mydata/database.db
421 |     ports:
422 |       - "8000:8000"
423 |     volumes:
424 |       - ./surreal_data:/mydata
425 | ```
426 | 
427 | **nginx.conf:**
428 | ```nginx
429 | http {
430 |     upstream frontend {
431 |         server frontend:8502;
432 |     }
433 | 
434 |     upstream api {
435 |         server api:5055;
436 |     }
437 | 
438 |     server {
439 |         listen 443 ssl http2;
440 |         server_name notebook.example.com;
441 | 
442 |         # API routes
443 |         location /api/ {
444 |             proxy_pass http://api/api/;
445 |             proxy_http_version 1.1;
446 |             proxy_set_header Host $host;
447 |             proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
448 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
449 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
450 |         }
451 | 
452 |         # Frontend (catch-all)
453 |         location / {
454 |             proxy_pass http://frontend;
455 |             proxy_http_version 1.1;
456 |             proxy_set_header Host $host;
457 |             proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
458 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
459 |             proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
460 |             proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
461 |             proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
462 |             proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
463 |         }
464 |     }
465 | }
466 | ```
467 | 
468 | **Note**: Most users should use the single-container approach (`v1-latest-single`). Multi-container is only needed for custom scaling or isolation requirements.

479 |

481 | sudo certbot --nginx -d notebook.example.com

483 | # Auto-renewal (usually configured automatically)

500 | ---
501 | 
502 | ## Troubleshooting
503 | 
504 | ### "Unable to connect to server"
505 | 
506 | 1. **Check API_URL is set**:
507 |    ```bash
508 |    docker exec open-notebook env | grep API_URL
509 |    ```
510 | 
511 | 2. **Verify reverse proxy reaches container**:
512 |    ```bash
513 |    curl -I http://localhost:8502
514 |    ```
515 | 
516 | 3. **Check browser console** (F12):
517 |    - Look for connection errors
518 |    - Check what URL it's trying to reach
519 | 
520 | ### Mixed Content Errors
521 | 
522 | Frontend using HTTPS but trying to reach HTTP API:
523 | 
524 | ```bash
525 | # Ensure API_URL uses https://
526 | API_URL=https://notebook.example.com  # Not http://
527 | ```
528 | 
529 | ### WebSocket Issues
530 | 
531 | Ensure your proxy supports WebSocket upgrades:
532 | 
533 | ```nginx
534 | proxy_http_version 1.1;
535 | proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
536 | proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
537 | ```
538 | 
539 | ### 502 Bad Gateway
540 | 
541 | 1. Check container is running: `docker ps`
542 | 2. Check container logs: `docker logs open-notebook`
543 | 3. Verify nginx can reach container (same network)
544 | 
545 | ### Timeout Errors
546 | 
547 | **Symptoms:**
548 | - `socket hang up` or `ECONNRESET` errors
549 | - `Timeout after 30000ms` errors
550 | - Operations fail after exactly 30 seconds
551 | 
552 | **Cause:** Your reverse proxy has a default timeout (often 30s) that's shorter than Open Notebook's operations.
553 | 
554 | **Solutions by proxy:**
555 | 
556 | **Nginx:**
557 | ```nginx
558 | proxy_read_timeout 600s;
559 | proxy_send_timeout 600s;
560 | ```
561 | 
562 | **Caddy:**
563 | ```caddy
564 | reverse_proxy open-notebook:8502 {
565 |     transport http {
566 |         read_timeout 600s
567 |         write_timeout 600s
568 |     }
569 | }
570 | ```
571 | 
572 | **Traefik (static config):**
573 | ```yaml
574 | serversTransport:
575 |   forwardingTimeouts:
576 |     responseHeaderTimeout: 600s
577 | ```
578 | 
579 | **Application-level timeouts:**
580 | 
581 | If you still experience timeouts after configuring your proxy, you can also adjust the application timeouts:
582 | 
583 | ```bash
584 | # In .env file:
585 | API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT=600      # API client timeout (default: 300s)
586 | ESPERANTO_LLM_TIMEOUT=180   # LLM inference timeout (default: 60s)
587 | ```
588 | 
589 | See [Advanced Configuration](advanced.md) for more timeout options.
590 | 
591 | ---
592 | 
593 | ### How to Debug Configuration Issues
594 | 
595 | **Step 1: Check browser console** (F12 → Console tab)
596 | ```
597 | Look for messages starting with 🔧 [Config]
598 | These show the configuration detection process
599 | You'll see which API URL is being used
600 | ```
601 | 
602 | **Example good output:**
603 | ```
604 | ✅ [Config] Runtime API URL from server: https://your-domain.com
605 | ```
606 | 
607 | **Example bad output:**
608 | ```
609 | ❌ [Config] Failed to fetch runtime config
610 | ⚠️  [Config] Using auto-detected URL: http://localhost:5055
611 | ```
612 | 
613 | **Step 2: Test API directly**
614 | ```bash
615 | # Should return JSON config
616 | curl https://your-domain.com/api/config
617 | 
618 | # Expected output:
619 | {"openai_api_key_set":true,"anthropic_api_key_set":false,...}
620 | ```
621 | 
622 | **Step 3: Check Docker logs**
623 | ```bash
624 | docker logs open-notebook
625 | 
626 | # Look for:
627 | # - Frontend startup: "▲ Next.js ready on http://0.0.0.0:8502"
628 | # - API startup: "INFO:     Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:5055"
629 | # - Connection errors or CORS issues
630 | ```
631 | 
632 | **Step 4: Verify environment variable**
633 | ```bash
634 | docker exec open-notebook env | grep API_URL
635 | 
636 | # Should show:
637 | # API_URL=https://your-domain.com
638 | ```
639 | 
640 | ---
641 | 
642 | ### Frontend Adds `:5055` to URL (Versions ≤ 1.0.10)
643 | 
644 | **Symptoms** (only in older versions):
645 | - You set `API_URL=https://your-domain.com`
646 | - Browser console shows: "Attempted URL: https://your-domain.com:5055/api/config"
647 | - CORS errors with "Status code: (null)"
648 | 
649 | **Root Cause:**
650 | In versions ≤ 1.0.10, the frontend's config endpoint was at `/api/runtime-config`, which got intercepted by reverse proxies routing all `/api/*` requests to the backend. This prevented the frontend from reading the `API_URL` environment variable.
651 | 
652 | **Solution:**
653 | Upgrade to version 1.0.11 or later. The config endpoint has been moved to `/config` which avoids the `/api/*` routing conflict.
654 | 
655 | **Verification:**
656 | Check browser console (F12) - should see: `✅ [Config] Runtime API URL from server: https://your-domain.com`
657 | 
658 | **If you can't upgrade**, explicitly configure the `/config` route:
659 | ```nginx
660 | # Only needed for versions ≤ 1.0.10
661 | location = /config {
662 |     proxy_pass http://open-notebook:8502;
663 |     proxy_http_version 1.1;
664 |     proxy_set_header Host $host;
665 |     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
666 | }
667 | ```
668 | 
669 | ---
670 | 
671 | ### File Upload Errors (413 Payload Too Large)
672 | 
673 | **Symptoms:**
674 | ```
675 | CORS header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' missing. Status code: 413.
676 | Error creating source. Please try again.
677 | ```
678 | 
679 | **Root Cause:**
680 | When uploading files, your reverse proxy may reject the request due to body size limits *before* it reaches the application. Since the error happens at the proxy level, CORS headers are not included in the response.
681 | 
682 | **Version Requirement:**
683 | - **Open Notebook v1.3.2+** is required for file uploads >10MB
684 | - Uses Next.js 16+ which supports the `proxyClientMaxBodySize` configuration option
685 | - Check your version: Settings → About (bottom of settings page)
686 | 
687 | **Solutions:**
688 | 
689 | 1. **Nginx - Increase body size limit**:
690 |    ```nginx
691 |    server {
692 |        # Allow larger file uploads (default is 1MB)
693 |        client_max_body_size 100M;
694 | 
695 |        # Add CORS headers to error responses
696 |        error_page 413 = @cors_error_413;
697 | 
698 |        location @cors_error_413 {
699 |            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
700 |            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS' always;
701 |            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' '*' always;
702 |            return 413 '{"detail": "File too large. Maximum size is 100MB."}';
703 |        }
704 | 
705 |        location / {
706 |            # ... your existing proxy configuration
707 |        }
708 |    }
709 |    ```
710 | 
711 | 2. **Traefik - Increase buffer size**:
712 |    ```yaml
713 |    # In your traefik configuration
714 |    http:
715 |      middlewares:
716 |        large-body:
717 |          buffering:
718 |            maxRequestBodyBytes: 104857600  # 100MB
719 |    ```
720 | 
721 |    Apply middleware to your router:
722 |    ```yaml
723 |    labels:
724 |      - "traefik.http.routers.notebook.middlewares=large-body"
725 |    ```
726 | 
727 | 3. **Kubernetes Ingress (nginx-ingress)**:
728 |    ```yaml
729 |    apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
730 |    kind: Ingress
731 |    metadata:
732 |      name: open-notebook
733 |      annotations:
734 |        nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "100m"
735 |        # Add CORS headers for error responses
736 |        nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
737 |          more_set_headers "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *";
738 |    ```
739 | 
740 | 4. **Caddy**:
741 |    ```caddy
742 |    notebook.example.com {
743 |        request_body {
744 |            max_size 100MB
745 |        }
746 |        reverse_proxy open-notebook:8502 {
747 |            transport http {
748 |                read_timeout 600s
749 |                write_timeout 600s
750 |            }
751 |        }
752 |    }
753 |    ```
754 | 
755 | **Note:** Open Notebook's API includes CORS headers in error responses, but this only works for errors that reach the application. Proxy-level errors (like 413 from nginx) need to be configured at the proxy level.
756 | 
757 | ---
758 | 
759 | ### CORS Errors
760 | 
761 | **Symptoms:**
762 | ```
763 | Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is missing
764 | Cross-Origin Request Blocked
765 | Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check
766 | ```
767 | 
768 | **Possible Causes:**
769 | 
770 | 1. **Missing proxy headers**:
771 |    ```nginx
772 |    # Make sure these are set:
773 |    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
774 |    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
775 |    proxy_set_header Host $host;
776 |    ```
777 | 
778 | 2. **API_URL protocol mismatch**:
779 |    ```bash
780 |    # Frontend is HTTPS, but API_URL is HTTP:
781 |    API_URL=http://notebook.example.com  # ❌ Wrong
782 |    API_URL=https://notebook.example.com # ✅ Correct
783 |    ```
784 | 
785 | 3. **Reverse proxy not forwarding `/api/*` correctly**:
786 |    ```nginx
787 |    # Make sure this works:
788 |    location /api/ {
789 |        proxy_pass http://open-notebook:5055/api/;  # Note the trailing slash!
790 |    }
791 |    ```
792 | 
793 | ---
794 | 
795 | ### Missing Authorization Header
796 | 
797 | **Symptoms:**
798 | ```json
799 | {"detail": "Missing authorization header"}
800 | ```
801 | 
802 | This happens when:
803 | - You have set `OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD` for authentication
804 | - You're trying to access `/api/config` directly without logging in first
805 | 
806 | **Solution:**
807 | This is **expected behavior**! The frontend handles authentication automatically. Just:
808 | 1. Access the frontend URL (not `/api/` directly)
809 | 2. Log in through the UI
810 | 3. The frontend will handle authorization headers for all API calls
811 | 
812 | **For API integrations:** Include the password in the Authorization header:
813 | ```bash
814 | curl -H "Authorization: Bearer your-password-here" \
815 |   https://your-domain.com/api/config
816 | ```
817 | 
818 | ---
819 | 
820 | ### SSL/TLS Certificate Errors
821 | 
822 | **Symptoms:**
823 | - Browser shows "Your connection is not private"
824 | - Certificate warnings
825 | - Mixed content errors
826 | 
827 | **Solutions:**
828 | 
829 | 1. **Use Let's Encrypt** (recommended):
830 |    ```bash
831 |    sudo certbot --nginx -d notebook.example.com
832 |    ```
833 | 
834 | 2. **Check certificate paths** in nginx:
835 |    ```nginx
836 |    ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem;      # Full chain
837 |    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/privkey.pem;    # Private key
838 |    ```
839 | 
840 | 3. **Verify certificate is valid**:
841 |    ```bash
842 |    openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem -text -noout
843 |    ```
844 | 
845 | 4. **For development**, use self-signed (not for production):
846 |    ```bash
847 |    openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
848 |      -keyout ssl/privkey.pem -out ssl/fullchain.pem \
849 |      -subj "/CN=localhost"
850 |    ```
851 | 
852 | ---
853 | 
854 | ## Best Practices
855 | 
856 | 1. **Always use HTTPS** in production
857 | 2. **Set API_URL explicitly** when using reverse proxies to avoid auto-detection issues
858 | 3. **Bind to localhost** (`127.0.0.1:8502`) and let proxy handle public access for security
859 | 4. **Enable security headers** (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection)
860 | 5. **Set up certificate renewal** for Let's Encrypt (usually automatic with certbot)
861 | 6. **Keep ports 5055 and 8502 accessible** from your reverse proxy container (use Docker networks)
862 | 7. **Use environment files** (`.env` or `docker.env`) to manage configuration securely
863 | 8. **Test your configuration** before going live:
864 |    - Check browser console for config messages
865 |    - Test API: `curl https://your-domain.com/api/config`
866 |    - Verify authentication works
867 |    - Check long-running operations (podcast generation)
868 | 9. **Monitor logs** regularly: `docker logs open-notebook`
869 | 10. **Don't include `/api` in API_URL** - the system adds this automatically
870 | 
871 | ---
872 | 
873 | ## Legacy Configurations (Pre-v1.1)
874 | 
875 | If you're running Open Notebook **version 1.0.x or earlier**, you may need to use the legacy two-port configuration where you explicitly route `/api/*` to port 5055.
876 | 
877 | **Check your version:**
878 | ```bash
879 | docker exec open-notebook cat /app/package.json | grep version
880 | ```
881 | 
882 | **If version < 1.1.0**, you may need:
883 | - Explicit `/api/*` routing to port 5055 in reverse proxy
884 | - Explicit `/config` endpoint routing for versions ≤ 1.0.10
885 | - See the "Frontend Adds `:5055` to URL" troubleshooting section above
886 | 
887 | **Recommendation:** Upgrade to v1.1+ for simplified configuration and better performance.
888 |

125 |         "wait_strategy": "exponential_jitter",

132 | async def embed_note_command(input_data: EmbedNoteInput) -> EmbedNoteOutput:
133 |     """
134 |     Generate and store embedding for a single note.
135 | 
136 |     Uses the unified embedding pipeline with automatic chunking and mean pooling
137 |     for notes that exceed the chunk size limit.
138 | 
139 |     Flow:
140 |     1. Load Note by ID
141 |     2. Generate embedding via generate_embedding() (auto-chunks + mean pools if needed)
142 |     3. UPSERT note embedding in database
143 | 
144 |     Retry Strategy:
145 |     - Retries up to 5 times for transient failures (network, timeout, etc.)
146 |     - Uses exponential-jitter backoff (1-60s)
147 |     - Does NOT retry permanent failures (ValueError for validation errors)
148 |     """
149 |     start_time = time.time()
150 | 
151 |     try:
152 |         logger.info(f"Starting embedding for note: {input_data.note_id}")
153 | 
154 |         # 1. Load note
155 |         note = await Note.get(input_data.note_id)
156 |         if not note:
157 |             raise ValueError(f"Note '{input_data.note_id}' not found")
158 | 
159 |         if not note.content or not note.content.strip():
160 |             raise ValueError(f"Note '{input_data.note_id}' has no content to embed")
161 | 
162 |         # 2. Generate embedding (auto-chunks + mean pools if needed)
163 |         # Notes are typically markdown content
164 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
165 |         embedding = await generate_embedding(
166 |             note.content, content_type=ContentType.MARKDOWN, command_id=cmd_id
167 |         )
168 | 
169 |         # 3. UPSERT embedding into note record
170 |         await repo_query(
171 |             "UPDATE $note_id SET embedding = $embedding",
172 |             {
173 |                 "note_id": ensure_record_id(input_data.note_id),
174 |                 "embedding": embedding,
175 |             },
176 |         )
177 | 
178 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
179 |         logger.info(
180 |             f"Successfully embedded note {input_data.note_id} in {processing_time:.2f}s"
181 |         )
182 | 
183 |         return EmbedNoteOutput(
184 |             success=True,
185 |             note_id=input_data.note_id,
186 |             processing_time=processing_time,
187 |         )
188 | 
189 |     except ValueError as e:
190 |         # Permanent failure - don't retry
191 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
192 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
193 |         logger.error(
194 |             f"Failed to embed note {input_data.note_id} (command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
195 |         )
196 |         return EmbedNoteOutput(
197 |             success=False,
198 |             note_id=input_data.note_id,
199 |             processing_time=processing_time,
200 |             error_message=str(e),
201 |         )
202 |     except Exception as e:
203 |         # Transient failure - will be retried (surreal-commands logs final failure)
204 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
205 |         logger.debug(
206 |             f"Transient error embedding note {input_data.note_id} "
207 |             f"(command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
208 |         )
209 |         raise

318 | async def embed_source_command(input_data: EmbedSourceInput) -> EmbedSourceOutput:
319 |     """
320 |     Generate and store embeddings for a source document.
321 | 
322 |     Creates multiple chunk embeddings stored in the source_embedding table.
323 |     Uses content-type aware chunking based on file extension or content heuristics.
324 | 
325 |     Flow:
326 |     1. Load Source by ID
327 |     2. DELETE existing source_embedding records for this source
328 |     3. Detect content type from file path or content
329 |     4. Chunk text using appropriate splitter
330 |     5. Generate embeddings for all chunks in a single API call
331 |     6. Bulk INSERT source_embedding records
332 | 
333 |     Retry Strategy:
334 |     - Retries up to 5 times for transient failures (network, timeout, etc.)
335 |     - Uses exponential-jitter backoff (1-60s)
336 |     - Does NOT retry permanent failures (ValueError for validation errors)
337 |     """
338 |     start_time = time.time()
339 | 
340 |     try:
341 |         logger.info(f"Starting embedding for source: {input_data.source_id}")
342 | 
343 |         # 1. Load source
344 |         source = await Source.get(input_data.source_id)
345 |         if not source:
346 |             raise ValueError(f"Source '{input_data.source_id}' not found")
347 | 
348 |         if not source.full_text or not source.full_text.strip():
349 |             raise ValueError(f"Source '{input_data.source_id}' has no text to embed")
350 | 
351 |         # 2. DELETE existing embeddings (idempotency)
352 |         logger.debug(f"Deleting existing embeddings for source {input_data.source_id}")
353 |         await repo_query(
354 |             "DELETE source_embedding WHERE source = $source_id",
355 |             {"source_id": ensure_record_id(input_data.source_id)},
356 |         )
357 | 
358 |         # 3. Detect content type from file path if available
359 |         file_path = source.asset.file_path if source.asset else None
360 |         content_type = detect_content_type(source.full_text, file_path)
361 |         logger.debug(f"Detected content type: {content_type.value}")
362 | 
363 |         # 4. Chunk text using appropriate splitter
364 |         chunks = chunk_text(source.full_text, content_type=content_type)
365 |         total_chunks = len(chunks)
366 | 
367 |         # Log chunk statistics for debugging
368 |         chunk_sizes = [len(c) for c in chunks]
369 |         logger.info(
370 |             f"Created {total_chunks} chunks for source {input_data.source_id} "
371 |             f"(sizes: min={min(chunk_sizes) if chunk_sizes else 0}, "
372 |             f"max={max(chunk_sizes) if chunk_sizes else 0}, "
373 |             f"avg={sum(chunk_sizes)//len(chunk_sizes) if chunk_sizes else 0} chars)"
374 |         )
375 | 
376 |         if total_chunks == 0:
377 |             raise ValueError("No chunks created after splitting text")
378 | 
379 |         # 5. Generate embeddings for all chunks in single API call
380 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
381 |         logger.debug(f"Generating embeddings for {total_chunks} chunks")
382 |         embeddings = await generate_embeddings(chunks, command_id=cmd_id)
383 | 
384 |         # Verify we got embeddings for all chunks
385 |         if len(embeddings) != len(chunks):
386 |             raise ValueError(
387 |                 f"Embedding count mismatch: got {len(embeddings)} embeddings "
388 |                 f"for {len(chunks)} chunks"
389 |             )
390 | 
391 |         # 6. Bulk INSERT source_embedding records
392 |         records = [
393 |             {
394 |                 "source": ensure_record_id(input_data.source_id),
395 |                 "order": idx,
396 |                 "content": chunk,
397 |                 "embedding": embedding,
398 |             }
399 |             for idx, (chunk, embedding) in enumerate(zip(chunks, embeddings))
400 |         ]
401 | 
402 |         logger.debug(f"Inserting {len(records)} source_embedding records")
403 |         await repo_insert("source_embedding", records)
404 | 
405 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
406 |         logger.info(
407 |             f"Successfully embedded source {input_data.source_id}: "
408 |             f"{total_chunks} chunks in {processing_time:.2f}s"
409 |         )
410 | 
411 |         return EmbedSourceOutput(
412 |             success=True,
413 |             source_id=input_data.source_id,
414 |             chunks_created=total_chunks,
415 |             processing_time=processing_time,
416 |         )
417 | 
418 |     except ValueError as e:
419 |         # Permanent failure - don't retry
420 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
421 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
422 |         logger.error(
423 |             f"Failed to embed source {input_data.source_id} (command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
424 |         )
425 |         return EmbedSourceOutput(
426 |             success=False,
427 |             source_id=input_data.source_id,
428 |             chunks_created=0,
429 |             processing_time=processing_time,
430 |             error_message=str(e),
431 |         )
432 |     except Exception as e:
433 |         # Transient failure - will be retried (surreal-commands logs final failure)
434 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
435 |         logger.debug(
436 |             f"Transient error embedding source {input_data.source_id} "
437 |             f"(command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
438 |         )
439 |         raise

454 | async def create_insight_command(
455 |     input_data: CreateInsightInput,
456 | ) -> CreateInsightOutput:
457 |     """
458 |     Create a source insight with automatic retry on transaction conflicts.
459 | 
460 |     This command wraps the CREATE source_insight operation with retry logic
461 |     to handle SurrealDB transaction conflicts that occur during batch imports
462 |     when multiple parallel transformations try to create insights concurrently.
463 | 
464 |     Flow:
465 |     1. CREATE source_insight record in database
466 |     2. Submit embed_insight command (fire-and-forget) for async embedding
467 |     3. Return the insight_id
468 | 
469 |     Retry Strategy:
470 |     - Retries up to 5 times for transient failures (network, timeout, etc.)
471 |     - Uses exponential-jitter backoff (1-60s)
472 |     - Does NOT retry permanent failures (ValueError for validation errors)
473 |     """
474 |     start_time = time.time()
475 | 
476 |     try:
477 |         logger.info(
478 |             f"Creating insight for source {input_data.source_id}: "
479 |             f"type={input_data.insight_type}"
480 |         )
481 | 
482 |         # 1. Create insight record in database
483 |         result = await repo_query(
484 |             """
485 |             CREATE source_insight CONTENT {
486 |                 "source": $source_id,
487 |                 "insight_type": $insight_type,
488 |                 "content": $content
489 |             };
490 |             """,
491 |             {
492 |                 "source_id": ensure_record_id(input_data.source_id),
493 |                 "insight_type": input_data.insight_type,
494 |                 "content": input_data.content,
495 |             },
496 |         )
497 | 
498 |         if not result or len(result) == 0:
499 |             raise ValueError("Failed to create insight - no result returned")
500 | 
501 |         insight_id = str(result[0].get("id", ""))
502 |         if not insight_id:
503 |             raise ValueError("Failed to create insight - no ID in result")
504 | 
505 |         # 2. Submit embedding command (fire-and-forget)
506 |         submit_command(
507 |             "open_notebook",
508 |             "embed_insight",
509 |             {"insight_id": insight_id},
510 |         )
511 |         logger.debug(f"Submitted embed_insight command for {insight_id}")
512 | 
513 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
514 |         logger.info(
515 |             f"Successfully created insight {insight_id} for source "
516 |             f"{input_data.source_id} in {processing_time:.2f}s"
517 |         )
518 | 
519 |         return CreateInsightOutput(
520 |             success=True,
521 |             insight_id=insight_id,
522 |             processing_time=processing_time,
523 |         )
524 | 
525 |     except ValueError as e:
526 |         # Permanent failure - don't retry
527 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
528 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
529 |         logger.error(
530 |             f"Failed to create insight for source {input_data.source_id} "
531 |             f"(command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
532 |         )
533 |         return CreateInsightOutput(
534 |             success=False,
535 |             processing_time=processing_time,
536 |             error_message=str(e),
537 |         )
538 |     except Exception as e:
539 |         # Transient failure - will be retried (surreal-commands logs final failure)
540 |         cmd_id = get_command_id(input_data)
541 |         logger.debug(
542 |             f"Transient error creating insight for source {input_data.source_id} "
543 |             f"(command: {cmd_id}): {e}"
544 |         )
545 |         raise

548 | async def collect_items_for_rebuild(
549 |     mode: str,
550 |     include_sources: bool,
551 |     include_notes: bool,
552 |     include_insights: bool,
553 | ) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
554 |     """
555 |     Collect items to rebuild based on mode and include flags.
556 | 
557 |     Returns:
558 |         Dict with keys: 'sources', 'notes', 'insights' containing lists of item IDs
559 |     """
560 |     items: Dict[str, List[str]] = {"sources": [], "notes": [], "insights": []}
561 | 
562 |     if include_sources:
563 |         if mode == "existing":
564 |             # Query sources with embeddings (via source_embedding table)
565 |             result = await repo_query(
566 |                 """
567 |                 RETURN array::distinct(
568 |                     SELECT VALUE source.id
569 |                     FROM source_embedding
570 |                     WHERE embedding != none AND array::len(embedding) > 0
571 |                 )
572 |                 """
573 |             )
574 |             # RETURN returns the array directly as the result (not nested)
575 |             if result:
576 |                 items["sources"] = [str(item) for item in result]
577 |             else:
578 |                 items["sources"] = []
579 |         else:  # mode == "all"
580 |             # Query all sources with non-empty content
581 |             result = await repo_query(
582 |                 "SELECT id FROM source WHERE full_text != none AND string::trim(full_text) != ''"
583 |             )
584 |             items["sources"] = [str(item["id"]) for item in result] if result else []
585 | 
586 |         logger.info(f"Collected {len(items['sources'])} sources for rebuild")
587 | 
588 |     if include_notes:
589 |         if mode == "existing":
590 |             # Query notes with embeddings
591 |             result = await repo_query(
592 |                 "SELECT id FROM note WHERE embedding != none AND array::len(embedding) > 0"
593 |             )
594 |         else:  # mode == "all"
595 |             # Query all notes with non-empty content
596 |             result = await repo_query(
597 |                 "SELECT id FROM note WHERE content != none AND string::trim(content) != ''"
598 |             )
599 | 
600 |         items["notes"] = [str(item["id"]) for item in result] if result else []
601 |         logger.info(f"Collected {len(items['notes'])} notes for rebuild")
602 | 
603 |     if include_insights:
604 |         if mode == "existing":
605 |             # Query insights with embeddings
606 |             result = await repo_query(
607 |                 "SELECT id FROM source_insight WHERE embedding != none AND array::len(embedding) > 0"
608 |             )
609 |         else:  # mode == "all"
610 |             # Query all insights with non-empty content
611 |             result = await repo_query(
612 |                 "SELECT id FROM source_insight WHERE content != none AND string::trim(content) != ''"
613 |             )
614 | 
615 |         items["insights"] = [str(item["id"]) for item in result] if result else []
616 |         logger.info(f"Collected {len(items['insights'])} insights for rebuild")
617 | 
618 |     return items

621 | @command("rebuild_embeddings", app="open_notebook", retry=None)
622 | async def rebuild_embeddings_command(
623 |     input_data: RebuildEmbeddingsInput,
624 | ) -> RebuildEmbeddingsOutput:
625 |     """
626 |     Rebuild embeddings for sources, notes, and/or insights.
627 | 
628 |     This command submits individual embedding jobs for each item:
629 |     - embed_source for sources
630 |     - embed_note for notes
631 |     - embed_insight for insights
632 | 
633 |     The command returns after submitting all jobs. Actual embedding
634 |     happens asynchronously via the individual commands (which have
635 |     their own retry strategies).
636 | 
637 |     Retry Strategy:
638 |     - Retries disabled (retry=None) for this coordinator command
639 |     - Individual embed_* commands handle their own retries
640 |     """
641 |     start_time = time.time()
642 | 
643 |     try:
644 |         logger.info("=" * 60)
645 |         logger.info(f"Starting embedding rebuild with mode={input_data.mode}")
646 |         logger.info(
647 |             f"Include: sources={input_data.include_sources}, notes={input_data.include_notes}, insights={input_data.include_insights}"
648 |         )
649 |         logger.info("=" * 60)
650 | 
651 |         # Check embedding model availability (fail fast)
652 |         EMBEDDING_MODEL = await model_manager.get_embedding_model()
653 |         if not EMBEDDING_MODEL:
654 |             raise ValueError(
655 |                 "No embedding model configured. Please configure one in the Models section."
656 |             )
657 | 
658 |         logger.info(f"Embedding model configured: {EMBEDDING_MODEL}")
659 | 
660 |         # Collect items to process (returns IDs only)
661 |         items = await collect_items_for_rebuild(
662 |             input_data.mode,
663 |             input_data.include_sources,
664 |             input_data.include_notes,
665 |             input_data.include_insights,
666 |         )
667 | 
668 |         total_items = (
669 |             len(items["sources"]) + len(items["notes"]) + len(items["insights"])
670 |         )
671 |         logger.info(f"Total items to rebuild: {total_items}")
672 | 
673 |         if total_items == 0:
674 |             logger.warning("No items found to rebuild")
675 |             return RebuildEmbeddingsOutput(
676 |                 success=True,
677 |                 total_items=0,
678 |                 jobs_submitted=0,
679 |                 failed_submissions=0,
680 |                 processing_time=time.time() - start_time,
681 |             )
682 | 
683 |         # Initialize counters
684 |         sources_submitted = 0
685 |         notes_submitted = 0
686 |         insights_submitted = 0
687 |         failed_submissions = 0
688 | 
689 |         # Submit embed_source commands for sources
690 |         logger.info(f"\nSubmitting {len(items['sources'])} source embedding jobs...")
691 |         for idx, source_id in enumerate(items["sources"], 1):
692 |             try:
693 |                 submit_command(
694 |                     "open_notebook",
695 |                     "embed_source",
696 |                     {"source_id": source_id},
697 |                 )
698 |                 sources_submitted += 1
699 | 
700 |                 if idx % 50 == 0 or idx == len(items["sources"]):
701 |                     logger.info(
702 |                         f"  Progress: {idx}/{len(items['sources'])} source jobs submitted"
703 |                     )
704 | 
705 |             except Exception as e:
706 |                 logger.error(f"Failed to submit embed_source for {source_id}: {e}")
707 |                 failed_submissions += 1
708 | 
709 |         # Submit embed_note commands for notes
710 |         logger.info(f"\nSubmitting {len(items['notes'])} note embedding jobs...")
711 |         for idx, note_id in enumerate(items["notes"], 1):
712 |             try:
713 |                 submit_command(
714 |                     "open_notebook",
715 |                     "embed_note",
716 |                     {"note_id": note_id},
717 |                 )
718 |                 notes_submitted += 1
719 | 
720 |                 if idx % 50 == 0 or idx == len(items["notes"]):
721 |                     logger.info(
722 |                         f"  Progress: {idx}/{len(items['notes'])} note jobs submitted"
723 |                     )
724 | 
725 |             except Exception as e:
726 |                 logger.error(f"Failed to submit embed_note for {note_id}: {e}")
727 |                 failed_submissions += 1
728 | 
729 |         # Submit embed_insight commands for insights
730 |         logger.info(f"\nSubmitting {len(items['insights'])} insight embedding jobs...")
731 |         for idx, insight_id in enumerate(items["insights"], 1):
732 |             try:
733 |                 submit_command(
734 |                     "open_notebook",
735 |                     "embed_insight",
736 |                     {"insight_id": insight_id},
737 |                 )
738 |                 insights_submitted += 1
739 | 
740 |                 if idx % 50 == 0 or idx == len(items["insights"]):
741 |                     logger.info(
742 |                         f"  Progress: {idx}/{len(items['insights'])} insight jobs submitted"
743 |                     )
744 | 
745 |             except Exception as e:
746 |                 logger.error(f"Failed to submit embed_insight for {insight_id}: {e}")
747 |                 failed_submissions += 1
748 | 
749 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
750 |         jobs_submitted = sources_submitted + notes_submitted + insights_submitted
751 | 
752 |         logger.info("=" * 60)
753 |         logger.info("REBUILD JOBS SUBMITTED")
754 |         logger.info(f"  Total jobs submitted: {jobs_submitted}/{total_items}")
755 |         logger.info(f"  Sources: {sources_submitted}")
756 |         logger.info(f"  Notes: {notes_submitted}")
757 |         logger.info(f"  Insights: {insights_submitted}")
758 |         logger.info(f"  Failed submissions: {failed_submissions}")
759 |         logger.info(f"  Submission time: {processing_time:.2f}s")
760 |         logger.info("  Note: Actual embedding happens asynchronously")
761 |         logger.info("=" * 60)
762 | 
763 |         return RebuildEmbeddingsOutput(
764 |             success=True,
765 |             total_items=total_items,
766 |             jobs_submitted=jobs_submitted,
767 |             failed_submissions=failed_submissions,
768 |             sources_submitted=sources_submitted,
769 |             notes_submitted=notes_submitted,
770 |             insights_submitted=insights_submitted,
771 |             processing_time=processing_time,
772 |         )
773 | 
774 |     except Exception as e:
775 |         processing_time = time.time() - start_time
776 |         logger.error(f"Rebuild embeddings failed: {e}")
777 |         logger.exception(e)
778 | 
779 |         return RebuildEmbeddingsOutput(
780 |             success=False,
781 |             total_items=0,
782 |             jobs_submitted=0,
783 |             failed_submissions=0,
784 |             processing_time=processing_time,
785 |             error_message=str(e),
786 |         )
787 |
